title: TUZUUKUKE,TUZUUKUKE
text:
TUZUUKUKE,tuzuukuke,
Emirimu tugikole;
Tuve mu tulo,tweweeyo
Ssaddaaka ez'okumwebaza.

title: TUZUUKUKE,TUZUUKUKE
text:
Tufube nga twerowooza
Mpozzi-olwa leero okufa,
Tukulire mu mpisa ze,
Tusuubire okujja kwe.

title: TUZUUKUKE,TUZUUKUKE
text:
Tubeerenga ba mazima,
Bukuusa bwonna buggweewo;
Katonda-amanyi-eby'omunda,
N'ebirowoozo-abyekkaanya.

title: TUZUUKUKE,TUZUUKUKE
text:
Twakenga ng'omusana gwe;
Amulisa-ekkubo lyaffe,
Nga bw'atuwa-ebyaffe byonna,
Tumuwe-okwagala kwaffe.

title: TUZUUKUKE,TUZUUKUKE
TUZUUKUKE,TUZUUKUKE
text:
Tuzuukuse,tuzuukuse,
Otujjuze Omwoyo wo,
Otuwe obunyiikivu,
Tuweerezanga Katonda.

title: YESU MUKAMA W'EGGULU
text:
YESU Mukama w'eggulu,
Ggwe kitiibwa kya Kitaffe,
Ggwe musana gw'emirembe,
Ogumalawo-enzikiza.

title: YESU MUKAMA W'EGGULU
text:
Jjangu Njuba y'omu ggulu,
Tumulise n'ekisa kyo;
Omwoyo wo-Omutukuvu,
Atuule mu myoyo gyaffe.

title: YESU MUKAMA W'EGGULU
text:
Nyweza-okukkiriza mu ffe,
Ofuge-emibiri gyaffe,
Tuwe-emirembe n'essanyu,
Bukuusa bwonna buggweewo.

title: YESU MUKAMA W'EGGULU
text:
Otukuze-essanyu lyange,
Mu lunaku lwaffe luno;
Tuwe fenna-okukwebaza
Obudde nga buwungedde.

title: YESU MUKAMA W'EGGULU
text:
Tukusaba kino kyokka,
Otuwe-okukujjukira;
Buli nkya na buli kiro,
Tukusuute Mulokozi.

title: BWE BUKEDDE-OLWA LEERO
text:
NGA bwe bukedde-olwa leero,
Bwe tuyimusa bwe tutyo;
-Emitima gyaffe,tusaba,
Otukuume olwa leero.

title: BWE BUKEDDE-OLWA LEERO
BWE BUKEDDE-OLWA LEERO
text:
Kka,emyoyo gyaffe gibe,
Mirongoofu nnyo mu byonna;
-Emibiri gyaffe-eminafu,
Biweebwe-emmere y'obulamu.

title: BWE BUKEDDE-OLWA LEERO
text:
Bye tukoze byonna leero,
Bitendereze Katonda,
-Ekiro ne bwe kinaatuuka
Tetuutye entiisa yonna.

title: BWE BUKEDDE-OLWA LEERO
MUKAMA WAFFE BULIJJO
text:
MUKAMA waffe bulijjo,
Mu linnya lyo tutanule,
Tukole-emirimu gyaffe;
Twagala n'okumanya ggwe.

title: MUKAMA WAFFE BULIJJO
text:
Tukolenga by'oyagala,
Tubeerenga mu maaso go,
Tulabe n'omukisa gwo,
Era tukusanyukire.

title: MUKAMA WAFFE BULIJJO
text:
Amaaso go gatulaba:
Mukama otuzibire,
Tukuwe n'emyoyo gyaffe,
Tukole by'otulagira.

title: MUKAMA WAFFE BULIJJO
text:
Era tubeere-abaddu bo,
Tutunule,tusabe nnyo,
Tukwatenga-amateeka go,
Tuwulire-ebigambo byo.

title: MUKAMA WAFFE BULIJJO
text:
Kyonna kyonna kye tulina,
Yesu,kikyo so si kyaffe,
Tubeere naawe bulijjo,
Tutambule mu kkubo lyo

title: JJANGU GYE NDI BWE NZUUKUKA
text:
JJANGU gye ndi bwe nzuukuka,
Obudde nga busaasaanye,
Osige mu mwoyo gwange,
Ebirowoozo-ebisaana.

title: JJANGU GYE NDI BWE NZUUKUKA
text:
Jjangu gye ndi mu ggandaalo,
Eby'ensi ebitaliimu,
Bireme-okusiikiriza,
-Omusana ogw'amaaso go.

title: JJANGU GYE NDI BWE NZUUKUKA
text:
Akawungeezi-ojje gye ndi
Era bwe mba nkuvuddeko,
Onkomywewo,onzibire;
Mu nkwe zonna-eza Ssetaani.

title: JJANGU GYE NDI BWE NZUUKUKA
text:
Era mu ttumbi-ojje gye ndi,
Bwe neebaka-amavumira,
Nneme-okutya-akabi konna;
Nga nkuumibwa-Omulokozi.

title: JJANGU GYE NDI BWE NZUUKUKA
text:
Beeranga nange mu bulamu-
Beeranga nange mu kufa,
Ompitanga-okujja gy'oli,
Nsanyukire mu maaso go.

title: ENKYA BW'ONOOZUUKUKANGA
text:
ENKYA bw'onoozuukukanga,
Nga tosoose mirimu,
Sooka-osome mu kitabo
Yesu kye yawandiisa,
N'ofukamira mu maaso
Ga Katonda-Omulamu-,
Anaakuwanga-omukisa,
Bwomubuulira byonna.

title: ENKYA BW'ONOOZUUKUKANGA
text:
Oba ssanyu,oba nnaku
Bwe bijja gy'oli leero;
Tebiireme kukusanga
Nga weeteeseteese nnyo.
Totya maayi ga mulabe,
Ssetaani muwangule,
Onoomukubanga-enfuka;
Bw'onokkiriza Yesu.

title: ENKYA BW'ONOOZUUKUKANGA
text:
Ebigambo bya Katonda
Bikuliisa-omwoyo gwo,
Nga bw'obyekkaanya-era bw'otyo
Bw'olaba-emirembe gye.
Mu kusaba mw'onooweerwa,
Amagezi n'amaanyi;
Okugoba abalabe
Bwe bakulumba-obubi.

title: ENKYA BW'ONOOZUUKUKANGA
text:
Obukoowu n'obunafu,
Era n'obuyinike,
N'emitego gya Ssetani
Onoosobola byonna.
Saba Yesu-okukubeera
Buli lw'olaba-ennaku;
Bw'otyo bw'onoofuna-amaanyi,
Bw'omubuulira byonna.

title: ZUUKUKA GGWE-OMWOYO GWANGE
text:
ZUUKUKA ggwe-omwoyo gwange,
Busaasaanye-
-Era bukeeredde ddala;
Zuukuka ove mu tulo,
Waayo gy'ali
By'osobolera ddala.

title: ZUUKUKA GGWE-OMWOYO GWANGE
ZUUKUKA GGWE-OMWOYO GWANGE
text:
N'obulamu bwo enkeera,
Busanye.
-Okuyita mu kabi ako,
-Olw'olubeerwa-okuva gy'ali,
N'ojja-eri ye;
-Okusinza n'amaanyi go.

title: GGWE MUSANA GW'OBULAMU
text:
GGWE musana gw'obulamu,
Yakiranga ddala mu ffe,
Ekizikiza kyonna
Ka kive mu myoyo gyaffe,
Ng'otumulisa-,emmambya
Ng'esaze.

title: GGWE MUSANA GW'OBULAMU
text:
Enkuba nga bw'etonnya,
Ku bimuli ne ku muddo,
Bw'otyo bw'otufukako
Ekisa eky'omwoyo gwo;
Ennyonta yaffe yonna,
Eggweewo.

title: GGWE MUSANA GW'OBULAMU
text:
Ng'enjuba bw'emerusa;
Ebibala eby'omu nsi,
Bwe butyo-obulungi bwo
Bwe bumeza-obutukuvu
Tukuweerezenga ggwe,
N'essanyu.

title: GGWE MUSANA GW'OBULAMU
GY'OLI YESU TUWAAYO
GY'OLI YESU TUWAAYO
text:
Bwe lunaaleeta-essanyu,
Mubeezi waffe jjangu,
Tuleme-okutegebwa
Mu nkwe z'omulyolyomi;
Tuli mu lukoola ffe,
Omulabe-omugobe.

title: GY'OLI YESU TUWAAYO
text:
Twagala kino kyokka
Okusiimibwa Yesu,
Bw'anaaba akomyewo
Okutuyita leero,
Atusange ffe fenna
Nga tumulindirira.

title: OMPULIRE KITAFFE
text:
OMPULIRE Kitaffe
Ggwe Mukuumi wange:
Beera kumpi nange;
Onjijanjabenga.

title: OMPULIRE KITAFFE
text:
Ayi Mukaama Yesu,
Atuwa-obulamu,
Ka nziruke-embiro
Okutuuka gy'oli.

title: OMPULIRE KITAFFE
text:
Ggwe Mubeezi waffe,
Mwoyo wa Katonda,
Laba bwe nkwetaaga
Nsembeza, nnongoosa.

title: OMPULIRE KITAFFE
text:
Jjangu, Ayi Katonda;
Tondekanga wano,
Okuva kaakano,
Tuula mu nda yange.

title: KABAKA WANGE
text:
KABAKA wange nsanyuka
Okwebaza-ekitiibwa kyo,
Enkya okusuuta-erinnya lyo,
n'okulinyumyako-ekiro.

title: KABAKA WANGE
text:
Lunaku lwo lutukuvu
Lwa kitiibwa, lwa ssanyu nnyo:
Muyimbe mwenna amawanga,
N'essanyu lingi n'okutya.

title: KABAKA WANGE
text:
Bakozi b'obubi bonna
Bajja kusaasaanyizibwa
Baloka mangu ng'omuddo,
Naye balizikirira.

title: KABAKA WANGE
text:
Batukuvu ba Mukama
Banywera nnyo ng'omuvule,
Kibuyaga tamenya bo,
Baweereddwa-okubeerawo.

title: ENJUBA Y'OMWOYO GWANGE
text:
ENJUBA y'omoyo gwange,
-Omulokozi gwe njagala;
Bw'abanga-anjakira-,obudde
Tebujja kunzibirira.

title: ENJUBA Y'OMWOYO GWANGE
text:
Emitawaana egy'ensi
Gireme-okusiikiriza
Omusana gw'amaaso go,
Ne siyinza kukulaba.

title: ENJUBA Y'OMWOYO GWANGE
text:
Bwe ngenda-okwebaka-ekiro
Onteeke mu mikono gyo,
Onkuume mu kabi konna,
Oneebase mu mirembe.

title: ENJUBA Y'OMWOYO GWANGE
text:
Enkya,mu ttuntu, n'ekiro,
Era ne me bifo byonna,
Ggwe-ayagala abaana bo,
Beeranga nange,tondeka.

title: ENJUBA Y'OMWOYO GWANGE
text:
Oba nga-omu gwe watonda
Anyoomye-ekisa kyo leero
Kaakano-omutaase oyo,
Mu buyinza-obw'omulabe.

title: ENJUBA Y'OMWOYO GWANGE
text:
Ojjanjabe-abalumwa-ennyo,
N'abatayinza kwebaka,
Obawonye-endwadde zaabwe;
Obaggyeko-obubi bwonna.

title: ENJUBA Y'OMWOYO GWANGE
text:
Era bwe tunaazuukuka
Ojje otuwe-ekisa kyo;
Nga tetunnaba kukola
Emirimu-egya bulijjo

title: MUSANA MULUNGI
MUSANA MULUNGI
text:
2 
 Nga tebunnaziba,
 N'enzikiza ng'ejja,
 N'ennyimba z'olw'eggulo,
 Tusuute Kitaffe,
 N'Omwana we Yesu
 N'Omwoyo Omutukuvu.

title: MUSANA MULUNGI
text:
3
 Ggw'oli Mutukuvu,
 Tukutendereza.
 Yesu bulamu bwaffe
 Wansi ne mu ggulu;
 Ensi-ekusuuta
 Teekomyenga ttendo lyo.

title: KAAKANO BULI KINTU
text:
KAAKANO buli kinyu,
Ensolo n'ebimuli,
N'abantu byebaka:
Otulo tubikutte,
Naye ggwe mwoyo gwange,
Ofumiitirize bino.

title: KAAKANO BULI KINTU
text:
Eggulu litangaala
Obudde nga buzibye,
-Emmunyeenye ne zaaka;
Katonda bw'alimpita,
Ndigenda mangu gy'ali
Ne ndeka obuyinike.

title: KAAKANO BULI KINTU
text:
Bitundu byaffe byonna
Byesiima-okuwummula
-Emirimu giwedde;
Bwe gutyo-omwoyo gwange
Edda bwe guliteebwa
Gulijjula emirembe.

title: KAAKANO BULI KINTU
text:
Bwe twebaka,amaaso
Gabeera nga gazibye,
Nga tetuwulira;
Naye Yesu akuuma
Bonna abamwesiga,
N'abo-abeebakira mu ye.

title: OBUDDE BUZIBYE
text:
OBUDDE buzibye
Enjuba-egenze
Enzikiza-ekwata
Mu bbanga ly'ensi.

title: OBUDDE BUZIBYE
text:
Buli nsolo yonna,
Era n'ennyonyi,
Byonna biwummula
Byebaka-otulo.

title: OBUDDE BUZIBYE
text:
Ayi Mukama waffe,
Ontunuulire,
Kaakano nkusaba,
Ompe-ekisa kyo.

title: OBUDDE BUZIBYE
text:
Ebyonoono byange,
Binkwasa-ensonyi;
Naye-olw'ekisa kyo,
Tongoba w'oli.

title: OBUDDE BUZIBYE
text:
Bwe neebaka-otulo,
Mu kiro kino;
Bamalayika bo
Bajje bankuume.

title: OBUDDE BUZIBYE
text:
Ate bwe bunaakya,
Nga ngolokose,
Mbeere mu maaso go
Omulongoofu.

title: OBUDDE BUZIBYE
text:
Nsabira-abalwadde,
Ne bannamwandu;
Obawe-omutima
Ogukwesiga.

title: OBUDDE BUZIBYE
text:
Oweebwe-ekitiibwa
Gwe-eyatonda-ensi;
Ogulumizibwe,
Gwe-eyazuukira.

title: GUWEDDEWO OMUSANA
GUWEDDEWO OMUSANA
text:
Mu budde obw'enzikiza,
Ayi Yesu,otukuumenga.

title: GUWEDDEWO OMUSANA
text:
Biweddewo kaakano
Bigambo bya leero;
-Omulokozi,tuwonye
Mu maayi g'ekibi.

title: GUWEDDEWO OMUSANA
text:
Mu budde obw'enzikiza,
Ayi Yesu,otukuumenga.

title: GUWEDDEWO OMUSANA
GUWEDDEWO OMUSANA
text:
Mu budde obw'enzikiza,
Ayi Yesu,otukuumenga.

title: GUWEDDEWO OMUSANA
text:
Tukuume-emyoyo gyaffe;
Katonda ggwe-omanyi,
Obubi bw'omu kkubo
Ffe lye tuyitamu.

title: GUWEDDEWO OMUSANA
text:
Mu budde obw'enzikiza,
Ayi Yesu otukuumenga.

title: NGA TEBUNNABA KUZIBA
text:
NGA tebunnaba kuziba,
Tusaba-Omutonzi w'ensi
Olw'ekisa kyo ekingi
Ba Mukuumi waffe leero.

title: NGA TEBUNNABA KUZIBA
text:
Era bwe tuba twebase
Ebitutiisa biggyeewo;
Tuwanguze-obubi bwonna
Tubeerenga balongoofu.

title: NGA TEBUNNABA KUZIBA
text:
Ggwe Kitaffe tukusaba,
Ku bwa Yesu Omwana wo
Naawe Mwoyo-Omutukuvu,
Ggwe-afuga-emirembe gyonna.

title: BEERA NANGE,OBUDDE BUZIBYE
text:
BEERA nange,obudde buzibye;
Enzikiza-ekwata,beera nange:
Sirina nze mubeezi mulala,
Ggwe-abeera-abanaku,nange mbeera.

title: BEERA NANGE,OBUDDE BUZIBYE
BEERA NANGE,OBUDDE BUZIBYE
BEERA NANGE,OBUDDE BUZIBYE
BEERA NANGE,OBUDDE BUZIBYE
text:
Nze bwe ndiba nga naatera-okufa:
Omasemasenga mu nzikiza:
Ondowoozese-essanyu n'engule:
Mu bulamu, mu kufa,tondeka

title: MULOKOZI WAFFE GWE TWAGALA
text:
MULOKOZI waffe gwe twagala,
Tuyimiridde okusuuta ggwe:
Tukwegayiridde tusiibule,
N'emirembe,nga tufukamidde.

title: MULOKOZI WAFFE GWE TWAGALA
text:
Tuwerekere n'emirembe gyo,
Tubeere naawe,nga bwe twakedde;
Tukuumenga,tuleme-okwonoona,
Ffe abasabidde mu nnyumba yo.

title: MULOKOZI WAFFE GWE TWAGALA
text:
Tuwe-emirembe,Mukama waffe
Mu budde bw'ekiro-otumulise:
Tukuume lwa kisa ffe-abaana bo:
Enzikiza gwe musana gy'oli.

title: MULOKOZI WAFFE GWE TWAGALA
text:
Tuwe-emirembe buli lunaku
Lwe tuteganyizibwa eby'ensi;
Gitujjuze,era bwe tulifa 
Tuwe-emirembe egitakoma.

title: OLUNAKU LWAFE LUNO
text:
OLUNAKU lwaffe luno,
Kaakano luweddeko,
Enkya twebazizza Yesu,
Tumusuute-era-ekiro.

title: OLUNAKU LWAFE LUNO
text:
Naye wano nga buzibye,
Awalala bukedde,
Buli ssawa wanaabeera
Abasuuta-erinnya lye.

title: OLUNAKU LWAFE LUNO
text:
Omusaana nga bwe gujja
Mu nsi-ezitali zimu
Nga gwetooloola-olukalu,
Nga gugoba-enzikiza.

title: OLUNAKU LWAFE LUNO
text:
Bwe kutyo-okutendereza
Okw'abaana bo leero,
Tekusirika mu bantu,
Tekukoma n'akamu.

title: OLUNAKU LWAFE LUNO
text:
Ffe tugenda okwebaka,
Naye baganda baffe
Baakazuukuka-awalala,
Balyoke bakwebaze.

title: OLUNAKU LWAFE LUNO
text:
-Obwakabaka bwo, Mukama,
Tebugenda kuggwaawo;
Bulibuna mu mawanga,
Ne bufuga-ensi zonna.

title: AYI MUSUMBA OMUTEEFU
text:
AYI Musumba omuteefu,
Yesu-,olw'obulungi bwo
Ekiro beeranga nange,
Nkuuma mu kizikiza.

title: AYI MUSUMBA OMUTEEFU
text:
Ggwe ampa entanda yange
N'amaka n'ebyambalo;
Ne mu b'emikwano bonna,
Otuwenga ekisa.

title: AYI KITAFFE OMUTONZI
text:
AYI Kitaffe Omutonzi,
Ebitonde byo bikusinza;
Ku lwa Yesu Omwana wo
Tukuume mu kiro kino.

title: AYI KITAFFE OMUTONZI
text:
Ayi Omwana-0mununuzi
Eyatuggya mu busibe,
Emyoyo gyaffe gikuume,
Tubeere mirembe mu ggwe.

title: AYI KITAFFE OMUTONZI
text:
Ayi Omwoyo-ow'obuyinza 
Atukuza Ekkanisa,
Mu kiro kya leero, jjangu
Tukuza-emitima gyaffe.

title: AYI KITAFFE OMUTONZI
text:
Otenderezebwenga nnyo
Ggwe Kitaffe-era n'Omwana
Naawe-Omwoyo-Omutukuvu,
Ggwe-afuga-emirembe gyonna.

title: KATONDA WANGE NKWEBAZA
text:
KATONDA wange nkwebaza
Olw'ebirungi ebya leero;
Era nkusaba onkuume
Mu budde bwonna-obw'ekiro.

title: KATONDA WANGE NKWEBAZA
text:
Onsonyiwe ebyonoono
Bye nsobezza olwa leero:
Ompe-emirembe mu mwoyo,
Nga ngenda-okwebaka otulo.

title: KATONDA WANGE NKWEBAZA
text:
-Onjigirizenga bulijo
Ekkubo lye naakwatanga:
Bwe ntyo bwe ndituusa-okufa
Nneme-okutya-entiisa yonna.

title: KATONDA WANGE NKWEBAZA
text:
Mpummulire mu maaso go 
Mu nzikiza nkweyabiza,
Ne ndyoka ngolokoka-enkya
Okukuweereza nate.

title: OMUKISA GWA KITAFFE
text:
OMUKISA gwa Kitaffe,
N'ogw'Omwana we Yesu
N'ogw'Omwoyo-Omutukuvu.
Gukke ku myoyo gyaffe.

title: OMUKISA GWA KITAFFE
text:
Ffe tubeere fenna wamu,
Nga tujjudde-okwagala,
Bwe tusseekimu n'essanyu
N'emirembe bulijjo.

title: KITAFFE TWEWAAYO
text:
KITAFFE twewaayo
Emibiri gyaffe:
Tukuume-ekiro omu tulo
Okukeesa obudde.

title: KITAFFE TWEWAAYO
text:
Era Tukwebaza
Olw'ekigambo kyo
Kyewatusuubiza fenna
Nti tolituleka

title: JJANGU GGWE OMUNUNUZI WAFFE
text:
JJANGU ggwe Omununuzi waffe,
Ggwe Emmanueri,Kabaka waffe;
Onunule Abaisirayiri,
Abaakyamira-edda ewala-ennyo.

title: JJANGU GGWE OMUNUNUZI WAFFE
text:
Tusanyuke! Yesu(O)mulokozi
Alikomawo mu nsi gye tuli.

title: JJANGU GGWE OMUNUNUZI WAFFE
text:
Jjangu,jjangu,Omwana wa Dawudi,
Olokole ffe-abali mu kibi;
Tuwonye mu mikono gy'omubi,
Eyatujooga mu bukuusa bwe.

title: JJANGU GGWE OMUNUNUZI WAFFE
text:
Tusanyuke! Yesu (O)mulokozi 
Alikomawo mu nsi gye tuli

title: JJANGU GGWE OMUNUNUZI WAFFE
text:
Jjangu ggwe Musana-ogusanyusa;
Oyingire mu mitima gyaffe,
Otumalemu ekizikiza
N'ekisiikirize eky'okufa.

title: JJANGU GGWE OMUNUNUZI WAFFE
text:
Tusanyuke! Yesu (O)mulokozi
Alikomawo mu nsi gye tuli.

title: JJANGU GGWE OMUNUNUZI WAFFE
text:
Jjangu, Omukulembeze waffe,
Tulage-ekkubo-erituuka-ewuwo,
Tuggulirewo tutuuke gy'oli
Otuzibire-ekkubo-ery'okufa.

title: JJANGU GGWE OMUNUNUZI WAFFE
text:
Tusanyuke! Yesu (O)mulokozi 
Alikomawo mu nsi gye tuli.

title: JJANGU GGWE OMUNUNUZI WAFFE
text:
Jjangu,Mukama ow'obuyinza,
Eyawa-abantu bo amateeka,
Mu kitiibwa, mu biseera-eby'edda.
Ng'oyima mu lusozi Sinaayi

title: JJANGU GGWE OMUNUNUZI WAFFE
text:
Tusanyuke! Yesu (O)mulokozi
Alikomawo mu nsi gye tuli

title: MUZUUKUKE! MMWE-ABEEBASE
text:
MUZUUKUKE! mmwe-abeebase
Omukuumi atukoowoola
Suukuka Yerusaalemi
Kaakano obudde ttumbi,
Abawala ab'amgezi
Mujje, batukoowoola nnyo:
Awasa-omugole
Ajja,muyimuke!
Aleruuya!
Mujje nga mweteeseteese,
Mujje mumusisinkane.

title: MUZUUKUKE! MMWE-ABEEBASE
text:
Saayuuni yenna-awulidde,
Okukoowoola kw'omukuumi;
Bonna ne bajjula-essanyu;
Mukwano gwabwe-akka ku nsi,
Wa kitiibwa-era wa mazima,
Wa maanyi era wa kisa.
Kale Yesu jjangu
-Omwana wa Katonda,
Aleruuya!
Fenna tusseekimu naawe,
Fenna tugende n'essanyu.

title: MUZUUKUKE! MMWE-ABEEBASE
text:
Ekitiibwa kibe gy'oli;
Abantu bakutendereze
Wamu ne bamalayika.
Fenna tukuyimbirenga
Nga twetooloola entebe yo
Tujaguze! tujaguze!
Tewalabikanga 
Ssanyu eryenkanaawo
Aleruuya!
Tukuyimbire n'essanyu
Emirembe n'emirembe.

title: YESU ALIJJA N'EBIRE
text:
YESU alijja n'ebire
Eyafiirira-abanyu;
Abatukuvu be bangi
Wamu naye bayimba,
Aleruuya!
Ajja wansi-okufuga.

title: YESU ALIJJA N'EBIRE
text:
Bonna baliraba Yesu
Ng'ali mu kitiibwa kye:
N'abo-abaamuyigganya 
N'abo-abaamufumita
Balikaaba,
Yesu bw'alirabika.

title: YESU ALIJJA N'EBIRE
text:
Wansi ne waggulu wonna
N'ebirimu biriggwaawo-:
Abaamulyamu olukwe
Baliwulira Yesu
Bw'alisala,
Gubasinze,muveewo.

title: YESU ALIJJA N'EBIRE
text:
Abeegendereza bonna
Abamulindirira 
Balitwalibwa mu bbanga,
Balisangayo Yesu.
Eyeewayo,
Okuleeta-obulamu.

title: YESU ALIJJA N'EBIRE
MUSANYUKE ABALOKOLE
text:
MUSANYUKE abalonde
Abeesiga Yesu,
Ettabaaza zammwe zaake,
Obudde buzibye.
Mukama waffe alijja,
Kaakano ali kumpi,
Muyimuke mwekuume
Meleme-okwebaka

title: MUSANYUKE ABALOKOLE
text:
Mukoleeze-ettabaaza 
zaake mu nzikiza, 
Mulabe-obulokozi
Bwammwe busembedde.
Mukama bamulengera
Kaakano ali kumpi,
Mugende nga muyimba,
Okumusisinkana.

title: MUSANYUKE ABALOKOLE
text:
Abawala ab'amagezi 
Muyimbe nnyo nnyini
Ennyimba-ez'amatendo 
Ez'abamalayika.
Yesu atulindirira 
Mulokozi w'abantu:
Balokole ba Yesu,
Musembere mwenna.

title: MUSANYUKE ABALOKOLE
text:
Tukkiriza ggwe Yesu
Mulokozi waffe,
Yanguwa-okujja,olye
Obwakabaka bwo. 
Katonda atubeerenga 
Okubuuliranga wonna, 
Balokoke bonna.

title: EKIRO KIYISE
text:
EKIRO kiyise,
Obudde bukedde;
Kale twambule-ebikolwa
Eby'ekizikiza.

title: EKIRO KIYISE
text:
Twambale-amazima,
Ng'eby'okulwanyisa;
Tutambule nga tuwoomye,
Nga tujjudde-essanyu.

title: EKIRO KIYISE
text:
Ebyonoono byonna
N'ebinyumu by'ensi 
N'embaga-ez'okutamiira,
Byonna tubyambule.

title: YESU OMULINDWA, JJANGU!
text:
YESU omulindwa, jjangu!
Ffe tukulindirira;
Ebibi byonna-otuggyeko
Otuwummuze mangu.

title: YESU OMULINDWA, JJANGU!
text:
Ggwe ssuubi ly'abantu bonna,
Ggwe ssanyu ly'aboonoonyi.
Amawanga gonna gonna,
Gakwetaaga Katonda.

title: YESU OMULINDWA, JJANGU!
text:
Baakutuuma-erinnya Yesu
Eyanunula-abantu,
Wazaalibwa nga Kabaka
Era ng'omwana omuto.

title: YESU OMULINDWA, JJANGU!
text:
Olw'omwoyo wa Katonda 
Otufugire ddala; 
Beera mu ffe-otuwe-amaanyi 
Otutuuse mu ggulu.

title: MULOKOZI WAFFE YATUGAMBA
text:
MULOKOZI waffe yatugamba,
Ndikomawo ku nsi,mwetegeke.
Tetumanyi biro w'alijjira;
Naye tusuubiranga tulinda.

title: MULOKOZI WAFFE YATUGAMBA
text:
Era-essubi eryo lye yatuwa
Liritusanyusa-ennaku zonna.
Abaagalwa baffe batuleka;
Naye-essuubi eryo litugumya.

title: MULOKOZI WAFFE YATUGAMBA
text:
Abamuweereza mu nsi muno
Baweereddwa-empeera mu maaso go
Era baweereddwa n'omukisa,
Emirimu gyabye nga giwedde.

title: MULOKOZI WAFFE YATUGAMBA
text:
Ku lunaku luli kw'alijjira
Aliyita bonna abeebaka.
Alibakungaanya-abatukuvu
Babeerere awo bonna-awamu.

title: MULOKOZI WAFFE YATUGAMBA
text:
Bwe tulituukayo mu maaso ge
Tulimuweereza n'essanyu nnyo.
Ewuwe tewali kibi kyonna;
Essanyu jjereere-ennaku zonna

title: LABA, ANAAWASA OMUGOLE EKIRO AJJA
LABA, ANAAWASA OMUGOLE EKIRO AJJA
LABA, ANAAWASA OMUGOLE EKIRO AJJA
text:
-Olunaku luno-olw'omusango weeruli; naye 
Omwoyo gwange, tunula, toleka mulimu;
Okuume nnyo-ettabaaza, bw'atyo Omulokozi
N'ebyambalo-ebitukuvu, ye alikwambaza.

title: MMWE MWENNA-ABALONDE
text:
MMWE mwenna-abalonde,
Mujje musanyuke
Mujje tugende e Beesirekemu,
Gy'azaaliddwa Omwana wa Katonda

title: MMWE MWENNA-ABALONDE
text:
Mujje nno tumweyanze,
Mujje nno tumweyanze,
Mujje nno tumweyanze Mukama.

title: MMWE MWENNA-ABALONDE
MMWE MWENNA-ABALONDE
text:
Mujje nno tumweyanze,
Mujje nno tumweyanze,
Mujje nno tumweyanze Mukama.

title: MMWE MWENNA-ABALONDE
text:
Mmwe mwenna muyimbe,
Ennyimba ez'-amatendo,
Ab'omu ggulu mumuyimbire; 
Musuute Yesu,mumutendereze.

title: MMWE MWENNA-ABALONDE
text:
Mujje nno tumweyanze,
Mujje nno tumweyanze,
Mujje nno tumweyanze Mukama.

title: MMWE MWENNA-ABALONDE
text:
Tukulamusizza 
Eyazaalwa leero:
Yesu Mukama, tukusinza ggwe:
Katonda ddala,watwala-omubiri.

title: MMWE MWENNA-ABALONDE
text:
Mujje nno tumweyanze,
Mujje nno tumweyanze,
Mujje nno tumweyanze Mukama.

title: ABAKRISTAAYO BOONA-AB'OMU NSI
text:
ABAKRISTAAYO bonna-ab'omu nsi
Mugolokoke leero n'essanyu
Mutendereze Omulokozi
Eyazaalirwa-e Beesirekemu:
Bamalayika be be baasooka
Okutendereza Omwana oyo.

title: ABAKRISTAAYO BOONA-AB'OMU NSI
text:
Bo baasooka okukibuulira 
Abasumba-abo abawombeefu;
Nti temutya,kubanga-olwa leero 
Azaaliddwa-Omulokozi wammwe:
Leero Katonda kye yasuubiza 
Kituukiridde: Yesu ye azze.

title: ABAKRISTAAYO BOONA-AB'OMU NSI
text:
Awo ekibiina ne kirabika 
Eggye lyonna-erya bamalayika 
Nga bayimba oluyimba-olugya, 
Nga batendereza okwagal 
Okwamuleeta okuzaalibwa 
N'obuwombeefu obwenkanidde-awo.

title: ABAKRISTAAYO BOONA-AB'OMU NSI
text:
Nabo bwe baamala-okuwulia
Amangu ago ne bagolokoka, 
Ne bagendayo mbiro nnyingi nnyo 
Balabe Katonda kye yakola;
Ne basanga Omwana we Yesu, 
Ne bamusinza n'essanyu lingi.

title: ABAKRISTAAYO BOONA-AB'OMU NSI
OBUDDE BWALI BWA TTUMBI
text:
OBUDDE bwali bwa ttumbi,
Bwe baaluwulira;
-Oluyimba lw'ab'omu ggulu
Abaatendereza:
Emirembe gibe ku nsi
N'ettendo mu ggulu:
Ensi yali nga-esirise
Okuluwulira

title: OBUDDE BWALI BWA TTUMBI
text:
Ne leero bajja bwe batyo 
Eggye-ery'omu ggulu 
-Eddoboozi lyabwe libuna 
Mu bbanga ery'ensi; 
Newankubadde nga bangi 
Tebaluwulira; 
Eggye eryo likyaliwo 
Nga litendereza.

title: OBUDDE BWALI BWA TTUMBI
text:
Emitawaana egy'ensi 
N'enkaayana zaayo, 
Ebyo byonna bitugaana 
Okuluwulira. 
Oba nga tulina-ennyombo 
Tunaayinza tutya, 
Okuwulira-ebigambo 
Bya bamalayika?

title: OBUDDE BWALI BWA TTUMBI
text:
Kabaka ow'emirembe, 
Ggwe-omanyire ddala 
Abantu bwe bategana 
Mu bigambo by'ensi:
Osirise-olukaayano, 
Olw'ensi, tulyoke, 
Tuwulire-oluyimba-olwo 
-olwa bamalayika.

title: OMWAMI W'EKITIIBWA KYONNA BWE YAJJA KU NSI
text:
OMWAMI w'ekitiibwa kyonna bwe yajja ku nsi,
Abakopi n'abagenyi baamweyuna mangu,
Bwe baalaba nga basinza ne bamalayika

title: OMWAMI W'EKITIIBWA KYONNA BWE YAJJA KU NSI
text:
Baayimba:Ssanyu,ssanyu, ssanyu nnyo, 
Tumutende,Omwami waff(e) era Omwami wammwe.

title: OMWAMI W'EKITIIBWA KYONNA BWE YAJJA KU NSI
text:
Kale tumutende tumusinze wa kitiibwa,
Azze leero tumulabye Mwami waffe ddala,
Amaloboozi gaffe n"aga bamalayika

title: OMWAMI W'EKITIIBWA KYONNA BWE YAJJA KU NSI
text:
Baayimba:Ssanyu,ssanyu, ssanyu nnyo, 
Tumutende,Omwami waff(e) era Omwami wammwe.

title: OMWAMI W'EKITIIBWA KYONNA BWE YAJJA KU NSI
text:
Abatonde bonna wonna baana ba Katonda,
Mutegeere-obulokozi bwaffe bwe tutenda, 
Mutunuulire mwenna, tumusembeze fenna,

title: OMWAMI W'EKITIIBWA KYONNA BWE YAJJA KU NSI
text:
Baayimba:Ssanyu,ssanyu, ssanyu nnyo, 
Tumutende,Omwami waff(e) era Omwami wammwe.

title: ABASUMBA BAALI BAKUUMA
text:
-ABASUMBA baali bakuuma,
-Endiga zaabwe-ekiro,
Malayika n'akka ku nsi
N'eyakaayakana.

title: ABASUMBA BAALI BAKUUMA
text:
Mmwe-abasumba temwekanga 
Ndeese-amawulire 
-Ag'essanyu lingi nnyo nnyini 
Eri-abantu bonna.

title: ABASUMBA BAALI BAKUUMA
text:
Leero mu kyalo kya Dawudi 
Era mu kika kye,
Muzaaliddwa-Omulokozi,
Yesu lye linnya lye.

title: ABASUMBA BAALI BAKUUMA
text:
Omwana munaamulaba
Ng'azazikiddwa-eri 
Ng'abikkiddwa mu bugoye 
Mu kiraalo ky'ente.

title: ABASUMBA BAALI BAKUUMA
text:
Amangu ne walabika,
Mu ggulu ne ku nsi, 
Eggye-erya bamalayika 
Ne bayimba bati:

title: ABASUMBA BAALI BAKUUMA
text:
Katonda -aweebwe-ekitiibwa 
Mu ggulu ne mu nsi:
-Emirembe gibe mu bantu 
Bonna-abasiimibwa.

title: MU KUJAGUZA OKUNGI
text:
MU kujaguza okungi
Muyimbe n'essanyu lingi;
Yesu ssanyu lyaffe
Ali mu kisibo,
Yenna amasamasa
Ku mubiri gwa nnyina,
Yesu okusooka,
N'enkomerero.

title: MU KUJAGUZA OKUNGI
text:
Ayi Yesu, Omwana omuto 
Ggwe gwe neegomba bulijjo 
Nsaasira siraba,
-Omwana asinga bonna;
Ku lw'obulungi bwonna, 
Ggwe ow'ekitiibwa; 
Nsembeza gy'oli, 
Nsembeza gyoli.

title: MU KUJAGUZA OKUNGI
MU KUJAGUZA OKUNGI
text:
Essunyu liri ludda wa 
Oba nga teriri eyo? 
Bamalayika be 
Bayimba ennyimba empya 
N'eng'oma nga zivuga; 
Mu maaso ga Kabaka. 
Singa gye tuli, 
Singa gye tuli.

title: MU KIBUGA KYA DAWUDI
MU KIBUGA KYA DAWUDI
MU KIBUGA KYA DAWUDI
MU KIBUGA KYA DAWUDI
text:
Edda tulirabagana, Olw'okwagala-okungi,
Kubanga Omwana oyo,
Ye Mukama wa byonna,
Alituusa-abaana be 
Mu ggulu,babe naye.

title: MU KIBUGA KYA DAWUDI
text:
Tetukyamulaba nate 
Mu kiraalo eky'ente; 
Tulimulaba mu ggulu,
Ng'atudde ne Katonda.
Naffe tulibeera-eyo,
Nga tumutendereza.

title: OMWANA YAZAALIBWA
text:
OMWANA yazaalibwa,
Ku lwaffe mu nsi muno,
Mu kibuga kya Dawudi Eyasuubizibwa-edda.

title: OMWANA YAZAALIBWA
text:
Lunaku nga lukulu!
Yesu lwe yajjirako;
Kitegeezebwe wonna,
Yesu bwe yazaalibwa.

title: OMWANA YAZAALIBWA
text:
Abasumba baalaba
Malayika ekiro,
N'agamba nti Temutya, 
Mbaleetedde-eby'essanyu.

title: OMWANA YAZAALIBWA
text:
Lunaku nga lukulu!
Yesu lwe yajjirako;
Kitegeezebwe wonna,
Yesu bwe yazaalibwa.

title: OMWANA YAZAALIBWA
text:
Kristo Omulokozi 
Eyatonda-ensi zonna,
Olwa leero-azaaliddwa 
Mu kiraalo eky'ente.

title: OMWANA YAZAALIBWA
text:
Lunaku nga lukulu!
Yesu lwe yajjirako;
Kitegeezebwe wonna,
Yesu bwe yazaalibwa.

title: OMWANA YAZAALIBWA
text:
Omwana-Omutukuvu,
Ffe leero tuzze gy'oli;
Tukweyanza-ennyo nnyini,
Olw'ekisa kyo-ekingi

title: OMWANA YAZAALIBWA
text:
Lunaku nga lukulu!
Yesu lwe yajjirako;
Kitegeezebwe wonna,
Yesu bwe yazaalibwa.

title: LEERO BAMALAYIKA
text:
LEERO bamalayika
Bayimbira Kabaka,
Azaaliddwa gye tuli,
Laba bwe yeetoowaza;
Ye afuuse omuntu,
Okutugulumiza,
Mujje ab'ensi zonna,
Okumutendereza.

title: LEERO BAMALAYIKA
text:
Leero bamalayika,
Bayimbira Kabaka

title: LEERO BAMALAYIKA
text:
Ffe tujje tumusuute,
Emanuweri waffe,
Omwana w'omuwala
Yesu Omulokozi!
Azze-omusana gw'ensi 
-Okutumulisa fenna 
Tuleme-okutambula 
Mu nzikiza y'ekibi.

title: LEERO BAMALAYIKA
text:
Leero bamalayika,
Bayimbira Kabaka

title: LEERO BAMALAYIKA
text:
Kristo wa lubeerera,
Mukama-ow'ekitiibwa 
Ye Kabaka yennyini 
Azze-okubeera naffe;
Azze mu buwombeefu,
Mu ngeri ey'obuddu 
-Okutufiirira fenna,
Tuleme okubula,

title: LEERO BAMALAYIKA
text:
Leero bamalayika,
Bayimbira Kabaka

title: MU BIRO-EBY'EMPEWO
text:
MU biro-eby'empewo
E Beesirekemu;
Muwala omulongoofu
Yazaala-Omwana we.

title: MU BIRO-EBY'EMPEWO
text:
Musanyuke mwenna 
Muyimbe-ettendo lye;
Mujaguze, mujaguze,
Yesu azaaliddwa.

title: MU BIRO-EBY'EMPEWO
text:
Yesu azaaliddwa,
Mu kisa kye-ekingi 
Eggye erya bamalayika 
Batendereza nnyo.

title: MU BIRO-EBY'EMPEWO
text:
Abasumba bazze 
-Okusinza Omwana-oyo;
Abalaguzi batona,
Mugavu ne zaabu.

title: MU BIRO-EBY'EMPEWO
text:
Ne bamalayika 
Baase-okulamusa
Omwana-oyo mu kisibo 
Ye Mukama waffe.

title: MU BIRO-EBY'EMPEWO
text:
Azze-okununula, 
-Okuba -Omulokozi;
Azze- okuwangula-okufa,
Tasingika maanyi.

title: MU BIRO-EBY'EMPEWO
text:
Azze n'okwagala,
-Okuleeta-omukisa; 
Eri abantu be bonna, 
Atuyigirize.

title: MU BIRO-EBY'EMPEWO
text:
Oli mu kiraalo 
Ggwe-eyava mu ggulu,
Amaggwa galifumita 
Ekyenyi kyo, Yesu.

title: MU BIRO-EBY'EMPEWO
text:
Naye ggwe-otwagaza,
-Ebigambo by'obulamu;
Era-otuyinzisa fenna 
-Okukugoberera

title: MU BIRO-EBY'EMPEWO
text:
Ka tumuweereze 
Nga bamalayika;
Kale tusanyuke fenna 
Azaaliddwa leero

title: OWANGE MUNNANGE, JJUKIRA,JJUKIRA
text:
OWANGE munnange,jjukira,jjukira,
-Owange munnange,jjukira nno
Buli kiseera bwe kiyita-amangu nnyo;
Naye ggwe jjukira,weekebere.

title: OWANGE MUNNANGE, JJUKIRA,JJUKIRA
text:
E Beesirekemu,owange munnange, 
Eyo e Beesirekemu gy'azaaliddwa; 
Oyo yeetoowaza n'afiira ku miti,
Olw'okutulokola ffe mu bibi.

title: OWANGE MUNNANGE, JJUKIRA,JJUKIRA
text:
Kale mumwebaze leero mu mbaga_eno,
Nga mumuyimbira n'essanyu nnyo;
Kale tujaguze nga tumuyimbira,
Era tusinze nti Mulokozi.

title: BAANI ABAYIMBA TOBAWULIRA
text:
BAANI abayimba,tobawulira?
Laba abasumba bafukamidde;
Ssanyu,ssanyu,ssanyu,lize mangu nnyo
Obulokozi bwe butuuse mu nsi.

title: BAANI ABAYIMBA TOBAWULIRA
text:
Bbanga ddene ddala twali mu kabi, 
Nga tewali ddembe,wabula-obuddu: 
Kale nno atuuse -okutufuga ffe, 
Wa kisa,wa maanyi,Omulokozi.

title: BAANI ABAYIMBA TOBAWULIRA
text:
Kale naffe fenna tumukkirize,
Ffe fenna tweweeyo mu bufuge bwe;
Ku lwaffe-eyeewaayo ffe tulamuke: 
Mujje mumusinze,Omulokozi.

title: BAANI ABAYIMBA TOBAWULIRA
EKIRO KYA SSEKUKKULU
text:
EKIRO kyo Ssekukkulu,
Amaloboozi g'ebide
Gaavuga okutegeeza
-Amawulire ag'essanyu;
Okubuna-abantu bonna,
Azaaliddwa-Omulokozi.

title: EKIRO KYA SSEKUKKULU
text:
Ebigambo eby'essanyu,
Ebya bamalayika-abo 
Abaalanga okujja kwe, 
Kabaka wa bakabaka,
Mukama ow'abakama;
Atenderezebwe bonna.

title: EKIRO KYA SSEKUKKULU
text:
Kaakano Omulokozi,
Azaaliddwa mmwe gye muli;
Bamalayika bayimba 
Nga balanga okujja kwe.
Mu ggulu era ne mu nsi 
Emirembe gibe mu mmwe.

title: KINO KYA KTALO NNYO
text:
KINO kya kitalo nnyo
Ekitalabwanga;
Emirembe gizze nno
Mu nsi yaffe muno.
Ka tuyimbe nate,

title: KINO KYA KTALO NNYO
text:
Ekitiibwa eri Katonda 
N'emirembe mu nsi.

title: KINO KYA KTALO NNYO
text:
Bayimbira Kabaka
Mukama w'eggulu; 
Ensozi n'ebiwonvu 
Mwenna musanyuke: 
Fenna ka tuyimbe,

title: KINO KYA KTALO NNYO
text:
Ekitiibwa eri Katonda 
N'emirembe mu nsi.

title: KINO KYA KTALO NNYO
text:
Entiisa y'omulabe 
Leero tekyaliwo; 
Yesu Mukama waffe 
Azaaliddwa leero: 
Tuyimbe n'essanyu,

title: KINO KYA KTALO NNYO
text:
Ekitiibwa eri Katonda 
N'emirembe mu nsi.

title: YE KIGAMBO WA KATONDA
text:
YE Kigambo wa Katonda,
Kristo Yesu-Omwana we,
Ye n'afuuka omubiri
N'abeerako gye tuli
Ne tulaba omusana
-Okumulisa-enzikisa

title: YE KIGAMBO WA KATONDA
text: Emirembe n'emirembe.

title: YE KIGAMBO WA KATONDA
YE KIGAMBO WA KATONDA
text: Emirembe n'emirembe.

title: YE KIGAMBO WA KATONDA
text:
Bwe baalagira banabbi 
-Ab'amagezi-edda n'edda, 
Mu kitabo-ekyawandiikibwa 
Esuubi lye ettukuvu, 
Eyazaalibwa-okubeera 
Omununuzi waffe;

title: YE KIGAMBO WA KATONDA
text: Emirembe n'emirembe.

title: YE KIGAMBO WA KATONDA
YE KIGAMBO WA KATONDA
text: Emirembe n'emirembe.

title: YE KIGAMBO WA KATONDA
YE KIGAMBO WA KATONDA
text: Emirembe n'emirembe.

title: YE KIGAMBO WA KATONDA
text:
Mwebaze mmwe-eby'omu ggulu
-Awamu n'ebyensi zonna,
Mmwe muyimbe abalonde 
N'aboonoonyi muddemu 
Buli olulimi lwonna,
Lwebaze ettendo lye ;

title: YE KIGAMBO WA KATONDA
text: Emirembe n'emirembe.

title: YE KIGAMBO WA KATONDA
text:
Oluyimba olukulu!
Abakadde n'abato,
Abalenzi n'abawala 
Banaayatula Yesu,
Era banaatendereza; 
Ye Mulokozi waabwe,

title: YE KIGAMBO WA KATONDA
text: Emirembe n'emirembe.

title: KU LUNAKU LUNO
text:
KU lunaku luno,
Yesu ow'okwagala,
Leero yazaalibwa
Eno ye Ssekukkulu.

title: KU LUNAKU LUNO
text:
Leka tumusinze,
Omulokozi waffe 
Mumuwe-ekitiibwa 
Nga mujaguza leero.

title: KU LUNAKU LUNO
text:
Yesu ye kwagala,
Ye atwagala fenna;
Naffe tumwagale,
Kubanga ye yasooka.

title: LABA OMWANA MU KIRAALO-OMU
LABA OMWANA MU KIRAALO-OMU
text:
Omwana oyo Omutukuvu 
Omulokozi yeetoowaza 
Okubeera mu nsi nga muwombeefu;
Tulimulaba mu kitiibwa.

title: LABA OMWANA MU KIRAALO-OMU
text:
Banabbi bangi abaamulanga 
Ne bamalayika baayimba,
Bo ne bagamba nti azaaliddwa,
Asaanidde nnyo ekitiibwa

title: GGWE KIBUGA BEESIREKEMU
text:
GGWE kibuga Beesirekemu-
Tukutunuulire;
Nga osiriikiridde nnyo
Mu maaso g'eggulu.
Mu nzikiza mu nguudo zo
-Omusana gwo guzze;
Byonna bye watyanga edda
Biweddewo leero.

title: GGWE KIBUGA BEESIREKEMU
text:
Malyamu-azadde Kristo 
Omutabaganya;
Abantu mu butamanya
Katonda-abaagala,
Ggwe Kristo-,era ggwe Kabaka 
Tukusuute leero: 
Oweebwenga ekitiibwa 
Eyaleeta-essanyu.

title: GGWE KIBUGA BEESIREKEMU
text:
Ayi Katonda nga watuwa
Yesu Omwana wo, 
Kye kirabokyo-ekirungi 
Ekyava mu ggulu.

title: GGWE KIBUGA BEESIREKEMU
text:
Otuwe ffe aboonooyi 
Okumukkiriza,
N'emyoyo emiwombeefu, 
Ayingire mu ffe.

title: GGWE KIBUGA BEESIREKEMU
text:
Ggwe-Omwana Omutukuvu 
Jjangu-obeere mu ffe; 
Otuggyeko-ebibi byonna 
Ozaalibwe mu ffe. 
Tuwulira bamalayika 
Bayimba-eby'essanyu 
Eby'Omulokozi w'ensi 
Emanuweri waffe.

title: MU KISIBO KY'ENTE-E BEESIREKEMU
text:
MU kisibo ky'ente-e Beesirekemu;
Mwe yazazikibwa,Yesu Omwana,
Ne mmunyeenye ku ggulu nga zaaka nnyo
Omwana wa Katonda ng'azaaliddwa.

title: MU KISIBO KY'ENTE-E BEESIREKEMU
text:
Yesu teyatya nte nga bwe zingoonga,
N'abantu tebaamumanya,Omwana.
Nze mmwagala Yesu eyazaalibwa,
Abeerenga nange wonna we mbeera.

title: MU KISIBO KY'ENTE-E BEESIREKEMU
text:
Beera kumpi nange,Omulokozi,
Nkusaba-okusembera wano we ndi;
Tusaasire fenna,abaana-abato 
Tulyoke tubeere naawe mu ggulu

title: YESU OMWANA OW'EKISA
text:
YESU-Omwana ow'ekisa
Era-Omwana-omuwombeefu
Eyazaalwa mu kiraalo
Ggwe asuutibwa bonna.

title: YESU OMWANA OW'EKISA
text:
Ggwe azzikiddwa mu mmanvu,
Otuggye mu bibi byonna;
Okuume mikwano gyaffe,
Otuwe-emikisa gyo

title: YESU OMWANA OW'EKISA
text:
Yesu-eyajja mg'omuwere
Saasira-obunafu bwaffe; 
Bonna-abaana be watonda 
Obawe emikisa gyo.

title: NSANYUKIRA OLUYIMBA
text:
NSANYUKIRA-oluyimba
Lwa bamalayika
Lwe baayimba okulanga
Okujja kwa Yesu.
Nze sirina bulungi,
Nnina-ebibi bingi;
Naye yakka ku lwange
Yesu Mulokozi.

title: NSANYUKIRA OLUYIMBA
text:
Mmanyi Mukama waffe 
Yafuuka omuto,
-Okulaga empisa ennungi 
Ffe tuzikwatenga 
Era bwe naafubanga 
Okumufaanana 
Ye tanneerabirenga,
Kubanga-anjagala.

title: NSANYUKIRA OLUYIMBA
text:
Siyinza kumulaba 
Kaakano n'amaaso 
Naye ennyimba zange 
Anaaziwwulira.
Bwe naamugonderanga,
Alintuusa-ewuwe 
Ne mutenderezanga 
Nga bwe kisaanidde.

title: LABA -OMWANA AZAALIDWA
text:
LABA -Omwana-azaaliddwa,
Okuva mu ggulu;
Laba azze ng'omuto,
Mukama w'abakama.

title: LABA -OMWANA AZAALIDWA
text:
Kristo yeefeebya bw'atyo; 
Bwe yafuuka -Omwana,
Mu kiraalo Malyamu
Gye yamuzazikira.

title: LABA -OMWANA AZAALIDWA
text:
Kerode-omukambwe-ennyo
Ye yatya nnyo nnyini,
N'atuma abantu be 
Ne batta-abaana bangi

title: LABA -OMWANA AZAALIDWA
text:
Omwana Yesu,kye kisa,
-Ekituwaliriza 
Okukwata-ekkubo-eryo
Eritutuusa gy'ali.

title: EKISEERA KYE KITUUSE
text:
EKISEERA kye kituuse
-Ab'omu ggulu weebali;
Bonna batendereza nnyo
Nga bayimba bwe bati:

title: EKISEERA KYE KITUUSE
text: Ekitiibwa kibe eri Katonda

title: EKISEERA KYE KITUUSE
text:
Abasumba bwe baalaba 
Bamalayika bali 
Nga bayimba oluyimba 
-Olwali -olw'okujaguza:

title: EKISEERA KYE KITUUSE
text: Ekitiibwa kibe eri Katonda

title: EKISEERA KYE KITUUSE
text:
Mu kiraalo bwe baagenda
Baamulaba omuto; 
Bakkiriza nga ye Kristo,
Baamufukaamirira: 
Ekitiibwa kibe eri Katonda

title: EKISEERA KYE KITUUSE
text:
Naffe olw'okwagala kwe 
Leero ka tuyimbe nnyo,
Tumutendereze -Omwana 
Eyazaalibwa mu nsi: 
Ekitiibwa kibe eri Katonda

title: OMWANA-E BEESIREKEMU
OMWANA-E BEESIREKEMU
text: Aleruuya,Ale,Aleruuya.

title: OMWANA-E BEESIREKEMU
OMWANA-E BEESIREKEMU
text: Aleruuya,Ale,Aleruuya.

title: OMWANA-E BEESIREKEMU
OMWANA-E BEESIREKEMU
text: Aleruuya,Ale,Aleruuya

title: ESSANYU LINGI MU GGULU
text:
-ESSANYU lingi mu ggulu
Ennanga nga zivuga;
Era bamalayika
Bayimba nnyo mu bbanga.

title: ESSANYU LINGI MU GGULU
text: Ekitiibwa kibe waggulu ennyo

title: ESSANYU LINGI MU GGULU
text:
Naffe abali mu nsi, 
Ka tukube enduulu; 
Nti wa la-la-la-la-la! 
Ozaana waggulu-ennyo

title: ESSANYU LINGI MU GGULU
text: Ekitiibwa kibe waggulu ennyo

title: ESSANYU LINGI MU GGULU
text:
Ka tuyimuse gy'oli
-Emitima gyaffe gyonna 
Okwagala kwo kungi 
Okwakuleeta mu nsi.

title: ESSANYU LINGI MU GGULU
text: Ekitiibwa kibe waggulu ennyo.

title: EGGYE LYONNA ERY'OMU GGULU
text:
EGGYE lyonna ery'omu ggulu,
Mwetooloole-ensi yonna;
Mumuyimbire Kabaka
Azaaliddwa-olwa leero.

title: EGGYE LYONNA ERY'OMU GGULU
text:
Katusuute
Katwebaze 
Kabaka 
Azaliddwa

title: EGGYE LYONNA ERY'OMU GGULU
text:
Kale abagezigezi 
Mwanguwe okugenda, 
Nga munoonya Kristo waffe 
Kabaka w'ensi zonna.

title: EGGYE LYONNA ERY'OMU GGULU
text:
Katusuute
Katwebaze 
Kabaka 
Azaliddwa

title: EGGYE LYONNA ERY'OMU GGULU
text:
Abasumba nga bakuuma 
Ndiga zaabwe ekiro, 
Naye eri mu kiraalo 
Omusana nga gwaka.

title: EGGYE LYONNA ERY'OMU GGULU
text:
Katusuute
Katwebaze 
Kabaka 
Azaliddwa

title: EGGYE LYONNA ERY'OMU GGULU
text:
Laba azze mu yeekaali 
Naye nga tetumanyi; 
Simulaba naye ye-oyo 
Essuubi ly'ensi zonna.

title: EGGYE LYONNA ERY'OMU GGULU
text:
Katusuute
Katwebaze 
Kabaka 
Azaliddwa

title: EGGYE LYONNA ERY'OMU GGULU
text:
Kino kya kitalo ddala;
Omwana oyo-omuto 
Alifuga ensi zonna 
Emirembe-egitaggwaawo-

title: EGGYE LYONNA ERY'OMU GGULU
text:
Katusuute
Katwebaze 
Kabaka 
Azaliddwa

title: YESU NGA BWE YAZAALIBWA
text:
YESU nga bwe yazalibwa,
Mu kibuga-ekinyoomebwa
Bamalayika bayimba:
Ekitiibw(a) eri Katonda.

title: YESU NGA BWE YAZAALIBWA
text:
Tusanyuke n'okuyimba 
Yesu azaaliddwa leero; 
Bamalayika bayimba:
Ekitiibw(a) eri Katonda.

title: YESU NGA BWE YAZAALIBWA
text:
Basumba bwe baawulira 
Oluyimba olw'omu ggulu,
Baasanyuka nnyo nnyini; 
Ekitiibw(a) eri Katonda.

title: YESU NGA BWE YAZAALIBWA
text:
Leero nammwe-abawulira 
Mugende e Beesirekemu, 
Muwulire-oluyimba: 
Ekitiibw(a) eri Katonda.

title: AYI KITANGE,NKWESIGA
text:
AYI Kitange,nkwesiga
Okumbeeranga
Mu-ebyo-ebinambangako
Mu mwaka guno:
Sisaba kuggyibwako
Bizibu byonna,
Kyokka nsaba-erinnya lyo
Lyebazibwenga.

title: AYI KITANGE,NKWESIGA
text:
Mwana ki-eyeerondera 
Ye by'ayagala? 
Ebirungi kitaawe 
Tabimugaana.
Bulijjo-otuweereza 
Emikisa gyo; 
Kyenvu nsaba-erinnya lyo 
Lyebazibwenga

title: AYI KITANGE,NKWESIGA
text:
Bw'onompa mu bulamu 
Ebisanyusa,
-Essanyu lyange lye nnina 
Lineeyongera: 
Ka nnyimbenga bulijjo 
Amatendo do,
Mu byonna erinnya lyo 
Lyebazibwenga

title: AYI KITANGE,NKWESIGA
text:
Bw'onompita-okwetikka
-Omusaalaba gwo;
Ne gundeetera-ennaku 
N'obuyinike; 
Kandowooze ku Yesu 
Mu kitiibwa kye.
Bulijjo,erinnya lyo 
Lyebazibwenga.

title: TWEYANZIZA-EKISA KYO
text:
TWEYANZIZA-ekisa kyo
Okututuusa fenna,
Mu mwaka guno-omuggya
Ayi Kitaffe, wulira.

title: TWEYANZIZA-EKISA KYO
text:
Mu bunafu n'ennaku, 
Ka tuddukire gy'oli 
Ng'ekkubo litubula; 
Yesu-otukulembere.

title: TWEYANZIZA-EKISA KYO
text:
Bwe tulisemberera 
Ekiwonvu-eky'okufa, 
-Omuggo gwo n'oluga lwo 
Bye biritusanyusa.

title: TWEYANZIZA-EKISA KYO
text:
Bulijjo tubeerenga 
Beesigwa,balongoofu;
Ka tugumiikirize,
Otusaayize-engule.

title: TWEYANZIZA-EKISA KYO
text:
Mu nsi ey'omu ggulu,
Tulikuba-ennanga-empya 
Nga tukusuuta wekka,
Ggwe-afuga-abantu bonna

title: ABAGEZIGEZI-EDDA
text:
ABAGEZIGEZI-edda
Bwe baalaba-emmunyeenye
Baagiraba n'essanyu
Ne bagigoberera;
Naffe Yesu Mukama,
Twagala-okukulaba

title: ABAGEZIGEZI-EDDA
ABAGEZIGEZI-EDDA
text:
Bo baawaayo-ebirabo 
Eby'omuwendo-omungi 
Ne babimutonera 
Asinga bonna-ab'ensi;
Bwe tutyo naffe leero 
Tweweeyo Yesu gy'oli.

title: ABAGEZIGEZI-EDDA
ABAGEZIGEZI-EDDA
MMUNYEENYE- EYAKIRA BONNA
text:
MMUNYEENYE-eyakira bonna
-Abatambula-ekiro!
Otwakire otuwonye
Mu nzikiza yaffe.

title: MMUNYEENYE- EYAKIRA BONNA
text:
Jjangu! Muwanguzi waffe,
Yolesa-amaanyi go,
Ensi zonna zikusuute,
Zikugulumize.

title: MMUNYEENYE- EYAKIRA BONNA
text:
Leero-ebitonde byo byonna 
Bikaaba bisinda,
Awamu n'emyoyo gyaffe 
Nga tukusuubira.

title: MMUNYEENYE- EYAKIRA BONNA
text:
Ggwe-eyeetikka-omusaalaba 
Otuwonye-okufa. 
Musuutwa waffe, labika, 
Jjangu:tukwetaaga.

title: MMUNYEENYE- EYAKIRA BONNA
text:
Labika n'ekitiibwa kyo,
Weetikkira-engule,
Naffe ne bamalayika
Tusinzize wamu

title: OTUBEERE MMUNYEENYE ENNUNGI
text:
OTUBEERE Mmunyeenye ennungi,
Laga-ekifo Mukama gy'ali;
Oyakire mu nzikiza yaffe,
Tukwate-ekkubo-eridda gy'ali:
-Omununuzi ow'abantu bonna,
Kabaka,Omutonzi wa byonna,
Yeewombeeka ng'omwana-omuto.

title: OTUBEERE MMUNYEENYE ENNUNGI
text:
Kale tumuwe eby'obugagga,
-Akaloosa-ak'omuwendo-omungi?
Oba kumuwa zaabu n'eruulu,
-Obuyinja obumasamasa?
-Obugagga tumuweere bwereere,
Asinga-okwagala emitima 
Gy'abantu n'okusaba kwabwe.

title: OTUBEERE MMUNYEENYE ENNUNGI
text:
Otubeere Mmunyeenye ennungi,
Laga-ekifo Mukama gy'ali:
Oyakire mu nzikiza yaffe 
Tukwate-ekkubo-eridda gy'ali;
Twewombeeke nga Ye bwe Yakola,
Tweweeyo-olw'okubeera-abalala,
Tufubenga-okumufaanana

title: LABA-EMMUNYEENYE-ENNUNGI-ENNYO
text:
LABA-emmunyeenye_ennungi_ennyo
Ey'ekisa n'amazima
Emasamasa leero!
Omwana wa Dawudi ggwe,
Kannoonyenga amaaso go,
Omuva omusana.
Yesu wange,
Gw'oli-okumpi,ayi Kabaka ow'ekitiibwa,
Omuwanguzi wa byonna.

title: LABA-EMMUNYEENYE-ENNUNGI-ENNYO
text:
Emmeeme yange essanyuka 
Kubanga amaaso ga Yesu 
Galaba omuddu we.
Yesu gw'oli-omulungi enyo,
-Omutima gwange n'obulamu,
Era-amagezigange,
Beera nange 
Emirembe n'emirembe ,Ozaana! 
Ggwe-obulamu-obutaggwawo.

title: LABA-EMMUNYEENYE-ENNUNGI-ENNYO
text:
Kale kaakano njaguza,
Kubanga mmanyi nga Yesu 
Muganzi-anjagala nze;
Ankwata mu mikono gye,
Ankuuma mu kifuba kye,
Tunaagendanga wamu,
Jjangu mangu 
Engule ey'omuwendo,-era tolwawo;
Omugole akulinze.

title: ABANTU ABAABEERANGA
text:
ABANTU abaabeeranga
Mu nzikiza y'ensi
Omusana gubaakidde
Okugoba-okufa.

title: ABANTU ABAABEERANGA
text:
Watutikkula-emigugu
N'omenya-omujoozi,
Nga bwe wakola-omulabe,
Ku lwa Midiyaani.

title: ABANTU ABAABEERANGA
text:
Anaayitibwanga-erinnya 
Kabaka-ow'amaanyi,
Kabaka ow'emirembe,
Katonda-omwagalwa,

title: ABANTU ABAABEERANGA
ABANTU ABAABEERANGA
text:
Omwana atuzaaliddwa 
-Omwana-atuweereddwa;
-Obuyinza bwe bulifuga,
Mu ggulu ne mu nsi.

title: ABANTU ABAABEERANGA
text:
Buyinza bwe bulibuna 
Mu mawanga gonna;
N'ensala ze ez'ensonga,
Za mirembe gyonna.

title: ABANTU ABAABEERANGA
text:
Kale Yesu,jjangu leero 
Wamu ne Kitaffe;
N'Omwoyo Omutukuvu 
Tufugire ddala

title: YESU MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
YESU Mukama waffe,
Otugumiikirize,
Twetoowazizza leero.

title: YESU MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
Yesu ggwe-Omutukuvu 
Otugonze ffe-emyoyo 
Nga tukyalina-ebbanga.

title: YESU MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
Otujjuze ffe-Omwoyo 
Omubeezi ow'ekisa,
Tukwatenga-amazima.

title: YESU MUKAMA WAFFE
YESU MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
Ku lw'okwagala-okungi 
Okwakutufiiriza,
Yesu otuwulire

title: KATONDA, BWE BAALUMWA-ENNYO
text:
KATONDA, bwe baalumwa-ennyo
Ennyonta-Abayisirsyiri
Walagira Musa bw'oti:
-Okukuba-olwazi n'omuggo.

title: KATONDA, BWE BAALUMWA-ENNYO
text:
Mu lwazi olwakubibwa 
Ne muvaamu-amazzi mangi;
Abaali balina-ennyonta,
Baaganywa ne basanyuka.

title: KATONDA, BWE BAALUMWA-ENNYO
text:
Bwe tuluba-olwazi olwo,
Tulaba Yesu mu ngero;
Gwe baakuba-edda ku lwaffe,
Ne muva omusaayi gwe.

title: KATONDA, BWE BAALUMWA-ENNYO
text:
Bwe tubeera mu nsi muno,
Tulumwa-ennyonta mu mwoyo;
Kale tegatugwanidde 
Ffe amazzi g'obulamu?

title: YESU FFE MU MAASO GO
text:
YESU ffe mu maaso go
Tufukamidde leero:
Twatula-ebibi bingi
Amaziga ne gajja
Ku lw'okwagala-okungi
Okwakuleeta mu nsi,
Ng'oyima waggulu-ennyo
Yesu! otuwulire.

title: YESU FFE MU MAASO GO
text:
Ku lw'ekisa kyo-ekingi
Ekyakufuula-omwana,
N'obuzaaliranwa bwo 
Bwe wafuuka omuntu:
Ku lw'okukemebwa kwo 
Okw'entiisa mu ddungu,
Ng'oyima waggulu-ennyo,
Yesu! otuwulire.

title: YESU FFE MU MAASO GO
text:
Ku lw'okusaasira kwo 
Bwe wanyolwa omwoyo 
Ku ntaana ya Laazaalo,
Ne ku Yerusaalemi! 
Ku lw'entuuyo-ez'omusaayi 
N'Okusaba kwo-okungi,
Ngo'yima waggulu-ennyo,
Yesu! otuwulire.

title: YESU FFE MU MAASO GO
text:
Ku lw'okulumwa-okungi,
Ku lw'okusaba-okungi;
Ku lw'engule ya maggwa,
Era n'emisumaali,
N'effumu mu mbiriizi,
N'okukaaba-okw'entiisa,
Wawaayo-obulamu bwo;
Yesu! otuwulire.

title: BINKOOYESA-EBIBI BYANGE
text:
BINKOOYESA-ebibi byange
Ne njagala-okuwummula:
Ggw'oli kigo kyange,Yesu
Mwe neekwekanga bulijjo;
Ggwe muwolereza wange
Mukama wange ddala ggwe.

title: BINKOOYESA-EBIBI BYANGE
text:
Okwagala kwo kusinga 
Amaayi ebibi byange 
Nzize gy'oli, gunsinze nnyo,
Ogolola-emikono gyo:
Omwonoonyi-omusembeze
-Omunaaze mu musaayi gwo.

title: BINKOOYESA-EBIBI BYANGE
text:
Ontambuze mu kkubo lyo,
Ka nzire mu bigere byo,
-Olw'ekisa mpa ku maanyi go,
Obutayonoona nate,
Ebyagwa mu mwoyo gwange,
Obirongooseze ddala.

title: BINKOOYESA-EBIBI BYANGE
text:
Omwoyo ogukutya ggwe,
Ogwagala-amateeka go,
Ogumpe nze,omuddu wo 
Nneme-okuva mu maaso go,
Yesu Mukama wange,nze 
Neeweeyo mu mikono gyo

title: TULI BOONOONYI DDALA
text:
TULI boonoonyi ddala,
Abasibiddwa-ebibi;
Ggwe abeera-abanaku,
Otusaasire,Yesu

title: TULI BOONOONYI DDALA
text:
Tetulina bulungi 
Mu byonna bye tukola,
Ggwe-otegeera bwe tuli,
Otusaasire,Yesu

title: TULI BOONOONYI DDALA
TULI BOONOONYI DDALA
text:
Ssetaani yatusiba 
Mu kkomera ly'ebibi ;
Otufuule ba ddembe,
Otusaasire,Yesu.

title: TULI BOONOONYI DDALA
text:
Ali omu mu ggulu 
Atulokola yekka,
Tatuggalira bweru;
Otusaasire,Yesu.

title: TULI BOONOONYI DDALA
text:
Ye atuwolereza,
Mu maaso ga Katonda,
Ku bw'oyo tuwangula,
Tulituuka mu ggulu

title: MU KWETAAGA KWAFFE-OKUNGI
text:
MU kwetaaga kwaffe-okungi
Tukoowoola,AyiKatonda,
Tusaasire,tega-okutu,
Tuwulire-olw'ekisa kyo!
Mukama bw'onoolabanga
-Ebibi n'ensonyi-eby'abantu
Aliyimirira-aluwa?

title: MU KWETAAGA KWAFFE-OKUNGI
text:
Naye kino kye tumanyi 
Nga waliwo-okusonyiwa.
Eri ggwe Katonda waffe,
Awulira n'asaasira!
-Ekigambo kyo,Ayi Mukama 
Kya nsuubira -ennaku zonna,
Nindirira ggwe Mukama.

title: MU KWETAAGA KWAFFE-OKUNGI
text:
-Abakuumi baalindirira 
Obudde okukya,naye 
Emmeeme yange-esinga nnyo 
-Okuyaayaanira Katonda,
Kubanga-awali Mukama 
Wewali okusaasira,Mwenna mumusuubirenga.

title: EBYONOONO BYANGE BINKOOYESA
text:
EBYONOONO byange binkooyesa
Neegomba nnyo-okutuuka mu ggulu;
Teri kibi kyonna-ekiyingira
Naye-eddoboozi limpitaJjangu

title: EBYONOONO BYANGE BINKOOYESA
text:
Nze muddu w'ekibi okuva-edda,
Naasuubira ntya-okuyimirira 
Mu maaso ga Mukama w'emyoyo?
Naye akkiriza-okunsembeza.

title: EBYONOONO BYANGE BINKOOYESA
text:
Bwe njagala-okukola-obulungi,
Ekibi kimba kumpi bulijjo;
Naye nze mpulira bw'oyegera 
Weenenye,kkiriza-,onoolokoka

title: EBYONOONO BYANGE BINKOOYESA
text:
Mpulira eddoboozi lyo,Yesu,
Emikono gyo gye ginsembeza,
Era-omusaayi gwo guntangira;
Ogwayiika-edda ku musaalaba

title: EBYONOONO BYANGE BINKOOYESA
text:
Mulokozi w'abalina-ebibi,
Onnyambaze obutuukirivu,
Ndyoke ndabikire mu ggwe wekka,
Eyanzigyako-empeera-ey'ekibi

title: TUSAASIRE FFE-ABANAKU
text:
TUSAASIRE ffe-abanaku,
Tuzirise olw'ebibi;
Otubeere-Omulokozi
Kubanga ggwe osaasira.

title: TUSAASIRE FFE-ABANAKU
text:
Tusonyiwe abeeneya,
Tutambule mu maaso go 
Ng'aboonoonyi-abasonyiwe,
Tukwebaze-Omulokozi.

title: TUSAASIRE FFE-ABANAKU
text:
Tuzze gy'oli-Omulokozi,
Ggwe eyafa ku lw'abantu 
Naffe fenna aboonoonyi 
Tumanyi nti osaasira.

title: TUSAASIRE FFE-ABANAKU
text:
Tetukyatya omulabe,
Takyalina maanyi gonna:
Kale leka tukwesige,
Tusaasire -Omulokozi

title: OWEEBWE NNYO-EKITIBWA
text:
OWEEBWE nny(o) ekitiibwa,
Ggw(e) eyatununula;
Eyagulumizibwa
N'emimwa gy'abaana.

title: OWEEBWE NNYO-EKITIBWA
text:
Kabaka-agaba-obuwa,
Omwana wa Dawudi,
Mu linnya lya Mukama,
Eyajja gye tuli.

title: OWEEBWE NNYO-EKITIBWA
text:
Oweebwe,nny(o) ekitiibwa,
Ggw(e) eyatununula; 
Eyagulumizibwa 
N'emimwa gy'abaana.

title: OWEEBWE NNYO-EKITIBWA
text:
Bamalayika nabo 
Baasuuta-erinnya lyo;
Abantu n'enitonde 
Mu nsi ne baddamu

title: OWEEBWE NNYO-EKITIBWA
text:
Oweebwe,nny(o) ekitiibwa,
Ggw(e) eyatununula; 
Eyagulumizibwa 
N'emimwa gy'abaana.

title: OWEEBWE NNYO-EKITIBWA
text:
Abayudaaya-ensansa
Baakukulembeza;
Naffe tuyimba-ennyimba 
Nga tutendereza.

title: OWEEBWE NNYO-EKITIBWA
text:
Oweebwe,nny(o) ekitiibwa,
Ggw(e) eyatununula; 
Eyagulumizibwa 
N'emimwa gy'abaana.

title: OWEEBWE NNYO-EKITIBWA
text:
Bo baakutendereza 
Eyafa ku mit:
Ffe tusinza n'ennyimba 
Kabaka-afuga-ensi.

title: OWEEBWE NNYO-EKITIBWA
text:
Oweebwe,nny(o) ekitiibwa,
Ggw(e) eyatununula; 
Eyagulumizibwa 
N'emimwa gy'abaana.

title: OWEEBWE NNYO-EKITIBWA
text:
Ennyimba ez'abaana 
Ggwe wazikkiriza 
Naffe-era totugaana 
Byonna bye tusaba.

title: OWEEBWE NNYO-EKITIBWA
text:
Oweebwe,nny(o) ekitiibwa,
Ggw(e) eyatununula; 
Eyagulumizibwa 
N'emimwa gy'abaana.

title: BWE NDOWOOZA OMUSAALABA
text:
BWE ndowooza-omusaalaba
Mukama gwe yafiirako,
-Obugagga bwonna obw'ensi
Mbulaba nga tebuliimu.

title: BWE NDOWOOZA OMUSAALABA
text:
Bwe ndaba-amazzi n'omusaayi-
Ebyava mu mbiriizi ze,
Ne ntegeera-okusaasira 
N'okwagala kwe bwe kuli.

title: BWE NDOWOOZA OMUSAALABA
text:
Yesu Mukama onkuume,
Nneme-okwenyumirizanga,
Kino kyokka kinsanyuse 
Wanjagala n'onfiirira.

title: BWE NDOWOOZA OMUSAALABA
text:
Singa mbadde n'ensi zonna 
Ne nziwaayo Yesu gy'oli; 
Zonna tezandisasudde 
Ebbanja lyange-eryenkanaawo-

title: BWE NDOWOOZA OMUSAALABA
text:
Naye ky'oyagala leero,
Era kye ndeese nze eri ggwe,
Kwe kwagala kwange kwona,
Nkuweereze,nkusanyuse.

title: GGWE YERUSAALEMI
text:
GGWE Yerusaalemi.
Yerusaalemi
Kabaka wo ajja.

title: GGWE YERUSAALEMI
text:
Nga yeebagadde ,
Omwana gw'endogoyi 
Ozaana waggul(u) ennyo.

title: GGWE YERUSAALEMI
text:
Omulokozi,
Omwana wa Dawudi 
Ozaana waggul(u) ennyo.

title: GGWE YERUSAALEMI
GGWE YERUSAALEMI
text:
-Obwakabaka bwo 
Bubune mu nsi zonna,
Ozaanz waggul(u) ennyo.

title: OMUTWE GWA MUKAMA
text:
OMUTWE gwa Mukama,
Ogwafumitibwa
Amaggwa ge baaluka
Okukuduulira.
Ye ffe abandirabye
Ennaku zo zonna,
Mu kifo kyo bandisse
Ffe-abalina-ebibi.

title: OMUTWE GWA MUKAMA
text:
Tuli boonoonyi ddala,
Ggwe-oli Mutukuvu;
Mu maaso ga Kitaawo 
Toyonoonangako.
Twewombeese kaakano,
Tukuvuunamidde,
Tusaanidde okufa 
Naye otulokole.

title: OMUTWE GWA MUKAMA
text:
Naafuna ntya-ebigambo 
Eby'okukwebaza?
Wayiwa-omusaayi gwo 
Ku lwaffe ku muti.
Essanyu lye watuwa 
Tunaalyenkanya wa? 
Lisinga lyonna lyonna 
Ery'omu nsi zonna.

title: OMUTWE GWA MUKAMA
text:
Lulimi ki-oluyinza
Okwolesa-ekisa,
N'okwagala kwo-okungi 
Yesu bye walaga?
Otenderezebwenga,
Mulokozi waffe 
Kaakano n'okutuusa 
Emirembe gyonna

title: OKWAGALA OKWO
text:
OKWAGALA okwo
Okw'Omulokozi
Kwe yanjagala nze
Nange-atasaanira;
Kale nze-ani
Omwonoonyi?
Naye yafa ku lwange nze.

title: OKWAGALA OKWO
text:
Baatendereza nnyo 
Nga bayimba-ennyimba,
Nga bayimba-ennyimba,
Nga bagamba bonna:
Ozaana waggulu! 
Ate-amangu
Ne bagamba:
Komerera-Omulokozi.

title: OKWAGALA OKWO
text:
Tewalina nnyumba,
Ggwe eyatonda-ensi.
Mu kufa, bonna bonna 
Baakwabulira 
Njogere ntya 
-Omulokozi 
Olw'okunjagala bw'otyo?

title: OKWAGALA OKWO
text:
Yaleka-ekitiibwa
N'aleetera-abantu 
Obulokozi bwe 
Ffe-abatasaanira:
Yanjagala
Nze-omwonoonyi
N'awaayo byonna ku lwange.

title: OKWAGALA OKWO
text:
Naye yakola ki?
Yawonya-abalwadde;
Abalema bonna 
-Era Ne bamuzibe 
Yabawonya.
Kya kitalo,
Kaakano bamuduulira!

title: OKWAGALA OKWO
text:
Ka mbeere nga nnyimba 
Ku mukwano gwange; 
Ye Kabaka, naye 
N'anjagala bw'atyo
Mu bulamu 
Bwange bwonna,
Ka nkwagale-Omulokozi

title: EWALA MU BUYUDAAYA
text:
EWALA mu Buyudaaya,
Eriyo-olusozi,
Kwe yatufiirira Yesu,
Ye Mukama waffe.

title: EWALA MU BUYUDAAYA
text:
Ffe-abantu be tetumanyi 
Ennaku bwe zaali,
Ze yalaba ku lw'abantu,
-Omulokozi Yesu.

title: EWALA MU BUYUDAAYA
text:
Yafa ffe tufune-eddembe 
Atuwe n'obulamu:
Yafa atutuuse-ewuwe 
Gy'atudde mu ggulu.

title: EWALA MU BUYUDAAYA
text:
Tewali-eyandiyinzizza 
Kulokola munne,
Newankubadde ye yekka 
Kusinga-omusango.

title: EWALA MU BUYUDAAYA
text:
Mukama y'ayinza yekka 
Okutuggulira 
Oluggi olw'omu ggulu,
N'okutuyingiza.

title: EWALA MU BUYUDAAYA
text:
Tusaanidde ffe twagale
Mukama waffe-oyo;
Tweweeyo-okumuweereza 
Eyatufiirira

title: EKIBI KIRUWA KYE WALI-OKOZE?
text:
EKIBI kiruwa kye wali-okoze?
Baakuvunaana ki Mukama waffe?
Era-omusango gwakusinga gutya?
-Omwagalwa waffe!

title: EKIBI KIRUWA KYE WALI-OKOZE?
EKIBI KIRUWA KYE WALI-OKOZE?
text:
Ensonga y'ebibonyoobonyo byo ki?
Lwaki walaba-ennaku-ez'ekitalo? 
Zaakusanga lwa bibi byange byonna,
Mukama wange!

title: EKIBI KIRUWA KYE WALI-OKOZE?
text:
Okwagala kwo tekutegeerekeka:
Ku lw'endiga omusumba alumwa? 
-Omwami afa mu kifo ky'omuddu we?
Wafa ku lwange,

title: EKIBI KIRUWA KYE WALI-OKOZE?
text:
Ekisa kyo kimonyezza-okwegomba,
Kwe nali nakwo eri-eby'ensi eno:
Neeteeseteese okunyiikiranga,
Nkusanyusenga

title: YESU AZUUKIDDE OLWA LEERO, ALERUUYA
text:
YESU-azuukidde olwa leero,Aleruuya
Leero naffe ka tuyimbe, Aleruuya
Yatufiirira edda, Aleruuya
Yatulokola mu kufa, Aleruuya

title: YESU AZUUKIDDE OLWA LEERO, ALERUUYA
text:
Yesu tumutendereza,Aleruuya 
Ye kabaka-ow'omu ggulu,Aleruuya 
Yattibwa,N'aziikibwa, Aleruuya 
Okununula ffe abantu,Aleruuya

title: YESU AZUUKIDDE OLWA LEERO, ALERUUYA
text:
Obulumi bwa Mukama,Aleruuya 
Bwatuleetera-obulamu,Aleruuya 
Leero gy'ali mu ggulu, Aleruuya 
Gye bayimbira n'essanyu,Aleruuya

title: YESU WAALI! OKUFA
text:
YESU waali! Okufa,
Tokyayinza kututiisa:
Yesu yakuwangula;
Obulumi bwo bufudde!
Aleruuya!

title: YESU WAALI! OKUFA
text:
Yesu waali! bw'alijja,
Baliva-ababe mu bafu: 
Yesu waali! Okufa,
Gwe mulyango gw'obulamu.
Aleruuya!

title: YESU WAALI! OKUFA
YESU WAALI! OKUFA
text:
Yesu waali! tewali,
Ddala kya kutwawukanya.
Atukuuma bulijjo 
Buli wantu tatuleka.
Aleruuya!

title: YESU WAALI! OKUFA
text:
Yesu waali! yaweebwa 
-Obwakabaka bw'ensi zonna 
Tulibeera wamu naye.
Aleruuya!

title: YESU EYALI MU NVUBA
text:
YESU eyali mu nvuba,
Ez'okufa ku lwa ffe,
Yawngula n'azuukira,
N'atuwa obulamu;
Ka tumwebaze ennyo,
Leka tuyimbe n'essanyu,
Nga tuyimba Aleruuya!
Aleruuya!

title: YESU EYALI MU NVUBA
text:
Obulamu-bwe bwalwanyisa 
Okufa n'amagombe,
Newabaawo ssematalo,
Okufa ne kudduka;
Yesu yakuwangula,
Ekitabo kya Katonda,
Nga Ye Mujulirwa webyo .
Aleruuya!

title: YESU EYALI MU NVUBA
text:
Tukuume nnyo embaga-eno 
Nga tujjudde essanyu;
Yesu ye Njuba y'emyoy,
Ayakire mu gyaffe,
Twolese empisa ze;
Alabikire mu gyaffe,
Ne tutaswaza linnya lye.
Aleruuya

title: ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA! ALEERUYA!
text:
ALERUUYA! Aleruuya! Aleruuya!
-Abaana ba Kabaka mwenna
Musanyuke mujaguze,
-Amaanyi g'okufa gafudde:
Aleruuya!

title: ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA! ALEERUYA!
text:
Awo-olwatuuka Malyamu,
Era ne Magudaleene,
N'omukyala wa Kuloopa:
Aleruuya!

title: ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA! ALEERUYA!
text:
Ku lunaku-olwa Ssabbiiti 
Enkya mu matulutulu
Ne bagenda-awaali entaana:
Aleruuya!

title: ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA! ALEERUYA!
text:
Ne basanga Malayika,
Mu byeru n'abagamba nti:
Yesu-agenze-e Ggaliraaya:
Aleruuya

title: ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA! ALEERUYA!
text:
-Ekiro-ekyo_abatume baatya,
Yesu n'ajja n'agamba nti: 
Emirembe gibe mu mmwe:
Aleruuya

title: ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA! ALEERUYA!
text:
Tomasi bwe yawulira,
Bwe baamulabidde ddala,
N'abuusabuusa mu nda ye:
Aleruuya!

title: ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA! ALEERUYA!
text:
Yesu n'agamba Tomasi 
Nti,Leeta omukono gwo, 
-Ogusse mu mbiriizi zange:
Aleruuya!

title: ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA! ALEERUYA!
text:
Leka-okuba-atakkiriza,
Tomasi n'amuddamu nti:
Ggwe Katonda wange ddala 
Aleruuya!

title: ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA! ALEERUYA!
text:
Naye-alina-omulisa-oyo
Akkiriza nga talina 
Ky'alabako n'akatono:
Aleruuya!

title: ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA! ALEERUYA!
text:
Mu tendereze Kitaffe,
N'ettendo libe-eri-Omwana,
N'Omwoyo Omutukukuvu.
Aleruuya!

title: KU LUNAKU OLUKULU
text:
KU Lunaku olukulu,
Yesu lw'alirabika;
Alitukung'anya fenna,
Abaana be

title: KU LUNAKU OLUKULU
text:
Ebitundu byaffe byonna,
Omubiri n'omwoyo,
Biritwalibwa-eyo gy'ali,
Mu ggulu.

title: KU LUNAKU OLUKULU
text:
Bijja kwawulibwa mu nsi,
Ekiseera-ekitono,
Omubiri ne gwebaka,
Bwebasi.

title: KU LUNAKU OLUKULU
text:
Era omwoyo ogutafa,
Ne gubeerawo gwokka,
Nga gukyamulindiridde,
-Okujja kwe.

title: KU LUNAKU OLUKULU
text:
Naye ku lunaku olwo,
Birigattirwa ddala,
Omubiri nga gwambadde,
-Obutafa.

title: KU LUNAKU OLUKULU
text:
-Essanyu lyaffe nga liriba,
Lingi ku lunaku lwe,
Bwe tulimulaba Yesu,
Mu ggulu.

title: KU LUNAKU OLUKULU
text:
Ayi Mukma waffe Yesu,
-Otulung'amyenga fenna,
Mu kkubo eriritutuusa,
Ewuwo

title: LEERO LWA SSANYU, NNYO
text:
LEERO lwa ssanyu,nnyo,
-Okunakuwala n'ekibi biggwaawo;
Omwagalwa wange
Azuukidde,kaakano ye mulamu:
Naye sing(a) entaana yamusibiri ddala,essuubi liruwa?
Naye Kristo mulamu:yavaamu,yavaamu,yava mu ntaana.

title: LEERO LWA SSANYU, NNYO
text:
-Omubiri mu kufa 
 Gubeera nga guwumudde mu ntaana,
 -Okutuusa -olunaku 
 Abafu bonna lwe balizuukira.
 Naye sing(a) entaana yamusibiri ddala,essuubi liruwa?
 Naye Kristo mulamu:yavaamu,yavaamu,yava mu ntaana.

title: LEERO LWA SSANYU, NNYO
ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA
text:
ALERUUYA! Aleruuya! Aleruuya!
Yesu agobye,okufa
Kufudde,ye awangudde;
Kale muyimbe mwebaze.
Aleruuya!

title: ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA
text:
Amaanyi g'okufa, laba,
Gaatalira ddala gonna:
Galemeddwa,gagobeddwa.
Aleruuya!

title: ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA
text:
Ku lw'okusatu yagyasa 
Entaana ye n'azuukira 
Tweyongere-okuyimba-
ennyo 
Aleruuya!

title: ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA
text:
Yesu,tuwonye mu kufa 
N'emiggo-egyakubambula 
Tube balamu eri ggwe. 
Aleruuya!

title: YASULA MU NTAANA, MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
YASULA mu ntaana,Mukama waffe
Ng'alinda obudde,-Omulokozi.
Yazuukira mu bafu,ng'abawangudd(e) abalabe
Yava mu magombe ng'omwanguzi
N'abeer(a) omulam(u) emirembe gyonna
Yeebale! Yeebale!
Yeebale! yazuukira.

title: YASULA MU NTAANA, MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
Baakumira busa,Mukama waffe 
Banywereza busa, -Omulokozi.
Yazuukira mu bafu,ng'abawangudd(e) abalabe 
Yava mu magombe ng'omwanguzi 
N'abeer(a) omulam(u) emirembe gyonna
Yeebale! Yeebale!
Yeebale! yazuukira.

title: YASULA MU NTAANA, MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
-Okufa tekwayinza,Mukama waffe 
Yamenya-ebisiba,-Omulokozi
Yazuukira mu bafu,ng'abawangudd(e) abalabe 
Yava mu magombe ng'omwanguzi 
N'abeer(a) omulam(u) emirembe gyonna
Yeebale! Yeebale!
Yeebale! yazuukira.

title: ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA!
text:
ALERUUYA! Aleruuya!
Muyimbire Katonda;
Muyimuse-emyoyo gyammwe
Nga mujjudde nnyo-essanyu.
Yesu yatiibwa ku lwaffe,
N'ayiwa-omusayi gwe,
Okununula ffe-abantu,
Ye mulamu-,yazuukira.

title: ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA!
ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA!
text:
Ggwe wazuukira,Mukama;
Ggwe-oli mwaka gye tuli:
Olunaku luli kumpi,
Naffe tulikungulwa.
Nga enkuba n'omusana 
Bwe byengeza-ebibala:
Bw'otyo Yesu bw'otubaza,
Ebibala-ebirungi.

title: ALERUUYA! ALERUUYA!
text:
Aleruuya! Aleruuya!
Tukusinza,Kitaffe,
Naawe,Mwana,tukusinza,
Wakuwangula-okufa.
Naawe,Mwoyo,tukusinza,
Atuwa obutukuvu;
Aleruuya! Aleruuya!
Twebaze-Obusatu

title: YESU OMULOKOZI
text:
YESU Omulokozi,
Azuukidde leero
Bwe mutyo mujaguze
Mmwe-abalonde mwenna.
Kristo Omuwanguzi
Nga takyafa nate;
Ye Kabaka,okufa
Tekukyamufuga.

title: YESU OMULOKOZI
text:
Kale nno ka tukwate 
Embaga-ey'essanyu,
Era tuggyewo mu ffe 
Byonna-ebitasaana: 
Ka tuleke eby'edda;
N'obubi eby'edda;
Tulye nga tusanyuka 
-Emmere ey'omu ggulu.

title: YESU OMULOKOZI
text:
Mmwe mwenna-abazuukidde 
-Awamu ne Mukama,
Munoonye-eby'omu ggulu 
So si eby'omu nsi
Kristo bw'alirabika,
Obulamu bwaffe,
Ffe tulirabisibwa 
Fenna wamu naye

title: KABAKA MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
KABAKA Mukama waffe
Atuyita ku mbaga ye;
Ategese ebya ssava,
Twanguwe okugendayo.

title: KABAKA MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
Kristo-okuyitako kwaffe 
Omwana gw'endiga Yesu,
Eyaweebwayo ku lwaffe,
Tulyoke ffe tuwangule.

title: KABAKA MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
Kristo yava mu ntaana ye 
N'obuwanguzi obungi 
N'amaayi,okulokola
Ababi abamwesiga

title: KABAKA MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
Aleruuya, Aleruuya;
Osaanidde ekitiibwa,
Naawe Katonda Kitaffe,
N'Omwoyo Omutukuvu

title: ALERUUYA MYIMBE
text:
ALERUUYA myimbe,
Leero Yesu-azuukidde,
Tuyimbe nga twebaza
Olw'okuwangula kwe.
Aleruuya

title: ALERUUYA MYIMBE
text:
Obulumi bw'okufa,
N'amaanyi gaakwo gonna,
Byonna abiwangudde:
Naffe ka tujaguze.
Aleruuya

title: ALERUUYA MYIMBE
text:
Naffe-abaali-abasibe 
Mu buddu obwekibi 
Leero naffe tusinza:
Ssetaani awanguddwa.
Aleruuya

title: ALERUUYA MYIMBE
text:
Ka tujaguze fenna 
Kubanga yawangula;
Ka tuyimbe-amatendo 
Kuba tuli ba ddembe.
Aleruuya.

title: LEERO AZUUKIDDE
text:
LEERO azuukidde
-Omulimu guwedde,
Abasibe bateereddwa,
-Okufa kuwanguddwa.

title: LEERO AZUUKIDDE
text:
Yesu azuukidde 
Entaana njereere
Abaagulibwa bawonye 
Balifuga naye.

title: LEERO AZUUKIDDE
text:
Yesu azuukidde 
Mulamu takyafa,
Anaatuwolerezanga 
Emirembe gyonna.

title: LEERO AZUUKIDDE
text:
Yesu azuukide 
Mwenna musanyuke 
Mweyonger-okujaguza 
Kubanga azuukidde.

title: LEERO AZUUKIDDE
text:
-Abakubi b'ennanga 
N'abayimbi bonna 
Muyimbe mwenna n'essanyu 
Yesu azuukidde

title: OLUNAKU NGA LUKULU, ALERUUYA
text:
-OLUNAKU nga lukulu,Aleruuya!
Lwe yalinnya mu ggulu, Aleruuya!
Afuga nga Kabaka,Aleruuya!
Ensi zonna ziyimbe,Aleruuya!

title: OLUNAKU NGA LUKULU, ALERUUYA
text:
Kabaka-ow'ekitiibwa,Aleruuya! 
Makondeere gavuga; Aleruuya!
Bamalayika bonna; Aleruuya! 
Bonna batendereza,Aleruuya!

title: OLUNAKU NGA LUKULU, ALERUUYA
text:
Kabaka wensi zonna,Aleruuya! 
Mu ggulu era ku nsi;Aleruuya! 
Ssanyu, ssanyu lingi nnyo,Aleruuya!
Aleruuya,Ozaana.Aleruuya!

title: TUSINZA NNYO ERINNYA LYO
text:
TUSINZA nnyo erinnya lyo
Ayi Yesu Mukama,
Awamu n'abantu bonna;
Kababa waffe Yesu,afuga byonna.

title: TUSINZA NNYO ERINNYA LYO
text:
Mumwebaze, mmwe-abattibwa 
Okubalanga ye 
Musinze-eyabafiirira:
Kababa waffe Yesu,afuga byonna.

title: TUSINZA NNYO ERINNYA LYO
text:
Nammwe Bayisirayiri be 
Abaanunulibwa,
Musinze-Omwana wa Dawudi 
Kababa waffe Yesu,afuga byonna.

title: TUSINZA NNYO ERINNYA LYO
text:
Abantu abaasonyiyibwa 
Olw'ekisa kye ye,
Mufukaamirire Yesu:
Kababa waffe Yesu,afuga byonna.

title: TUSINZA NNYO ERINNYA LYO
text:
Amawanga gonna-agensi 
Muwulire Yesu:
Erinnya lye lisinzibwe.
Kababa waffe Yesu,afuga byonna.

title: TUSINZA NNYO ERINNYA LYO
text:
Twagala okutuukayo 
Mu maaso ga Yesu,
Okumweyanza bulijjo:
Kababa waffe Yesu,afuga byonna.

title: AYI YESU GGWE ATUDDE
text:
AYI Yesu ggwe atudde
Mu kitiibwa-ekingi,
-Omulimu nga guwedde
Gwe watukolere.
Tukwesiga ggwe wekka
Nga tukyatambula
Mu nsi muno.ggwe mwe wajja
Okutununula.

title: AYI YESU GGWE ATUDDE
text:
Tumanyi watugula,
Era watunaaza;
Tumanyi n'ekisa kyo 
Kye kitutukuza.
Ewuwo mu ggulu 
Okubeera bakabona 
N'okukuweereza.

title: AYI YESU GGWE ATUDDE
text:
Yesu okwagala kwo 
Tekukomezeka;
Tekuliiko kusooka,
So tekuliggwaawo;
Ebirowoozo byaffe 
Biremwa-okugera 
Ekisa kyo nga bwe kiri 
Ekitenkanika.

title: AYI YESU GGWE ATUDDE
text:
Yesu,okwagala kwo 
Tukwegayiridde,
Kutweweeseeyo gy'oli 
Leero ne bulijjo 
Tunooye kino kyokka,
Tunyiikire nnyini 
-Okugulumiza erinnya 
Ery'Omulokozi

title: MUMUSSEEKO-ENGULE
text:
MUMUSSEEKO-engule
Omwana gw'endiga;
Muwulire-amatendo ge
Agatenkanika.
Yimba mwoyo gwange,
N'amaanyi go gonna,
Oyatule Kabaka wo
Eyakufiirira.

title: MUMUSSEEKO-ENGULE
text:
Mumusseeko-engule
Omwana w'omuntu,
Yawangula-abalabe be 
Abaamujeemera.
Banabbi ab'edda 
Bye baamulangako,
Byonna yabituukiriza 
Bwe yabeera mu nsi.

title: MUMUSSEEKO-ENGULE
text:
Mumusseeko-engule 
Nnannyini kwagala,
Enkovu z'ebiwundu bye 
Zonna zirabika.
Kino kya kitalo 
Ekitenkanika,
-Emikono gye-emifumite 
Gye gituwa-obulamu-

title: MUMUSSEEKO-ENGULE
text:
Mumusseeko-engule 
Mukama w'eggulu,
Eyatuwanguza fenna 
Abamweyabiza 
Mununuzi waffe,
Kkiriza-ettendo lyo 
-Emirembe-agitalabika 
Lye giri kussaako

title: MUMUYIMBIRE MUKAMA
text:
MUMUYIMBIRE Mukama
Mmwe-abantu bonna mu nsi,
Olw'obuwanguzi-obungi
Yesu bwe yazuukira:
Nammwe mwenna-ab'omu ggulu
Muyimbe nga mumulinda;
Ajja n'obuwanguzi.

title: MUMUYIMBIRE MUKAMA
text:
Ku lwaffe yabonaabona,
Era eyo mu ntaana 
Omulabe yawangulwa;
Naffe twasumululwa,
Tetukyali baddu nate:
Erinnya lye lyebazibwe,
Olw'obuwanguzi bwe.

title: MUMUYIMBIRE MUKAMA
text:
Otenderezebwenga ggwe 
Olw'obulokozi bwo;
Era naawe.Ayi Kitaffe,
Ogwanidde-ekitiibwa;
Era naawe,Ayi Omwoyo,
Ka tukutenderezenga,
Katonda omu wekka

title: YESU NG'ADDAYO GYE YAVA
text:
YESU ng'addayo gye yava
Mu buwanguzi-obungi
Mumulabe ye Kabaka
Afuga bakabaka.
Bamalayika be bomma
Bakuba nnyo ennanga,
Eggye lyonna ery'omu ggulu
Baaniriza Kabaka.

title: YESU NG'ADDAYO GYE YAVA
text:
Ani ajja mu kitiibwa 
N'obuwanguzi-obungi?
Oyo-ow'amaanyi mu ntalo 
Awangudde-omulabe.
Bwe yafa ku musaalaba 
Era n'ava mu ntaana,
N'aweebwa-erinnya-erisinga 
Bonna bamusinzenga

title: YESU NG'ADDAYO GYE YAVA
text:
Atuzuukizizza naffe,
Tufuge wamu naye 
Eyo mu kitiibwa-ekingi 
Ne bamalayika be:
Omulokozi afuga 
Katonda-era omuntu 
Erinnya lye wa kitalo
Katonda ataggwaawo.

title: YESU NG'ADDAYO GYE YAVA
OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU JJANGU
text:
OMWOYO Omutukuvu jjangu,
Otusemberere fenna
Oyakire mu mitima gyaffe
Otuwe ebirabo byo byonna

title: OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU JJANGU
text:
Tufukeeko-okuva mu ggulu 
Omuliro ogw'okwagala.
Tuzzemu obulamu mu nda yaffe;
Ggwe wekka-Omusanyusa.

title: OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU JJANGU
text:
Jjangu ozibulire ddala 
Amaaso gaffe agatalaba,
Otukuze ffe aboonoonefu 
N'ekisa kyo ekitakoma.

title: OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU JJANGU
text:
Owangule abalabe baffe,
Otuwe ffe emirembe gyo, 
Bw'oba otukulembera 
Teri kibi kitutuukako.

title: OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU JJANGU
text:
Tulage Kitaffe n'Omwana 
Wamu naawe Katonda omu;
Tutendereze obulungi bwo 
Tutendereze obuluni bwo 
Leero n'emirembe gyonna

title: EDDA KATONDA BWE YAKKA
text:
EDDA Katonda bwe yakka
Ne wabaawo-entiisa;
Eggulu ne libwatuka,
Ne gwaka-omuliro.

title: EDDA KATONDA BWE YAKKA
text:
Naye-Omwoyo-Omtukuvu 
Bwe yakka-olulala,
Yava mu ggulu ng'empewo 
Ewuuma n'amaanyi.

title: EDDA KATONDA BWE YAKKA
text:
Omuliro-ogw'entisa-ogwo 
-Ogwayokya Sinaayi,
Ne gukka mpola ku mitwe 
Egy'abatukuvu.

title: EDDA KATONDA BWE YAKKA
text:
Kale,tukwegayiridde,
Jjangu okke ku ffe:
-Omugabi w'obulamu,kka,
Jjangu,Musanyusa.

title: EDDA KATONDA BWE YAKKA
text:
Tuwe-ebirabo,-okwagala,
-Emirembe n'essanyu.
Okgumiikiriza-ekisa;
-Obutrrfu,-okwesiga.

title: EDDA KATONDA BWE YAKKA
text:
Tunaasuutanga bwe tutyo 
Erinnya lye-ekkulu,
Kaonda Ayinza byonna,
Atukuza fenna.

title: JJANGU MWOYO WA YESU
text:
JJANGU Mwoyo wa Yesu,
Mu nzikiza otuwe
Omusana gw'obulamu-
Sembera, Musanyusa,
Tuula mu myoyo gyaffe,
Otufugire ddala.

title: JJANGU MWOYO WA YESU
text:
Ggwe Kiwummulo kyaffe,
Mu byonna bye tukola 
Otuwummuze gy'oli
Otumalemu-ebibi,
Merusa mu ffe-ekisa,
Tulyoke tukwagale.

title: JJANGU MWOYO WA YESU
text:
Longoosa-ebyonoonese 
Wonya-ebiwundu byaffe,
Tonnyesa-emikisa gyo.
Emyoyo gy'abajeemu,
Era-abalina-ebibi 
Ogikyusize ddala.

title: JJANGU MWOYO WA YESU
text:
Abeesigira ddala 
Obuyinza bwo bwonna 
Bulijjo-obakuumenga 
Mu nsi-otwe-ekisa kyo,
Era ku lw'amaanyi go,
Otutuuse mu ggulu.

title: OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU
OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU
text:
-Omwoyo-Omutukuvu 
-Otumalemu mu ffe 
Okwegomba kwonna 
Okutasaanira;
-Omusana-ogwakaayakana 
Omulise-emyoyo gyaffe.

title: OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU
text:
-Omwoyo-Omutukuvu 
Tuwe-Okwagalana;
Tutuukirizenga 
Etteeka lya Yesu:
Twesibenga-obuwombeefu 
Tunakuwalire-ebibi.

title: OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU
text:
-Omwoyo-Omutukuvu 
Otusobozese 
Okutuukiriza 
Yesu by'ayagala;
Tuyaayaanire Katonda,
Bye yategekera fenna.

title: OLWA LEERO MBAGA:OLUNAKU LUNO LUKULU!
text:
OLWA leero mbaga: Olunaku luno lukulu!
Bwe tulwaniriza,ka tulukwatenga.

title: OLWA LEERO MBAGA:OLUNAKU LUNO LUKULU!
text:
Leero-Omutonzi w'eggulu,olunaku n'ennyanja byonna,
Yatandika-omulimu gwe,olw'amagezi ge.
Olwa leero mbaga: Olunaku luno lukulu! 
Bwe tulwaniriza,ka tulukwatenga.

title: OLWA LEERO MBAGA:OLUNAKU LUNO LUKULU!
text:
Leero Mukama yazikiriza okufa mu kufa kwe,
Bw'atyo n'alyoka atuwa-essanyu n'essuubi lingi.
Olwa leero mbaga: Olunaku luno lukulu! 
Bwe tulwaniriza,ka tulukwatenga.

title: OLWA LEERO MBAGA:OLUNAKU LUNO LUKULU!
text:
Leero Katonda yajjuza-abatume amaanyi g'Omwoyo
Okuyigirizanga era n'okulunggamyanga.
Olwa leero mbaga: Olunaku luno lukulu! 
Bwe tulwaniriza,ka tulukwatenga.

title: OLWA LEERO MBAGA:OLUNAKU LUNO LUKULU!
text:
Leero mwenna abakkiriza mu nsi yonna mumutende 
Omununuzi wammwe namaloboozi gonna.
Olwa leero mbaga: Olunaku luno lukulu! 
Bwe tulwaniriza,ka tulukwatenga.

title: OLWA LEERO MBAGA:OLUNAKU LUNO LUKULU!
text:
Leero abali ewala mu nzikiza balitegeera 
Ekitiibwa kye-ekingi n'obutuukirivu bwe.
Olwa leero mbaga: Olunaku luno lukulu! 
Bwe tulwaniriza,ka tulukwatenga.

title: OLWA LEERO MBAGA:OLUNAKU LUNO LUKULU!
text:
Tukusaba, bulijjo-obeerenga mu myoyo gy'abantu bo,
Ggwe Mulokozi Yesu,era Mukama waffe.
Olwa leero mbaga: Olunaku luno lukulu! 
Bwe tulwaniriza,ka tulukwatenga.

title: ABATUKUVU BA KATONDA
text:
-ABATUKUVU ba Katonda
Entalo zaabwe zaggwaawo,
Tebakyetaaga mafumu,
Tebakyewoma mu ngabo.
Baweereddwa-omukisa bo,
Bajjudde-essanyu lya Yesu.

title: ABATUKUVU BA KATONDA
text:
-Abatukuvu ba Katonda 
Batuuka mu kiwumulo,
Tebeesittala kaakano 
So tebazirika nate.
Baweereddwa-omukisa bo,
Balaba-amaaso ga Yesu.

title: ABATUKUVU BA KATONDA
text:
-Abatukuvu ba Katonda 
Edda baafuba n'amaanyi;
Mu nnyanja y'ennaku zaabwe,
-Amayengo nga gabakuba.
Baweereddwa-omukisa bo,
Bagobye mu mwalo gwabwe.

title: ABATUKUVU BA KATONDA
text:
-Abatukuvu ba Katonda 
-Emibiri gyabwe givunda,
Bw'aliijja balizuukira,
Ne basanyusibwa Yesu.
Baweereddwa omukisa-bo,
Kabaka waabwe-ajja mangu.

title: ABATUKUVU BA KATONDA
text:
Katonda w'abatukuvu 
Yesu, -Omulokozi waffe 
Omwoyo eyatukuuma,
Katonda-omu mu Busatu;
Otuwe-abakukkiriza,
-Otutuuka mu mirembe gyo

title: ABALOKOLE BA YESU,BE YATUUSA MU GGULU
text:
ABALOKOLE ba Yesu, be yatuusa mu ggulu,
Bonna baana baKatonda, bonna batuukirivu;
Aleruuya,Aleruuya,bwe bayimba bwe batyo:
Ne bakuba-ennanga zaabwe,olw'essanyu lingi nnyo.

title: ABALOKOLE BA YESU,BE YATUUSA MU GGULU
ABALOKOLE BA YESU,BE YATUUSA MU GGULU
text:
Omukadde,era nabbi,abamugoberera,
Omulenzi n'omuwala,era n'omuvubuka,
Abaayagala Katonda,era-abaamwuweereza;
Baali baddu ba Ssetaani,kaakano balokose.

title: ABALOKOLE BA YESU,BE YATUUSA MU GGULU
ABALOKOLE BA YESU,BE YATUUSA MU GGULU
text:
Yesu kiki-ekyabawanguza Ssetaani bulijjo? 
Ku lw'amaanyi go baawangula,era ku lwekisa kyo:
Ne bayoza-engoye zaabwe mu musaayi gwa Yesu;
Bo baakemebwa Ssetaani,ne banywerera ddala.

title: ABALOKOLE BA YESU,BE YATUUSA MU GGULU
text:
Katonda wa bakatonda,ggwe-eyazaalibwa wekka,
Ggwe-omusana omulungi, olw'abo tusanyuka:
Ka tukwate-empisa zaabwe,nga tukwesiga wekka 
Yesu Mulokozi waffe,ggwe eyatufiirira

title: KATONDA YAGABA EGGYE
text:
KATONDA yagaba eggye
-Okulwana n'ebibi;
-Omugabe we ye mwana we:
Musajja we y'ani?

title: KATONDA YAGABA EGGYE
text:
Akwata-omusaalaba gwe 
Ayita ne Yesu,
Ass'ekimu n'ennaku ze,
Musajja we y'oyo.

title: KATONDA YAGABA EGGYE
text:
Ng'oli gwe baakuba edda 
Ku lwa Mukama we, 
Bwe yali ng'abasabira 
Baali balabe be,

title: KATONDA YAGABA EGGYE
text:
Baamutta ng'afukamidde 
Ye ng'alaba Ye su.
Bwe yali ng'ayimiridde 
-Okumulwanirira.

title: KATONDA YAGABA EGGYE
text:
Eggye-eddungi ery'ettendo.
Ery'abajulirwa;
Abaafiira mu muliro 
Era ne ku miti.

title: KATONDA YAGABA EGGYE
text:
Mu bunnya bw'empologoma 
Bangi baasuulibwa;
Era baabatta n'empiima,
Naye ne baguma

title: KATONDA YAGABA EGGYE
text:
Eggye-eddungi ery'abantu 
-Abakulu n'abato 
Beeyanza Yesu n'essanyu 
Leero ne bulijjo.

title: KATONDA YAGABA EGGYE
text:
Mukama waffe, tusaba 
Otuwe-ekisa kyo; 
Ennaku bwe tuziraba,
Twesige-amaanyi go

title: ERINNYA lyo Yesu lyebazibwe,
ERINNYA lyo Yesu lyebazibwe,
text:
Gwe wali lwazi lwabwe-oluwanvu,
 Omugabe mu lutalo lwabwe,
 Ggwe wabamulisa mu nzikiza 
 Aleruuya,Aleruuya!

title: ERINNYA lyo Yesu lyebazibwe,
text:
Naffe-abaserikale bo leero,
 Tweragenga-amasajja nga bali; 
 Naffe tutikkirwe engule eri 
 Aleruuya,Aleruuya!

title: ERINNYA lyo Yesu lyebazibwe,
text:
Fenna tussekimu wamu nabo 
 Ffe-abakyalwana ne be watwala 
 -Okubeera naawe mu kitiibwa kyo 
 Aleruuya,Aleruuya!

title: ERINNYA lyo Yesu lyebazibwe,
text:
Era oluusi bwe tukoowa-ennyo 
 Tuguma-omwoyo nga tuwulira 
 -Oluvimba lwabwe olw'olujaguza.
 Aleruuya, Aleruuya!

title: ERINNYA lyo Yesu lyebazibwe,
text:
Obudde bunaatera-oktuuka,
 Ne tuwummulira wamu nabo 
 Mu nnimiro z'okwesiima ziri.
 Aleruuya,Aleruuya!

title: ERINNYA lyo Yesu lyebazibwe,
text:
Laba! ate obudde bwe bukya
 Abatukuvu ne bazuukira 
 Kabaka-ow'ekitiibwa ng'atuuse.
 Aleruuya,Aleruuya!

title: ERINNYA lyo Yesu lyebazibwe,
text:
Bava mu nkuzi zonna ez'ensi,
 Nga bayimba okutendereza 
 Katonda oli-omu mu Busatu
 Aleruuya,Aleruuya!

title: KA tutambulenga nabo
text:
Abanoonya erinnya lyo,
Era n'abatukuvu bo
Emirembe n'emirembe.

title: KA tutambulenga nabo
text:
Laba-eggye ly'abatukuvu 
 Wamu n'abo tusanyuke;
 Era bwe mba nga nzirise 
 Linzizaamu nnyo amaanyi

title: KA tutambulenga nabo
text:
Tetubalaba kaakano 
 Baamala okuwunguka;
 Naffe tuli mu lugendo 
 Tulibeera wamu nabo

title: KA tutambulenga nabo
text:
Fenna awamu tuli mu ggwe,
 Tetubalaba n'amaaso,
 Naye olw'okukkiriza 
 Tuli mu kisibo kimu.

title: KA tutambulenga nabo
text:
Mu maaso go ffe awamu,
 Bulijjo tutendereza;
 Mu mwoyo tulabagana,
 Ne twebaza ekisa kyo.

title: KA tutambulenga nabo
text:
Eggye lyonna-ery'omu ggulu 
 Abo be ndibeera nabo;
 Era naawe Omwagalwa,
 Ani alitwawukanya?

title: AYI Kitaffe atwagala,
text:
Tuwaayo gy'oli-omwana-ono
Ayingire mu kisibo
Anywezebwe mu kwagala.

title: AYI Kitaffe atwagala,
text:
Omwana wo omwagalwa 
Teyagoba baaba bato; 
Ne kaakano tumuwaayo 
Omunyweze mu mikono gyo.

title: AYI Kitaffe atwagala,
text:
Mu biro eby'okukemebwa 
Muwenga obuwanguzi, 
Ayolese-ekitiibwa kyo;
Bonna bakutendereze.

title: AYI Kitaffe atwagala,
text:
Era ne ku nkomerero 
Bw'olijja mu kitiibwa kyo,
Asanyuke okuweebwa 
Engule gye wasuubiza

title: MU MIKONOGYO
text:
MU mikono gyo, Yesu,
Tuleeta-omwana-ono;
Ku Bbatirizo lino,
Tukusaba-omukuume.

title: MU MIKONOGYO
text:
Tumanyi-okwagala kwo 
 Eri-abaana bonna;
 Kubanga wabanenya 
 Abaali babagoba.

title: MU MIKONOGYO
text:
Naffe leero tusaba 
 Bwe tuleeta ono 
 Omutuule-omwana wo 
 -Emirembe n'emirembe.

title: MU MIKONOGYO
text:
Omulabe wa maanyi,
 Naye wamusinga 
 Otukuume mu kkubo,
 Otutuuse mu ggulu.

title: OMULOKOZI YESU
text:
OMULOKOZI Yesu
Ggwe atuyita mu nsi eno
Okukugoberera,
Kaakano tuzze gy'oli.

title: OMULOKOZI YESU
text:
Tutandise-olugendo 
 -Okuyita mu nsi enoo;
 Tukwate mu mikono 
 Tulyoke tuwangule.

title: OMULOKOZI YESU
text:
Tuli banafu ddala 
 Ggwe-oli w'amaanyi 
 Kaakano tusuubiza 
 Okukugoberera.

title: OMULOKOZI YESU
text:
Tetutya kabikonna,
 Kubanga wasuubiza 
 Nti ffe mu mikono gyo 
 Tuli ba ddembe ddala.

title: OMULOKOZI YESU
text:
Olugendo luwanvu 
 N'emitego mingi nnyo;
 Naye bwe tuba naawe 
 Tulituuka mu ggulu

title: OMUSUMBA-OMULUNGI
text:
OMUSUMBA-omulungi
Kuuma-endiga zo zonna;
Mpaawo-alizisikula
-Okuva mu mikono gyo.

title: OMUSUMBA-OMULUNGI
text:
Bulijjo twewombeeke 
Okukugoberera,
Ng'abo abaatusooka, 
Tukuumibwe-okwagala.

title: OMUSUMBA-OMULUNGI
text:
Bulijjo beera kumpi 
Tuyige-eddoboozi lyo;
Tuleme-okukyamanga 
Nga tuva mu kkubo lyo.

title: OMUSUMBA-OMULUNGI
text:
Yonna gy'onootutwala,
Tukugobererenga,
Okutuuka mu ggulu 
Tufuge wamu naawe

title: YESU NAAWE WALI
text:
YESU naawe wali
Omuto ngaffe,
So tewali muto
Gw'otoyagadde;
Naffe twakusenga
Ku Bbatirizo,
Otujjukizenga
Endagaano eyo.

title: YESU NAAWE WALI
text:
Mu kiseera ekyo 
Baatuyingiza 
Munda mu kisibo 
Eky'Ekkanisa.
Bwe tuneesiganga 
Ebigambo byo,
Onootukwatanga 
Mu mikono gyo.

title: YESU NAAWE WALI
text:
Tetukyakulaba 
Yesu,n'amaaso,
Naye tukusaba 
Otukuume nnyo.
Edda tulituuka 
Mu ggulu gy'oli,
Okufa kufuuka 
Otulo w'oli

title: YESU NAAWE WALI
text:
Ennyonta n'enjala 
Tebiriruma 
Ndiga zo z'otwala 
Ggwe-olizikuuma.
Okufa ku bwaffe 
Wakuwangula,
Amaziga gaffe 
N'ogasangula.

title: YESU NAAWE WALI
text:
Ayi Musumba waffe 
Obulamu bwo 
Wabuwa ku lwaffe 
Abagule bo.
Otujjukizenga 
Emikisa gyo,
Ka tukwesigenga 
Wonna,bulijjo.

title: TUSANYUSE-OKUJJA MU MAASO GO
text:
TUSANYUSE-okujja mu maaso go,
Tusuubiza leero mu maaso go;
Tubeere-abaana bo-ennaku zonna,
Okukuweereza n'obwesigwa.

title: TUSANYUSE-OKUJJA MU MAASO GO
text:
Naye tumanyidde ddala kino 
Nti tetuyinza awatali ggwe;
Naye ggwe watusuubiza kino 
Okubeeranga naffe bulijjo.

title: TUSANYUSE-OKUJJA MU MAASO GO
text:
Tumanyi nti ggwe oli mwesigwa,
Toyinza kutuleka mu kkubo;
Kale-essubi eryo litugumye 
Liryoke litutuuse mu ggulu.

title: TUSANYUSE-OKUJJA MU MAASO GO
text:
Otuyise okukuweereza 
Tuwaayo-obulamu bwaffe bwonna;
Tukuweereze nga bw'osaanira 
Olyoke-oweebwe-ekitiibwa mu nsi

title: TWALA-OBULAMU BWANGE
text:
TWALA-obulamu bwange
Obufugire ddala,
Ebiro bye ndimala
Bibe bya kukusinza.

title: TWALA-OBULAMU BWANGE
text:
Twala-emikono gyange 
Okukuweerezanga;
Twala-ebigere byangge 
Ntambulirenga mu ggwe.

title: TWALA-OBULAMU BWANGE
text:
Twala-eddoboozi lyange 
Nkutendereze Yesu;
Twala n'emimwa gyange 
Gibuulirenga-Enjiri.

title: TWALA-OBULAMU BWANGE
text:
Twala ne bye ndowooza,
Ndowoozenga by'osiima;
Twala-omutima gwange 
Bulijjo-ogukuumenga

title: TWALA-OBULAMU BWANGE
text:
Twala bye nnina byonna,
Byonna bibyo si byange;
Twala-amagezi gange 
Gakozese by'osiima.

title: TWALA-OBULAMU BWANGE
text:
Twala-okwagala kwange,
Ntwala nzenna nga bwe ndi;
Yesu-ontwalire ddala,
-Emirembe ne'mirembe

title: TWATEEKEBWAKO OMUSAALABA
text:
TWATEEKEBWAKO omusaalaba,
Tugoberere-Omugabe_waffe
Omwoyo-o'wamaanyi gwe tuweereza,
Balwanyi ba Yesu,tetudda nnyuma

title: TWATEEKEBWAKO OMUSAALABA
text:
Bye tulwanyiisa biva mu ggulu,
Ekitabo kye ye-engabo yaffe;
Okwagala-, Ekisa n'Obutukuvu,
Twambalenga byonna bye tulwanyisa.

title: TWATEEKEBWAKO OMUSAALABA
text:
-Obulwa bunene naye tugume,e, 
Tuliwummula nga tuwangudde;
Ekiwummulo eky'obuwanguzi 
Omugabe waffe alitwebaza.

title: TWATEEKEBWAKO OMUSAALABA
text:
Tulwanyise-ensi n'eby'omubiri,
Tudde mu maaso,tetudda nnyuma;
Otuwadde Omwoyo-ow'amagezi 
Tugende mu maaso wamu ne Yesu.

title: KATONDA WANGE NKUWADDE
text:
KATONDA wange nkuwadde
-Omwoyo gwange gwonna;
Nnemenga okukuvaako
emirembe gyonna.

title: KATONDA WANGE NKUWADDE
text:
Neesudde ku bigere byo,
Ggwe-eyakomererwa:
Komerera-ebibi byange,
Nkuweereze wekka.

title: KATONDA WANGE NKUWADDE
text:
Olw'ekisa kyo-ontukuze ,
Onfuule owuwo,
Ndyoke ndabe amaaso go 
Nkutenderezenga.

title: KATONDA WANGE NKUWADDE
text:
Nkuwadde byonna bye nkola 
N'ebyo bye ndowooza,
Nkuweereze mu bulamu,
Mu kufa nbe naawe.

title: KATONDA WANGE NKUWADDE
text:
Eddungu weeriri,
Lye mpitamu,naye 
Ka nnyanguwe gy'oli 
Ennyonta yange-eggwe.

title: ALIJJA:ESSUBI ERYO
text:
ALIJJA:essubi eryo
Lye litugumya-emyoyo
Ekiseera kitono
Okutuusa lw'alidda;
Naffe tulijaguza
Fenna Yesu bw'alijja.

title: ALIJJA:ESSUBI ERYO
ALIJJA:ESSUBI ERYO
ALIJJA:ESSUBI ERYO
text:
Ka tulye ku mbaga ye 
Ey'enviinyo n'emmere;
Bino bye bijjukizo,
Okutuusa ku biro 
Lw'alituliisa fenna 
Be yayita, bw'alijja.

title: ENJALA N'ENNYONTA
text:
ENJALA n'ennyonta
Binnuma-:ompeereze
Amazzi g'obulamu-
N'emmere-eva gy'oli.

title: ENJALA N'ENNYONTA
text:
Ggwe-eyabetentebwa,
Ku bwange,Mukama;
-Omugaati gw'obulamu 
Gumpe, nneme-okufa.

title: ENJALA N'ENNYONTA
text:
Ggwe,Ayi Muzabibbu
Oguleeta-obulamu 
Onnywese-enviinyo yo,
Envumule-omwoyo,

title: ENJALA N'ENNYONTA
text:
Nkooye n'okukoowa,
-Olugemdo lunnyinze;
-Ondiise ku mmere yo, 
-Ombeere,Mulokozi.

title: ENJALA N'ENNYONTA
text:
Eddungu weeriri,
Lye mpitamu,naye 
Ka nnyanguwe gy'oli
Ennyonta yange-eggwe.

title: MUJJE MUWEEBWE EKIJUKIZO
text:
MUJJE muweebwe ekijukizo
-Eky'okufa n'okulumwa kwa Yesu.

title: MUJJE MUWEEBWE EKIJUKIZO
text:
Bonna-abakkiriza ssadaaka ye,
Olw'ebibi byabwe,balokoke.

title: MUJJE MUWEEBWE EKIJUKIZO
text:
-Omusaayi n'omubiri biriisa 
Emyoyo gyaffe lwa kukkiriza.

title: MUJJE MUWEEBWE EKIJUKIZO
text:
Eyatuwa-obulokozi bwaffe,
Ye nnyini ali wakati mu ffe.

title: MUJJE MUWEEBWE EKIJUKIZO
text:
Tusemberenga n'okukkiriza,
Tufune-amaanyi ge twetaaga ffe.

title: MUJJE MUWEEBWE EKIJUKIZO
text:
Yesu-Omugabuzi w'embaga-eno,
 Tusseekimu ffe naawe mu ggulu.

title: KABAKA OW'EKISA, TUNUULIRA
text:
KABAKA-ow'ekisa,tunuulira
Leero ffe-abaana bo abasaba.

title: KABAKA OW'EKISA, TUNUULIRA
text:
Ggwe-Omusumba eyatununula,
Kuuma leero endiga zo zonn.

title: KABAKA OW'EKISA, TUNUULIRA
text:
-Omulokozi eyatufiirira,
Leero-otuwe-obulamu-obutaggwaawo.

title: KABAKA OW'EKISA, TUNUULIRA
text:
Ggwe-emmere y'obulamu-otuliise 
Tufune-amaayi mangi mu mwoyo.

title: KABAKA OW'EKISA, TUNUULIRA
text:
Beera naffe buli gye tugenda,
-Omugabe waffe,era Omusaale.

title: KABAKA OW'EKISA, TUNUULIRA
text:
Bwe tutyo bwe tulimala-okufa,
tulituuka nessanyu mu ggulu

title: YESU-OMUBIRI GWO Y'EMMERE
text:
YESU-omubiri gwo y'emmere
Eriisa-ab'omu nsi zonna,
Ggwe-obulamu bw'abantu bonna,
Wafa ku bwaffe-,otuwonye.

title: YESU-OMUBIRI GWO Y'EMMERE
text:
Tunuulira-okusinda kwaffe 
N'okukaaba kwaffe kwonna;
Embaga-eno-etutegeezenga 
Nga bw'otukkusa mu njala

title: LABA-EMMEZA YANGE
text:
LABA-emmeeza yange
Nga-ejjudde ebya ssava;
Mujje ku mbaga-eno
Mulye-emmere y'obulamu.

title: LABA-EMMEZA YANGE
text:
Alina ennyonta 
N'enjala ng'emuluma;
Ajje mangu gye ndi 
Nange naamuliisanga.

title: LABA-EMMEZA YANGE
text:
Nze mmere ennungi 
Kitange gye yabawa;
Ereetera ensi 
Obulamu-obutaggwaawo.

title: GGWE-OMWOYO GWANGE,WEEYONJE
text:
GGWE-omwoyo gwange,weeyonje
Ggwe weeyonjenga n'essanyu;
Va mu nzikiza y'ennaku,
Laba omusana gw'ensi;
Jaguzanga nnyo namaanyi,
Tenderezanga omwami
Ateekawo-embaga eno
Okuliisa abalonde.

title: GGWE-OMWOYO GWANGE,WEEYONJE
text:
Yesu-emmere-ey'omu ggulu,
Yesu agaba-obulamu;
-Onsembeze ku mmeeza leero;
-Onsembez-omubi-omwereere.
Owa,ku lw'embaga eno
-Okutegeera-okwagala kwo, 
Onsembeze-omuddu wo nze 
Mu lubiri ng'omugenyi.

title: GGWE-EMMERE Y'OBUGENYI
text:
GGWE-emmere y'obugenyi,
Ggwe maanu y'abalonde,
Eriisa-abeesigwa:
Abatambuze-abakoowu
Tulumibwa enjala
Olw'obulungi bwo.

title: GGWE-EMMERE Y'OBUGENYI
text:
Ggwe-oluzzi olutaggwaawo 
Era-olukulukuta 
N'essanyu n'ekisa,
-Oluwummuza-ab'ennyonta 
-Okutuusa lwe bawona 
N'amazzi g'obulamu.

title: GGWE-EMMERE Y'OBUGENYI
text:
Tulabira kaakano 
Kyokka mu ndabirwamu;
Ebitalabika:
Naye mu biro biri 
Tunaatunuuliranga 
Amaaso ge ddala

title: KRISTO,BW'ATYO,BWE YEEWAYO
text:
KRISTO,bw'atyo,bwe yeewayo
Ku lwaffe, ku muti;
Bwe tutyo naffe tweweeyo,
Okulokolebwa.

title: KRISTO,BW'ATYO,BWE YEEWAYO
text:
Omubiri gwe ye mmere 
Eriisa-abeetaaga
