Kigambo kye tekiggwaawo 
Emirembe gyonna.

title: KRISTO,BW'ATYO,BWE YEEWAYO
text:
Otuliise-omubiri gwo 
Tunywe-omusaayi gwo;
Nga bwe tusembera gy'oli 
Tufune-obulamu.

title: KRISTO,BW'ATYO,BWE YEEWAYO
text:
Kitiibwa eri Kitaffe 
Era neri-Omwana.
N'eri-Omwoyo-Omutukuvu 
Emirembe gyonna.

title: YESU WAKATI MU FFE
text:
YESU wakati mu ffe
Yimirira leero;
Ku lw'Okuzuukira kwo
-Otuwe ku maanyi go;
Era tutambulenga
Mu kkubo lyo n'essanyu
N'obwesigwa bwonna

title: GGWE-AKAMWA KANGE, TENDANGA
text:
GGWE-akamwa kange,tendanga
Omubiri gwa Yesu
N'omusaayi-gwe-eby'omuwendo
Ebiva mu Kabaka
Eyazaalibwa Malyamu,
Ye Mununuzi w'ensi.

title: GGWE-AKAMWA KANGE, TENDANGA
GGWE-AKAMWA KANGE, TENDANGA
text:
Ekiro-eky'enkomerero 
Ng'ali mu batume be,
Yesu yabakuutira nnyo,
Bakwatega-ey'obulamu 
Ye gye yawa n'engalo ze 
Emmere y'omuwendo mungi.

title: GGWE-AKAMWA KANGE, TENDANGA
text:
Kigambo yafuuka-emmere,
Eriissa-abantu bonna;
Omusaayi gwe ye nviinyo
Ebireeta-obulamu:
Bwe tubikkiriza ebyo,
Tumanya-okwagala kwe.

title: GGWE-AKAMWA KANGE, TENDANGA
GGWE-AKAMWA KANGE, TENDANGA
text:
Omukisa n'ekitiibwa,
Bya Kitaffe n'Omwana 
Obukulu-era n'ettendo 
Bibe-eri ye bulijjo.
Bitulagenga-okwagala 
Kw'oyo-omu ne Kitaffe.

title: EKITIIBWA KIBE WAGGULU
text:
-EKITIIBWA kibe waggulu
N'eri Katonda waffe
N'emirembe gibe mu nsi
-Ekisa kibe mu bantu
Tukusinza, tukusuuta
Ggwe Ayi Mukama Katonda,
Kitaffe-Ayinza-byonna

title: EKITIIBWA KIBE WAGGULU
EKITIIBWA KIBE WAGGULU
text:
Ggwe aggyawo ebibi by'ensi,
Tusaasire,Ayi Yesu;
Ggwe-aggyawo ebibi by'ensi 
Kkiriza bye tusaba.
Ggwe attudde ku mukono 
Ogwa ddyo ogwa Katonda,
-Otusaasire,Ayi Yesu.

title: EKITIIBWA KIBE WAGGULU
text:
Ggwe wekka ggwe Mutukuvu,
Ggwe wekka,Ayi Mukama.
Ggwe wekka,Ayi Yesu Kristo,
N'Omwoyo-Omutukuvu.
Oli waggulu nnyo nnyini 
Mu kitiibwa kyo ekingi;
-Ekya Kitaffe.Amiina.

title: NYWEZA-,AYI KATONDA,-EMIKONO
text:
NYWEZA-,Ayi Katonda,-emikono
Egikutte-emmere yo:
Abawulidde-ennyimba zo
Tebaasuubire bibi.

title: NYWEZA-,AYI KATONDA,-EMIKONO
text:
Ffe abayimbye Mutukuvu
Tuleme okulimba;
Abalabye-okwagala kwo
-Essuubi lyo tulirabe.

title: NYWEZA-,AYI KATONDA,-EMIKONO
text:
Ffe abazze mu yeekaalu yo 
Tuleme okukyama;
-Abaliisibwa Omwoyo wo 
Otuwe obulamu

title: MUJJE, NGA MWETEREEREKA
text:
MUJJE,nga mwetereereka
Mwenna-eriKatonda,
Okwagala kwe kujjuze
-Emyoyo gyammwe.

title: MUJJE, NGA MWETEREEREKA
text:
Wulira:ggwe-alindirira 
-Omugole wo leero,
Mu kwagalana-okutaggwaawo 
Mugattibwe.

title: MUJJE, NGA MWETEREEREKA
text:
Naawe akkiriza wano 
Okumufumbirwa,
Laba Kitaffe awulira 
-Obweyamo bwo!

title: MUJJE, NGA MWETEREEREKA
text:
Nammwe ababeetoolodde 
Okubaasabira,
Katonda waffe-akakasa 
-Ebirayiro.

title: MUJJE, NGA MWETEREEREKA
text:
Mujje nga mwetereereka;
Mukama waffe-ajja,
Okubasembeza gy'ali,
-Abagole be

title: MUJJE, NGA MWETEREEREKA
text:
Bwe mutyo mwetereereke 
Agabire bonna 
Omwaoyo-Omutukuvu
Abasaba.

title: TUZZE GY'OLI,AYI KATONDA
text:
TUZZE gy'oli,Ayi Katonda,
Katonda ow'okwagala;
Nga tubasabira bano
Obagatte wamu.

title: TUZZE GY'OLI,AYI KATONDA
text:
Bwe baba nga basanyuka 
Olugendo nga lulungi,
Bakwesigenga ggwe wekka,
Mu ggwe babenga-omu.

title: TUZZE GY'OLI,AYI KATONDA
text:
Ne mu biro eb'ennaku,
Omuyaga bga gukunta;
Era bakwesigenga ggwe, 
Obeerenga nabo.

title: TUZZE GY'OLI,AYI KATONDA
text:
Byonna ebiribajjira 
Oba ssanyu oba nnaku,
Obawenga ekisa kyo
Obeerenga nabo.

title: TUZZE GY'OLI,AYI KATONDA
text:
Mu ndwadde ne mu bulamu,
Mu bwavu ne mu bugagga;
Okwagala kwo okungi 
Kubeetooloolenga.

title: AYI GGWE KWAGALA,GGWE ASINGA BYONNA
text:
AYI ggwe kwagala,ggwe asinga byonna
Tufukamidde okukusaba,
Abo b'ogasse okubeera-obumu
Babeerenga naawe ennaku zonna.

title: AYI GGWE KWAGALA,GGWE ASINGA BYONNA
text:
Ayi ggwe bulamu,obabikkulire 
Okwagala okw'ekisa-ekingi;
Okukkiriza okunywevu ddala,
N'okwesiga ng'okw'omwana-omuto.

title: AYI GGWE KWAGALA,GGWE ASINGA BYONNA
text:
-Obasanyusenga bwe baba mu nnaku,
-Obawe-emirembe egitakoma;
Obawe-emikisa mu bulamu bwabwe,
Baagalanenga-emirembe gyonna

title: ABANTU BONNA AB'ENSI
text:
ABANTU bonna ab'ensi,
Mukama mumuyimbire!
Mumutye,mumuwulire,
Mujje mumusanyukire.

title: ABANTU BONNA AB'ENSI
text:
Mukama Katonda waffe 
Ye yekka eyatutonda ffe;
ffe yatulonda,ffe babe,
Ffe ndiga z'oku ttale lye.

title: ABANTU BONNA AB'ENSI
ABANTU BONNA AB'ENSI
text:
Mujje mweyanze bulijjo:
Kubanga ye mulungi nnyo;
Tegaliggwa-amazima ge,
Newnkubadde-ekisa kye.

title: AYI KATONDA BWE NDOWOOZA
text:
AYI Katonda bwe ndowooza
Ku bingi bye wampa,
-Emmeeme yange ne yeewuunya,
Era n'ekutenda.

title: AYI KATONDA BWE NDOWOOZA
text:
Ne bwe nali nkyatondebwa,
Essanyu lyo-eringi 
Walissa mu mwoyo gwange,
Ng'olimpa nze buwa.

title: AYI KATONDA BWE NDOWOOZA
text:
-Omokono gwo gunnywezenga 
Nga bwe nkyali-omuto,
Mpite mu buzibu bwonna,
Ntuuke mu bukulu.

title: AYI KATONDA BWE NDOWOOZA
text:
Obulamu bwange mu nsi 
Leero mbukwasa ggwe,
Era nga mmaze okufa 
Ntuule-eyo mu ggulu.

title: AYI KATONDA BWE NDOWOOZA
text:
Ggwe,Ayi ow'olubeerera,
Bwe ntyo nkuyimbira;
Kuba-ekitiibwa kyo kingi 
Ekitatendeka

title: BAMALAYIKA BAYIMBA
text:
BAMALAYIKA bayimba
Batendereza
Nga bakuba ennanga zaabwe,
Tebawummula;
Eggye lyonna-ery'omu ggulu
Bayimbira Katonda.

title: BAMALAYIKA BAYIMBA
text:
Batendereza Mukama 
Eyo mu ggulu
Abatuukirivu bonna 
Abaawangula 
Eyo bonna banaazibwa 
Bonna batuukirivu.

title: BAMALAYIKA BAYIMBA
text:
Singa-abantu tumwagala 
Eyatutonda 
Tetwandyeyonoonye nebyo 
Ebitagasa
Ka tubirekere ddala 
Anti -ebyo bya Ssetaani!

title: BAMALAYIKA BAYIMBA
text:
Mu bifo-ebyo by'omu ggulu 
Gye tulibeera 
Nga tumutendereza-oyo 
Eyatwagala;
Nga fenna tumuyimbira 
N'essanyu eringi-ennyo.

title: BAMALAYIKA BAYIMBA
EBINTU-EBIRUNGI N'EBINTU-EBIKULU
text:
-EBINTU-ebirungi n'bintu-ebikulu
Eby'amagezi,n'ebituukirivu;
-Ebintu ebinene n'ebintu-ebitono
Byonna byakolerwa ddala Katonda.

title: EBINTU-EBIRUNGI N'EBINTU-EBIKULU
text:
Nate-ebigambo ebiri mu kyama,
Bye tulowooza-era ne bye twogera 
Bwe tubikisa mu mwoyo-abimanyi 
Ebyo-ebikweke,byonna abiraba.

title: EBINTU-EBIRUNGI N'EBINTU-EBIKULU
text:
-Abantu ba wano n'abantu b'ewala,
-Abantu abasiru n'abantu-abagezi;
-Abaana ba Adanu bonna-abalamu,
Bonna bakuumibwa Yesu Mukama.

title: EBINTU-EBIRUNGI N'EBINTU-EBIKULU
text:
-Abantu-abgaga n'abantu abanaku,
-Abantu ba wano n'abava-e Bulaaya;
-Abaana b'abaddu n'abaana b'Abaami
Bonna benkana mu maaso ga Yesu.

title: EBINTU-EBIRUNGI N'EBINTU-EBIKULU
text:
Mu nsi tewali na mwana wa muntu,
Atayagalwa Katonda-Omuyinza;
Bonna abalina-omwoyo-omuwombeefu,
Ogumuwulira,abakkiriza.

title: EBINTU-EBIRUNGI N'EBINTU-EBIKULU
text:
Kale,tweyanze Katonda-ow'ekisa;
Ffe abanaku twakyama twabula:
Tumweyanze,alokolera ddala 
Bonna-abakkiriza Yesu Mukama.

title: EGGULU LIKUSINZA
text:
EGGULU likusinza
Mukama,Mutonzi!
Ebbanga likusuuta
N'ebirimu byonna.
Tebikoowa kutenda
-Emisana n'ekiro
-Amagezi go,n'amaanyi
-Ekitiibwa n'ekisa.

title: EGGULU LIKUSINZA
text:
Enjuba-ey'ekitiibwa,
Etenda-amaanyi go;
Omwezi n'emmunyeenye 
Bisinza-erinnya lyo;
Bibuulira-amawanga 
Agatannalaba,
Bulungi bwa Mukama 
Bibuulira-amawanga
Agatannalaba,
Bulungi bwa Mukama 
Eyatonda byonna.

title: EGGULU LIKUSINZA
text:
Kigambo kya mazima 
Kye watuweereza,
Ktukuvu,kirungi,
Kisanyusa ddala.
-Amateeka ge watuwa 
Malungi,ga kisa;
Gagaggawaza-abaavu,
Galeeta-amagezi.

title: EGGULU LIKUSINZA
text:
Tewali n'omu-ayinza 
Kwekuumira ddala,
N'okutuusa-amateeka,
N'obutayonoona.
Katonda,ombeerenga!
Nneme-okwerabira,
N'okukunakuwaza 
Nga nkyamu bulijjo.

title: EGGULU LIKUSINZA
text:
Eggye er'omu ggulu 
-Ebitonde-eby'omu nsi,
Byonna bitendereza 
Erinnya lyo-eddungi:
Nange Mukama wange 
Ka neeweeyo gy'oli;
Omwoyo n'omubiri,
Okukuweereza.

title: ENKYA BWE NZUUKUKA
ENKYA BWE NZUUKUKA
text:
Ng'amaaso galaba 
Enjuba evuddeyo 
Nnaasuutanga Katonda.

title: ENKYA BWE NZUUKUKA
text:
Ng'engoma-entukuvu
Ez'akawungeezi 
Bwe ziyita-okusaba,
Kyenva njijukira 
Obulungi bwe bwonna 
Ne nsuutanga Katonda.

title: ENKYA BWE NZUUKUKA
text:
Bwe nkola-omulimu 
Ogundagirirwa,
Nnaasuutanga Katonda;
Nga ntoowolokoka,
Nga nzannya-,oba nga ndya,
Nnaasuutanga Katonda.

title: ENKYA BWE NZUUKUKA
text:
Mmwe-abantu b'omu nsi,
Mmwe mwenna, bulijjo 
Musuutenga Katonda 
Bw'asaanidde yekka 
-Okutenderezebwa;
Katonda-Ayinza byonna.

title: ENSI ZOONA,WE ZIFA ZENKANA
text:
ENSI zonna,we zifa zenkana
-Eggulu lyonna,
Bitende Mukama
Bimugulumize.
Atenderezebwe,
-Abantu n'ebitonde,
Ensi zonna,we zifa zenkana,
Zimusuuta.

title: ENSI ZOONA,WE ZIFA ZENKANA
text:
Ensi zonna,we zifa zenkana,
Zimusinze,
Yimbanga Zabbuli,
Yimbisa-amagezi;
Okusinga byonna 
Yimbisa-omutima,
Ensi zonna, we zifa zenkana.
Zisinze-oyo.

title: GGWE KATONDA ATAGGWAAWO
text:
GGWE Katonda-ataggwaawo
Afuga-amawanga
Naffe fenna abantu
Tukugulumize;
Tuyimuse-eddoboozi
Nga twewaayo gy'oli;
Ka tujje gy'oli leero

title: GGWE KATONDA ATAGGWAAWO
text:
Tukoowoola mmwe mwenna 
Ku lunaku luno 
Abakristaayo mwenna 
Mumutendereze.
Tuyimbe nnyo n'essanyu 
Olw'emikisa gyo 
Kale ka tusanyuke,
Ne bwe waba-ennaku.

title: GGWE KATONDA ATAGGWAAWO
text:
Twegatte fenna bumu 
Okukuweereza;
Yesu yatusabira 
Tubeerenga bumu 
Fenna ng'Ekkanisa ye
Ng'abaana-abaagalwa;
Kale twagalanenga 
Nga ye bw'atwagala.

title: GGWE KATONDA ATAGGWAAWO
text:
Tuyimuke tuyimbe 
Tusuute Kitaffe:
Era nga tusanyuka 
N'essanyu lingi nnyo;
Tumuyimbire Yesu 
Eyatulokola.
Ka tubeere n'essuubi
-Okutuuka mu ggulu.

title: GGWE WEKKA-ATAGGWAAWO,OW'AMAGEZI
GGWE WEKKA-ATAGGWAAWO,OW'AMAGEZI
text:
Bulijjo tokoowa,so towummula,
-Obuyinza bwo bwokka bufuga byonna:
Oli wa mazima,tokyukakyuka,
Olw'okwagala kwo tuli ba ddembe.

title: GGWE WEKKA-ATAGGWAAWO,OW'AMAGEZI
GGWE WEKKA-ATAGGWAAWO,OW'AMAGEZI
text:
Kitaffe-ow'ettendo,Omutukuvu
Tuyambe-okulaba ekitiibwa kyo;
Bamalayika bo awamu naffe,
Tusuute, tusinze, tutndereze.

title: KA TUMUSINZE,KATONDA WAFFE
text:
KA tumusinze,Katonda waffe
Tumuyimmbire-eby'okwagala kwe,
Akuuma,ayamba,Mukulu wa dda,
Ekitiibwa kyonna kimwetooloola.

title: KA TUMUSINZE,KATONDA WAFFE
text:
Obuyinza bwe neby'ekisa kye 
Tubibuulire mu nsangi zonna,
Eggulu n'eraddu-era n'omuyaga 
Byonna be baddu be abaweereza.

title: KA TUMUSINZE,KATONDA WAFFE
text:
Wansi w'eggulu,Kabaka waffe,
Waateekebwa dda enkuluze yo 
Y'ensi gye wasimba,n'ogyetoolooza 
Ennyanja zonna nga ensalo zaayo.

title: KA TUMUSINZE,KATONDA WAFFE
text:
Ani ayinza okunnyonnyola 
Eby'Omugabi waffe by'agaba;
Ensozi n'ensenyi,-enkuba n'olume,
Empewo, n'omusana bimusuuta.

title: KA TUMUSINZE,KATONDA WAFFE
text:
Ffe-abaana-abato banafu ddala 
Tukwesiga ggwe atatulimba,
Eby'ekisa kyo bye by'okwewuunyisa,
Ggwe-atonda,ggwe akuuma,ggwe-akwana,Yesu.

title: KA TUMUSINZE,KATONDA WAFFE
text:
Ayi ow'amaayi, ow,okwagala;
Bamalayika bakutenda nnyo 
Emigigi egy'abanunule bo 
Basinza, basuuta,baleeta-eteendo.

title: MUKAMA OMUYINZA WA BYONNA,OMUTONZI
text:
MUKAMA Omuyinza wa byonna,Omutonzi;
Ka mmutenderezenga Omulokozi wange:
Musembere
Abooluganda bonna,
Mujje tusinze n'essanyu.

title: MUKAMA OMUYINZA WA BYONNA,OMUTONZI
text:
Obufuzi bwe butenderezebwenga wonna:
Obw'oyo-akuuma n'ekisa,ayamba-obulungi:
Tolabanga?
Bw'anaakugabiranga,
Omwoyo gwo bye gwegomba.

title: MUKAMA OMUYINZA WA BYONNA,OMUTONZI
text:
Omwoyo gwange gwonna gumutende n'amaanyi
Abantu ne bamalayika bonna basuute:
Tuwulire,
Abantu bwe bayimba 
Ennyimba ez'amatendo.

title: MUMUTENDE YE
text:
MUMUTENDE ye
Mmwe eb'omu bbanga
Ne bakkerubi
-Olw'obutonzi bwe.
Mmwe-eggulu musuute
Eyabatonda;
Mumuvuunamire
Mu bukulu bwe.

title: MUMUTENDE YE
text:
Mumutende ye 
Mmwe ab'oku nsi,
Mukube-ennanga 
Mmwe abalonde be.
Mumutende-olwa byonna 
Eby'ekisa kye;
Musuute-eyabawa 
Okuyimbanga.

title: MUMUTENDE YE
text:
Mumutende ye 
Mmwe ebivuga 
-Eby'engeri zonna 
-Ez'amaloboozi.
Mukube nnyo-ennanga 
Lw'ekitiibwa kye,
Mmwe-ebitaasa mwenna
Mumuwe-ettendo.

title: MUMUTENDE YE
text:
Mumutende ye 
Era mwebaze,
Mu biro byonna 
Mumusuutenga;
Eyatwagala-ennyo 
N'atununula 
Atenderezebwe 
-Emirenbe gyonna

title: OKWOLESEBWA KULUNGI
text:
OKWOLESEBWA kulungi,
Nabbi kwe yalaba-edda;
Maloboozi ga kitalo
Olwo ge yawulira.

title: OKWOLESEBWA KULUNGI
OKWOLESEBWA KULUNGI
text:
Ekitiibwa kyo kinene,
Mu nsi-era ne mu ggulu;
Oweebwe-ekitiibwa kyonna,
Mukama Mutukuvu.

title: OKWOLESEBWA KULUNGI
text:
Mu ggulu bakyamusuuta,
Ne mu nsi ne baddamu 
Nga bayimba:Mutukuvu
Mukama-ow'eggye lyonna.

title: OKWOLESEBWA KULUNGI
text:
Wamu ne Bamalayika,
Wamu n'Ekkanisa ye,
Naffe tumutendereze,
Naffe tumuyimbire.

title: OKWOLESEBWA KULUNGI
text:
Ekitiibwa kyo kinene,
Mu nsi-era ne mu ggulu;
Oweebwe-ekitiibwa kyonna,
Mukama Mutukuvu.

title: TUKWEYANZA KITAFFE
text:
TUKWEYANZA Kitaffe
Ggwe-atukumye-olw'ekisa
Mu budde-obw'emisana,
Ne mu mirimu gyaffe;
Tukuume,Ayi Mutonzi,
Mu nzikiza ya leero.

title: TUKWEYANZA KITAFFE
TUKWEYANZA KITAFFE
text:
Naye-okusinga byonna 
Tweyanza-okwagala kwo,
Olw'Omwana wo Yesu,
Eyafiira ku muti,
Ku lwaffe aboonoonyi;
Tweyanza nnyo Kitaffe!

title: TUMUYIMBIRE MUKAMA
text:
TUMUYIMBIRE Mukama,
Tuyimbe n'essanyu;
Mujje,mujje nno tuyimbe,
Tumuyimbire n'essanyu
Nnyimba ne Zabbuli.

title: TUMUYIMBIRE MUKAMA
text:
Kabaka waffe Mukama
Ye Katonda yekka;
Entikko z'ensonzi zize,
N'ennyanja ye yagikola,
Mulokozi waffe.

title: TUMUYIMBIRE MUKAMA
text:
Ffe fenna tuli zzadde lye,
Omutonzi waffe;
Mujje, mujje nno tuyimbe,
Tumuyimbire Katonda 
-Omulokozi waffe

title: WEEBAZE GGWE EMMEEME YANGE
WEEBAZE GGWE EMMEEME YANGE
text:
Weebaze-ekisa kye kingi 
Eri bajjajja-ab'edda.
-Olw'ekisa kye-ekitakoma,
Eyaliwo edda n'edda.
Aleruuya,Aleruuya!
Weebaze Katonda wo.

title: WEEBAZE GGWE EMMEEME YANGE
text:
Ye Kitaffe,atukuuma,
Atuliisa bulijjo
Amanyi-obunafu bwaffe,
Amanyi-obunafu bwaffe,
Atuwonya mu kabi.
Aleruuya,Aleruuya!
Weebaze Katonda wo.

title: WEEBAZE GGWE EMMEEME YANGE
text:
Bamalayika be bonna 
Bayimba ettendo lye,
Oyanguwe-ojje n'ebire

title: WEEBAZE GGWE EMMEEME YANGE
text:
Olye-obwakabaka bwo.
Aleruuya,Aleruuya!
Weebaze Katonda wo.

title: ALERUUYA! MUMWEBAZE
text:
ALERUUYA! mumwebaze
Yesu,Mukama waffe,
Aleruuya! Ye Kabaka,
Ye Muwanguzi yekka.
Bangi nnyo abaatusooka
Okuyita mu kufa,
Bagulumiza Mukama
Atununudde fenna.

title: ALERUUYA! MUMWEBAZE
text:
Aleruuya! Ye Kitaffe 
Tetuli bamulekwa 
Bulijjo abeera naffe 
Fenna-abamukkiriza.
Bwe yatwalibwa mu ggulu 
N'ekitiibwa mu kire,
Yatusuubiriza ddala 
Okubeeranga naffe.

title: ALERUUYA! MUMWEBAZE
text:
Atusembeza-atuyita,
Okusseekimu naye,
Atuliisa ffe-abanafu 
Emmere-ey'omu ggulu
Alyoke atuwe-amaanyi 
Aganaamalangawo 
Enkwe zonna-ez'omulabe,
N'okukemebwa kwonna.

title: ALERUUYA! MUMWEBAZE
text:
Ka tutendereze Yesu 
Eyajja mu nsi yaffe,
Eyayambala-omubiri 
Ne yeetwalira-obuntu.
Ye Muwolereza waffe;
Ye Mununuzi yekka,
Ye Musuutwa, ye Mukama,
Ye Kabaka-ataggwaawo.

title: ESSANYU-ERINGI-ERITAKOMEZEKA
text:
ESSANYU-eringi-eritakomezeka,
Era n'emirembe-egitabuulikika,
Byombi birirabika-eyo mu ggulu
Byateekerwawo abatukuvu bonna.

title: ESSANYU-ERINGI-ERITAKOMEZEKA
text:
Mu bwakabaka bwonna-obw'ensi yonna 
Teri kitiibwa-ekirifaanana ng'ekyo,
Katonda gy'ali eyatulokola ffe 
Abatasaanira bulokozi obwo.

title: ESSANYU-ERINGI-ERITAKOMEZEKA
text:
Abatuuka eyo singa bayinza 
Okutegeeza-essanyu lyabwe bwe liri 
Twandiyanguye-okusseekimu nabo,
Tetwandyesiimye na bigambo by'omu nsi

title: ESSANYU-ERINGI-ERITAKOMEZEKA
text:
Yesu-Omugabe w'eggye lya Katonda,
Otusaanyize okuyitibwa kwaffe,
Otutuukirize,otuwe amaanyi,
Ffe-abakweyabiza ggwe Mukama waffe.

title: YESU,TOTEGEEREKEKA
text:
YESU,totegeerekeka,
Ogulumizibwa,
Ekitiibwa ky'amaaso go,
Kibuna-ensi zonna.

title: YESU,TOTEGEEREKEKA
text:
Katonda-ow'olubeerera,
-Ow'obuntu bwaffe-era,
Bonna bakutendereza,
-Emisana n'ekiro.

title: YESU,TOTEGEEREKEKA
text:
Okukulaba n'amaaso,
Kusinga-eby'omu nsi,
-Amagezi go n'ekisa kyo,
Tebikomezrka.

title: YESU,TOTEGEEREKEKA
text:
Katonda wange nga nkutya 
Nga neewombeese nnyo:
Era nkusinza n'omwoyo,
Nga neetereereka.

title: YESU,TOTEGEEREKEKA
text:
Amaanyi go n'ekisa kyo,
Byombi bya tttendo nnyo:
Naye weefeebya-okunsaba 
Okwagalanga ggwe.

title: YESU,TOTEGEEREKEKA
text:
Tewali akufaanana,
-Okuzibiikiriza,
-Obukyamu bwange n'obubi,
Ogumiikiriza.

title: YESU,TOTEGEEREKEKA
text:
Bw'olidda ggwe mu nsi muno 
-Okusinzibwa bonna 
Naakwebzanga-ekisa kyo 
Emirembe gyonna.

title: EWALA MU GGULU
text:
EWALA mu ggulu
Bamalayika be
Bayimba n'essanyu
Nga batendereza-
Aleruuya!
Basanyuka okuyimba
Aleruuya!

title: EWALA MU GGULU
text:
Era mu nsi muno 
Katonda-akkiriza 
Ennyimba z'abato 
Bonna-abamwagala.
Aleruuya!
Naffe ka tumuyimbire,
Aleruuya!

title: EWALA MU GGULU
text:
Yesu Mulokozi,
Tukwegayiridde 
Otuyingirize 
Amazima gonna.
Aleruuya!
Tulyoke tukuyimbire,
Aleruuya!

title: EWALA MU GGULU
text:
Ayi Yesu Mukama,
Bunya-ekigambo kyo;
Buli ggwanga-ery'ensi
Likyukire gy'oli.
Aleruuya!
-Ebika byonna biriyimba,
Aleruuya!

title: MUJJE MWEBAZE MUKAMA
text:
MUJJE mwebaze Mukama,
Mwenna be yalokola;
Mwolese-ekitiibwa ky'oyo
Eyatonda ffe fenna.
Okuva-edda n'edda lyonna
Ye yabeerera yekka.

title: MUJJE MWEBAZE MUKAMA
text:
Ennyanja nga tennabaawo 
Newankubadde ensi,
Yesu Mwana wa Katonda 
Ye yakkiriza-okufa,
Alyoke-atununule ffe 
Mu bibi byaffe byonna.

title: MUJJE MWEBAZE MUKAMA
text:
Kaakano eyo mu ggulu 
Atulongoosereza 
Ebifo-eby'okubeeramu 
Buliio mu maaso ge.
Mu nsi tulina ennaku,
Eri ssanyu jjereere.

title: MUJJE MWEBAZE MUKAMA
text:
Bonna bamutendereza 
Mu ggulu-era-ne mu nsi,
Bamalayika n'abantu 
Bamugulumiza nnyo.
Katonda wa bakatonda 
Kkiriza-ettendo lyaffe.

title: MUKAMA WAFFE-OW'OBULAMU!
text:
MUKAMA waffe-ow'obulamu!
Kigambo kya Katonda ggwe!
Kabaka Yesu Mukama!
Ensi n'eggulu bisuuta,
Biyimbira waggulu nti Ozaana!

title: MUKAMA WAFFE-OW'OBULAMU!
text:
Eggye lyonna-ery'omu ggulu
-Abatukuvu ab'omu nsi,
Abaatusooka-okwebaka,
Naffe-abakyaliwo leero,
Ffe tukutendereza nti Ozaana!

title: MUKAMA WAFFE-OW'OBULAMU!
text:
Mulokozi ggwe-atukuuma 
Beera naffe nga tusinza,
Nga bwe wasuubiza-ababo 
Nga tonnalinya mu ggulu:
-Otubeere nga tusinza nti Ozaana!

title: MUKAMA WAFFE-OW'OBULAMU!
text:
Omwoyo wo-Omutukuvu 
Abeere mu myoyo gyaffe,
Gifaanane ga yeekaalu 
Esaanidde-ekitiibwa kyo,
Mwe tunaasinzizanga nti Ozaana!

title: MUKAMA WAFFE-OW'OBULAMU!
text:
Bwe tutyo bwe tulituuka 
N'essanyu lingi mu ggulu,
Ffe-endiga ze watukuza 
Ng'omaze okutugula,
Ne tulyoka twebaza nti Ozaana!

title: MU MAASO GA YESU ABALOKOLE
text:
MU maaso ga Yesu abalokole,
-Ekibiina-ekinene,bayimiridde;
Bayimba nti Eyatunaaza yekka
-Aweebwe ekitiibwa ennaku zonna.

title: MU MAASO GA YESU ABALOKOLE
text:
Kiki-ekyabanaaza-abalina-ebibi?
Yesu yatunaaza n'omusaayi bw'ati;
Tuyimba nti Eyatunaaza yekka,
Aweebwe-ekitiibwa ennaku nzonna.

title: MU MAASO GA YESU ABALOKOLE
MU MAASO GA YESU ABALOKOLE
text:
Bo baali bajeemu,naye kaakano 
Be baddu ba Yesu-abamuweeereza 
Bayimba nti Eyatunaaza yekka 
Aweebwe-ekitiibwa ennaku zonna

title: MU MAASO GA YESU ABALOKOLE
MU MAASO GA YESU ABALOKOLE
text:
Bannange, n'essanyu tumuyimbire,
-Abalala balyoke bayimbe nabo,
Ggwe Yesu wekka eyatutukuza,
Oweebwe-ekitiibwa ennaku zonna.

title: YESU YE YAVA MU GGULU
text:
YESU ye yava mu ggulu,
N'akka-okufiirira-abantu;
Era-ekitabp kyogera
Bw'asaasira ffe-aboonoonyi.

title: YESU YE YAVA MU GGULU
text:
Yatambulanga bulijjo,
N'avumulanga-abalwala;
Yalongoosanga bangi nnyo,
N'azuukizanga abafu.

title: YESU YE YAVA MU GGULU
text:
Yabuuliranga bulinjo 
Enjiri-ey'obulokozi;
Era kubanga wa kisa,
N'asembezanga abaana.

title: YESU YE YAVA MU GGULU
text:
Naye oyo-eyakolanga 
-Obulungi bwonna-obw'ekisa
Yabonyaabonyezebwa nnyo,
N'awanikibwa ku muti.

title: YESU YE YAVA MU GGULU
text:
Bw'atyo bwe yafa, yafuuka 
Omuntu n'atufiirira:
Ffe tulyoke tusonyiyibwe 
Ebyonoono byaffe byonna.

title: LABA OMWANA-OMUTO
text:
LABA Omwana-omuto
Yazaalibwa mu nsi
Mu nnyumba enjavu-ennyo,
Ente nga weeziri.
Naye Omwana-oyo y'ani?
Ye Yesu eyatonda-ensi.

title: LABA OMWANA-OMUTO
text:
Ekyo kitalo nnyo!
Katonda Omwana 
-Okujja mu nsi muno 
N'obuwombeefu-atyo;
Fenna tuyigire ku ye,
Okwewombeeka-obulungi.

title: LABA OMWANA-OMUTO
text:
Era bwe yakula,
N'afuuka-omubazzi 
N'akola n'engalo,
Eyatonda ensi.
Emirirmu n'obwesiggwa,
Biweebwenga-omukisa gwe.

title: LABA OMWANA-OMUTO
text:
Ggwe Yesu eyajja 
-Omulenzi ow'essanyu 
-Otumulise fenna 
-Omusana ogw'obulamu 
Okwagala kwo okungi 
Kwe kutuwalula gy'oli.

title: GGWE-EYALEKA EKITIIBWA KYO
text:
GGWE-eyaleka ekitiibwa kyo
N'ojja-okunfiirira
So ne mu kyalo Beesirekemu
Temwali nnyumba yo;
Wasulanga mu malungu
Ggwe Katonda-eyatonda-ensi!

title: GGWE-EYALEKA EKITIIBWA KYO
text:
Ebisolo era n'ennyonyi
Byo byalina-ennyumba,
Naye ggwe Omwana wa Katonda 
Tewalina kifo;
Mu ddungu ly'e Ggaliraaya 
Mmwe wasiiba, mwe wasula!

title: GGWE-EYALEKA EKITIIBWA KYO
GGWE-EYALEKA EKITIIBWA KYO
text:
-Olunaku lwo bwe lulituuka 
Olw'okudda mu nsi,
Eddoboozi lyo bwe lirimpita 
Okuntwala-ewuwo,
Ndibeera n'essanyu lingi 
Okukulaba n'amaaso

title: TETWAKULABA BWE WAJJA
TETWAKULABA BWE WAJJA
TETWAKULABA BWE WAJJA
text:
Tetwayimirira n'abo 
Abaakunoonya mu ntaana,
Oba nabo be wasanga 
Mu kkubo nga batambula;
Naye bwe tubiwulira 
Tweyanza-era tusanyuka.

title: TETWAKULABA BWE WAJJA
TETWAKULABA BWE WAJJA
MUJAGUZE NNO!
text:
MUJAGUZE nno!
Mmwe-abantu mwenna
Yesu Mulokozi ye yajja gye tuli

title: MUJAGUZE NNO!
text:
Mumutende, mumutende oyo eyattibwa 
Mumutende,mumutende,eyazuukira.

title: MUJAGUZE NNO!
text:
Mujaguze nno!
Omusana gwaka,
Ebiro byayita eby'obutamanya.

title: MUJAGUZE NNO!
text:
Mumutende, mumutende oyo eyattibwa 
Mumutende,mumutende,eyazuukira.

title: MUJAGUZE NNO!
text:
Mujaguze nno! 
Omusaayi-gwayika,
Ogwa Yesu Mukama-ogunaaza-ebibi.

title: MUJAGUZE NNO!
text:
Mumutende, mumutende oyo eyattibwa 
Mumutende,mumutende,eyazuukira.

title: MUJAGUZE NNO!
text:
Mujaguze nno!
Atusonyiwa-era,
Omutuukirivu yatufiirira ffe.

title: MUJAGUZE NNO!
text:
Mumutende, mumutende oyo eyattibwa 
Mumutende,mumutende,eyazuukira.

title: MUJAGUZE NNO!
text:
Mujaguze nno! 
Okufa kufudde,
Yesu ye yakuwangulua n'azuukira.

title: MUJAGUZE NNO!
text:
Mumutende, mumutende oyo eyattibwa 
Mumutende,mumutende,eyazuukira.

title: MUJAGUZE NNO!
text:
Mujaguze nno!
Yesu atufuga,
Atufuga fenna-era-atuwolereza.

title: MUJAGUZE NNO!
text:
Mumutende, mumutende oyo eyattibwa 
Mumutende,mumutende,eyazuukira.

title: MUJAGUZE NNO!
text:
Mujaguze nno!
Ajja kudda nate,
Ajja kudda nate n'ekitiibwa Yesu.

title: MUJAGUZE NNO!
text:
Mumutende, mumutende oyo eyattibwa 
Mumutende,mumutende,eyazuukira.

title: ERINNYA LYA YESU DDUNGI
text:
ERINNYA lya Yesu ddungi
Eri akkiriza;
Lisangula-amaziga ge,
Limalamu-okutya.

title: ERINNYA LYA YESU DDUNGI
text:
Litereeza n'omwoyo gwe 
Linyiga-ebiwundu;
Ye mmere y'omuyala-,era 
Liwumuza-akooye.

title: ERINNYA LYA YESU DDUNGI
text:
Erinnya gganzi, lwe lwazi 
Kwe nzimba-enju yange 
Lye ggwanika-eritaggwaamu 
Emirembe gyonna.

title: ERINNYA LYA YESU DDUNGI
text:
Musumba wange,nkwebaza,
Mulokozi wange;
Bulamu bwange,nkwebaza,
Era-ekkubo lyange.

title: ERINNYA LYA YESU DDUNGI
text:
Okufuba kwange kwonna 
Tekuliimu maanyi;
Naye bwe ndikulabako,
Ndikutendereza.

title: ERINNYA LYA YESU DDUNGI
text:
Onteegeezenga bulijjo,
Ekisa kyo-ekingi 
Erinnya lyo linsanyuse 
Mu ntuuko-ez'okufa

title: TULINA-OMUBEEZI WAFFE
text:
TULINA-Omubeezi waffe
Nga-atwagala!
Akira baganda baffe
Nga-atwagala!
Emikwano gyaffe ku nsi
Batutamwa,batuvaako:
Naye oyo tatukuusa,
Nga-atwagala!

title: TULINA-OMUBEEZI WAFFE
text:
Buno bwe balamu bwaffe 
Nga-atwagala!
Yesu okumumanyanga 
Nga-atwagala!
Yatunoonya mu likoola 
N'atununula n'omu-wendo
N'atuleeta mu kisibo;
Nga-atwagala!

title: TULINA-OMUBEEZI WAFFE
text:
Kiki-ekimusanyusa-era,
Nga-atwagala!
Kwe kutuwa ffe-omukisa 
Nga-atwagal!
Ka tugume-emyoyo gyaffe 
Ka tutambule n'essanyu 
Alitutuusa ewuwe,
Nga-atwagala!

title: TULINA-OMUBEEZI WAFFE
text:
Ku lw'erinnya lye-ery'amaanyi
Nga-atwagala!
Tuliwangula-abalabe 
Nga-atwagala! 
Kale nno tweyongeremga 
Okuyimba nti Asinze 
Asinze Mukama waffe;
Nga-atwagala!

title: YESU,GGWE-EYANJAGALA
text:
YESU,ggwe-eyanjagala
Ka nzirukire gy'oli,
Amayengo-ag'ennaku
Nga gankubira ddala;
Nkweka mu mikono gyo
Abannumba ba maanyi,
Sirina magezi nze,
Kkiriza-omwoyo gwange.

title: YESU,GGWE-EYANJAGALA
text:
Tewali kiddukiro 
Wabula mu mwoyoy gwo;
Tondeka nga nteetera 
Nnaatera kugwa bugwi.
Essanyu lyange lyonna 
Ndiggya mu kubeerwa kwo,
-Onsenseze-omutwe gwange 
Wansi w'emikono gyo.

title: YESU,GGWE-EYANJAGALA
text:
Ggwe wekka gwe neetaaga,
Tewali akwenkana;
Agudde-omuyimuse,
Vumula azirise;
Omulwadde-omuwonnye,
Zibula-eyazibwa 
Nze njijudde ekibi,
Ggwe-oli Butuukirivu.

title: YESU,GGWE-EYANJAGALA
text:
Gye ndi yaza-ekisa kyo 
Sangula-ebibi byange,
Nnina-ennyota-,ondeetere,
Amazzi agamponya-ennyo;
Ggwe-oli nsulo z'obulamu 
Ka nsene omwo mwokka,
-Omwoyo gwange gujjule 
Amazzi-ag'obulamu.

title: YESU ALIFUGA WONNA
text:
YESU alifuga wonna,
Wonna-omusana we gwaka;
-Obwakabaka bwe bulibuna
-Okutuusa ennaku zonna.

title: YESU ALIFUGA WONNA
text:
Abantu b'ennimi zonna 
Batendenga-okwagala kwe;
Abaana banaabuuliranga,
Obulungi bw'erinnya lye.

title: YESU ALIFUGA WONNA
text:
Omukisa gwebwe guli 
-Abasibe bafuna-eddembe;
-Abakooye banaawummulanga,
Abeetaaga ne bakkuta.

title: YESU ALIFUGA WONNA
text:
Buli muntu-ayimirire 
Atende nnyo Kabaka we,
Bamalayika ne bayimba,
Ensi n'eddamu Amiina.

title: NEEGOMBA NNYO-OKUWULIRA
text:
NEEGOMBA nnyo-okuwulira
Ku linnya lya Yesu;
Tewali na limu ku nsi
Eririfaanana.

title: NEEGOMBA NNYO-OKUWULIRA
text:
Lintegeeza-Omulokozi 
Bwe yafa ku lwange,
Era-okufa kwe-okw'ensonyi 
Kwanfuula-ow'eddembe.

title: NEEGOMBA NNYO-OKUWULIRA
text:
Erinnya-eryo linsanyusa 
Mu biro-eby'ennaku;
Era bwe mba nga nkooye nnyo 
Linzizaamu-amaanyi.

title: NEEGOMBA NNYO-OKUWULIRA
text:
Ka nnyimbenga nnyo n'essanyu:
Awamu n'essubi;
Kubanga Yesu yamgamba,
Nti nkomawo mangu.

title: MUKAMA WAFFE MULOKOZI!
text:
MUKAMA waffe Mulokozi!
Ggwe owummuza bonna-abakooye
Ggwe osanyusa-abalina-ennaku
Ggwe-asaasira-abali mu kabi.

title: MUKAMA WAFFE MULOKOZI!
text:
Ggwe-osaasira anatera okufa 
Yesu wekka, ggwe kkubo lyaffe,
Empeera yaffe eva gyoli,
Mukama waffe Mulokozi!

title: MUKAMA WAFFE MULOKOZI!
text:
Bwe nnaabanga njagala-okugwa 
Nnaakuyitanga-ombeere Yesu,
Ne bwe ndikyama tolindeka;
Mukama waffe Mulokozi!

title: MUKAMA WAFFE MULOKOZI!
text:
Nkwatudde Yesu -Omulokozi,
Siirekenga kukweyanza nnyo;
Ggwe-osaatiidde ettendo lyonna 
Mukama waffe Mulokozi!

title: OMUSUMBA WANGE MUKAMA
text:
-OMUSUMBA wange Mukama,
-Obulungi bwe tebuggwawo-
Seetaagenga nga ndi wuwe,
Naye nga wange bulijjo.

title: OMUSUMBA WANGE MUKAMA
text:
Antwala ye ku mabbali 
Ag'amazzi-amateefu;
Mu ddundiro eddungi-ennyo 
Eyo gy'anaadiisizaanga.

title: OMUSUMBA WANGE MUKAMA
text:
Edda nali nga mpabye nnyo,
N'annoonya lwa kisa kye,
N'anteeka mu mikono gye,
N'antwala-ewuwe n'essanyu.

title: OMUSUMBA WANGE MUKAMA
text:
Mu kiwonvu eky'okufa 
Siritya-akabi konna;
Omuggo gwe n'oluga lwe,
Ebyo bye birinsanyusa.

title: OMUSUMBA WANGE MUKAMA
text:
Ansembeza ku mmeeza ye,
Ne nnywa ku kikompe kye;
Era-ansiga-amafuta ge,
N'ampa-emikisa gye gyonna.

title: OMUSUMBA WANGE MUKAMA
text:
Bwe butyo obulungi bwo,
Mukama tebuliggwaawo;
Nnakwebazanga bulijjo,
Ggwe oli-omusumba

title: OKWAGALA OKUTAGGWAAWO
text:
OKWAGALA-okutaggwaawo
Okw'olubeerera,
Kukulukuta n'amaanyi,
Ge mazzi agataggwaawo-.

title: OKWAGALA OKUTAGGWAAWO
text:
Ffe tetuyinza kulinnya,
Mukama Kristo-akke:
Ye abeera wonna-wonna,
Tewali w'abula.

title: OKWAGALA OKUTAGGWAAWO
text:
Naye ye Mubeezi waffe 
-Atubeera bulijjo;
Alabwa mu kizikiza 
Ne mu kwagala-era.

title: OKWAGALA OKUTAGGWAAWO
text:
Ebyambalo bye byawonya,
Endwadde z'abantu;
tumweyune bwe tulumwa,
Tuwonere ddala.

title: OKWAGALA OKUTAGGWAAWO
text:
-Okwagala-okutagambika,
-Erinnya lyo liwonya,
Okukugaana kwe kufa,
Ggwe-olina obulamu-

title: OMUZIRA WAFFE,OMWANA W'OMUNTU
text:
OMUZIRA waffe,Omwana w'omuntu
Abazira bonna ab'ensi babo:
Twewaayo gy'oli nga ssaddaaka ennamu,
Gwe oli wamu naffe mu byonna.

title: OMUZIRA WAFFE,OMWANA W'OMUNTU
text:
Wakwatanga ekkubo eryalagirwa,
-Ebigambo byo bya mazima ddala,
-Obulungi bw'ebimuli bwakusanyusa,
Omwoyo gw'abato wagutegeeranga.

title: OMUZIRA WAFFE,OMWANA W'OMUNTU
OMUZIRA WAFFE,OMWANA W'OMUNTU
text:
Tweyunenga ggwe mu nnaku zaffe zonna,
Era n'essanyu litwagaze ggwe,
Oba mugagga,Sseekimu mu ssanyu lye,
Omwavu,agume ku lw'omukwano gwo.

title: YESU, GGWE-OLI SSANYU LYAFFE
text:
YESU,ggwe-oli ssanyu lyaffe,
Ggwe-oli musana gw'obulamu;
Twaleka-eby'omu nsi muno,
Ne tusanyukira mu ggwe.

title: YESU, GGWE-OLI SSANYU LYAFFE
text:
-Amazima go gabeerera,
Olokola-abakwesiga,
Abakunoonya beesiima,
Abakulaba bakkuta.

title: YESU, GGWE-OLI SSANYU LYAFFE
text:
Tulya ku mmere y'obulamu-,
Twettanira-okuliisibwa;
Tunywa ne ku musaayi gwo,
Gutuwonya-ennyonta yaffe.

title: YESU, GGWE-OLI SSANYU LYAFFE
text:
Wonna tukyukira gyoli,
Ggwe-oli Kiwummulo kyaffe;
Bw'otusiima,tusanyuka,
Bw'obeera naffe tulama

title: YESU, GGWE-OLI SSANYU LYAFFE
text:
Jangu-otubeesebeese ffe,
Tuleme-okubulubuuta,
Goba-ekizikiza-eky'ensi 
Otwakize amaaso go.

title: YESU,SSANYU LYANGE
text:
YESU,ssanyu lyange
Ddundiro ly'omwoyo
Ka nkusinze ggwe!
Ennaku z'omwoyo
Ze zimpaliriza
Ndi wuwo naawe wange,
Nkwagala-okusinga bonna
Ggwe Mukama wange!

title: YESU,SSANYU LYANGE
text:
Olw'okukuuma kwo 
Abalabe bange 
Banafu gyendi;
Ssetaani bw'annumba,
Nsaba-ompe amaanyi,
Tombeera wala!
Neetoolooleddwa-obubi 
N'okufa kwa ntiisa, naye 
Yesu ggwe onkuuma.

title: YESU,SSANYU LYANGE
text:
Ka tugonze-emyoyo,
Ka tumuwe-ekifo 
Omusanyusa.
Yesu k'atufuge,
Tumuwulirenga,
Tujjule-essanyu 
Mu buyinike bwonna:
Atuwenga-essanyu lino,
Okubeera naffe.

title: OLWAZI LW'EDDA N'EDDA GWE
text:
-OLWAZI lw'edda n'edda gwe,
Olwanjatikira nze;
Omwo mwe neekweka-,era
Omusaayi gwe mwe gwava.
Ebibi binzigyeko,
Mponya mu maanyi gaabyo.

title: OLWAZI LW'EDDA N'EDDA GWE
OLWAZI LW'EDDA N'EDDA GWE
OLWAZI LW'EDDA N'EDDA GWE
text:
Nze nga nkyali mulamu,
Bwe ndituuka mu ggulu;
Bwe nidiraba ggwe,Yesu,
Emisango ng'osala,
Yesu-olwasi olwase,
Ka neekwekenga mu ggwe.

title: YESU MULOKOZI WANGE
text:
YESU Mulokozi wange
Leero nze wuwo wekka;
Omusaayi gwo gunnaazizza,
Yesu Mwana gw'endiga

title: YESU MULOKOZI WANGE
text:
Tukutendereza,Yesu:
Yesu Mwana gw'endiga;
Omusaayi gwo gunnaazizza,
Nkwebaza,Mulokozi.

title: YESU MULOKOZI WANGE
text:
Edda nafyba bufubi 
Okufuna-emirembe;
Leero mmaliridde ddala,
Okweyabiza Yesu.

title: YESU MULOKOZI WANGE
text:
Tukutendereza,Yesu:
Yesu Mwana gw'endiga;
Omusaayi gwo gunnaazizza,
Nkwebaza,Mulokozi.

title: YESU MULOKOZI WANGE
text:
Nnaababuuliranga-abantu 
Obulokozi bwonna,
Obutali bwa kitundu 
Obulamba-ob'obuwa.

title: YESU MULOKOZI WANGE
text:
Tukutendereza,Yesu:
Yesu Mwana gw'endiga;
Omusaayi gwo gunnaazizza,
Nkwebaza,Mulokozi.

title: YESU MULOKOZI WANGE
text:
Nnaategeezanga-ebya Yesu 
N'obuvuumu ne sitya;
Eyanzigya mu busibe 
N'okuwonya-eyamponya.

title: YESU MULOKOZI WANGE
text:
Tukutendereza,Yesu:
Yesu Mwana gw'endiga;
Omusaayi gwo gunnaazizza,
Nkwebaza,Mulokozi.

title: YESU MULOKOZI WANGE
text:
Neebaza-eyannunula nze;
Eyamponya wa kisa! 
Yesu-ankuuma ansanyusa-era,
Bulijjo yeebazibwe.

title: YESU MULOKOZI WANGE
text:
Tukutendereza,Yesu:
Yesu Mwana gw'endiga;
Omusaayi gwo gunnaazizza,
Nkwebaza,Mulokozi.

title: NNAATEEKANGA KU YESU OMWANA GW'ENDIGA
text:
NNAATEEKANGA ku Yesu Omwana gw'endiga,
Ebibi byange byonna ebitasinika;
Agwetisse ye yekka omugugu gwange:
Ka ntambule n'essanyu,kubanga-agwetisse,

title: NNAATEEKANGA KU YESU OMWANA GW'ENDIGA
text:
Yatwala ennaku zange n'ebibi bingi nnyo,
Yatwala-,Omulokozi,endwadde z'omyoyo:
Ne nfuna n'emirembe mu linnya lya Yesu;
Ayagala nga Yesu,Mukama aluwa?

title: NNAATEEKANGA KU YESU OMWANA GW'ENDIGA
text:
Yesu Mukama wange,Yesu Mulokozi;
Erinnya lyo lisinga gonna ag'omu nsi.
Erinnya lyo liwooma,lireeta-essanyu nnyo:
Tewali alokoka-,awatali linnya aluwa?

title: NNAATEEKANGA KU YESU OMWANA GW'ENDIGA
text:
Nze njagala-okubeera n'omwoyo-omuwombeefu;
-Okufaanana nga Yesu omutuuukirivu:
Nze njagala-okutuula mu ggulu ne Yesu,
-Okuyiga-ennyimba-ennungi-eza bamalayika

title: ENNAKU BWE ZIFUMITA
text:
ENNAKU bwe zifumita
Omwoyo gw'omuntu
Omu,eyafumitibwa
Ye-anyita ekiwundu.

title: ENNAKU BWE ZIFUMITA
text:
Omwoyo bwe gunyolwa-ennyo,
-Amaziga ne gajja,
Ayinza-omu,eyanyolwa,
Okugusanyusa.

title: ENNAKU BWE ZIFUMITA
text:
-Ebibi bwe tubijjukira 
Ebitanaazika;
Omugga gumu-,ogw'omusaayi,
Guyinza-okunaaza.

title: ENNAKU BWE ZIFUMITA
text:
Ogwa Yesu gwe gunaaza 
Gunaaliza ddala;
Era y'ayinza-okunyiga 
N'okutusanyusa.

title: ENNAKU BWE ZIFUMITA
text:
Kale,otusanyusa Yesu 
-Otunyige-ebiwundu 
-Otunaaze n'omusaayi gwo 
Ogunaaza gwokka.

title: YESU EYAKUBIBWA-EDDA
text:
YESU eyakubibwa-edda,
-Era eyafa ku lwaffe;
Laba-amaanyi n'ekitiibwa 
Leero bwe bifaananye.

title: YESU EYAKUBIBWA-EDDA
text:
Ggwe mukulu,ggwe Kabaka,
Eyafiirira fenna.

title: YESU EYAKUBIBWA-EDDA
text:
Mulabe Yesu bw'ajja ng'ayambadde-
Ekitiibwa kye;
Ye ng'amaze okusinga 
Abalabe be bonna.

title: YESU EYAKUBIBWA-EDDA
text:
Ggwe mukulu,ggwe Kabaka,
Eyafiirira fenna.

title: YESU EYAKUBIBWA-EDDA
text:
Eyalaba-ennaku-ennyingi,
Edda eyakaaba-ennyo;
Mulabe n'essanyu lingi 
Bw'amasamasa leero.

title: YESU EYAKUBIBWA-EDDA
text:
Ggwe mukulu,ggwe Kabaka,
Eyafiirira fenna.

title: YESU EYAKUBIBWA-EDDA
text:
Kabaka wa bakabaka,
Alifuga-ensi zonna;
Abantu bonna-ab'oku nsi 
Balimuvuunamira.

title: YESU EYAKUBIBWA-EDDA
text:
Ggwe mukulu,ggwe Kabaka,
Eyafiirira fenna.

title: YESU EYAKUBIBWA-EDDA
text:
Kale bulijjo enjiri,
Bonna tubabuulire;
Ayanguwe-ajje n'ebire,
Alye-obwakabaka bwe.

title: YESU EYAKUBIBWA-EDDA
text:
Ggwe mukulu,ggwe Kabaka,
Eyafiirira fenna.

title: GGWE EYATONDA OLW'A OKWAGALA KWO
GGWE EYATONDA OLW'A OKWAGALA KWO
GGWE EYATONDA OLW'A OKWAGALA KWO
text:
Ggwe-eyakkiriza,nga weewombeese,
Okunkwanira ddala-obutandeka,
Ggwe-alina wekka-obuyinza bwonna,
Okuumire ddala-omunafu wo.
Ggw(e) ayitiibwa wekka nti kwagala;
Leka neeweeyo mbeeren(ga) owuwo.

title: GGWE EYATONDA OLW'A OKWAGALA KWO
YESU,MWANA W'OMUNTU!
text:
YESU,Mwana w'omuntu!
Ggwe-,eyajja mu nsi muno
N'ofuuka-omwana-omuto,
Ku lw'okwagala-okungi.
Kka,-Omulokozi wange!
Tuula mu mwoyo gwange.

title: YESU,MWANA W'OMUNTU!
text:
Yesu,Omwana gw'endiga! 
Ggwe-eyagumiikiriza,
-Ennaku ezitalabwa 
N'obulumi n'okufa.
Kka,-Omulokozi wange!
Tuula mu mwoyo gwange.

title: YESU,MWANA W'OMUNTU!
text:
Ggwe Mukama w'obulamu!
Ggwe-eyawangula-okufa,
Ggwe-eyalinnya muggulu 
-Olw'obuyinza bwo bwokka,
Kka,-Omulokozi wange!
Tuula mu mwoyo gwange.

title: YESU,MWANA W'OMUNTU!
text:
Katonda-era Omuntu!
Ggwe Mukama-ow'eggulu 
Tukuza-omwoyo gwange,
-Olw'ekisa-onjigirize.
Ndyoke mpeebwe-omukisa 
Ntuule naawe mu ggulu.

title: YESU,-OBUYINIKE BWAFFE
text:
YESU,-obuyinike bwaffe
Wabwetikka wekka,
N'ositula-ennaku zaffe,
Ezitukooyesa.
Ffe-abatasaanidde n'akamu-
Bye watukolera.

title: YESU,-OBUYINIKE BWAFFE
text:
Okufa n'ekikolimo 
Ebyanditusse ffe,
Wawangula-amaayi gaabyo,
N'obibetenta-era,
Kaakano tuli ba ddembe,
Abandisibiddwa.

title: YESU,-OBUYINIKE BWAFFE
text:
-Embuyaga n'empewo-ennyingi 
Byakuntira ku ggwe,
Katonda ye yakuba ggwe,
Alyoke-ansaasire.
Kaakano tweggama mu ggwe,
Ng'otusiikiriza.

title: YESU,-OBUYINIKE BWAFFE
text:
Fenna twawaba ng'endiga 
Ezisaasaanye-ennyo,
Katonda n'akuteekako 
Omusango gwaffe.
Wawaayo obulamu bwo 
Olw'ebibi byaffe.

title: YESU OMULOKOZI
text:
YESU Omulokozi
Yanfiirira ku muti,
N'anzigyako ebibi:
Yesu Mulokozi wange!

title: YESU OMULOKOZI
text:
Gunsinze,so sirina:
Butuukirivu bwonna:
Naye ggwe wanfiirira: 
Yesu Mulokozi wange!

title: YESU OMULOKOZI
text:
Obutukuvu bwange,
Bwonna nziina njereere;
Kyennaavanga nkweisga,
Yesu Mulokozi wange!

title: YESU OMULOKOZI
text:
Ebibi byansonyiyibwa,
N'ebbanja lyange lyaggwa;
Lwe nakukkiriza ggwe:
Yesu Mulokozi wange!

title: YESU OMULOKOZI
text:
Ombeerenga bulijjo,
Ntabule mu kkubo lyo;
Nkwatenga-amateeka go.
Yesu Mulokozi wange!

title: ETTENDO LINGI MU GGULU
text:
-ETTENDO lingi mu ggulu,
Basuuta nnyo Katonda;
Olw'ekiragiro kyo
Byonna lwe byatondebwa.

title: ETTENDO LINGI MU GGULU
text:
-Oluyimba-olukulu-ennyo 
Lwayimbibwa mu ttumbi 
-Olwa Kabaka-omuwere 
Lwe yazaalibwa mu nsi

title: ETTENDO LINGI MU GGULU
text:
Eggulu era n'ensi 
Lwe birisangulibwa,
Walirabika-ebiggya,
Balimutendereza.

title: ETTENDO LINGI MU GGULU
text:
Ffe fekka tusirike 
Okutuusa lw'alijja?
Nedda,Ekkanisa ye 
Ejja kutendereza.

title: ETTENDO LINGI MU GGULU
text:
Abatukuvu bonna,
Balijaguza ddala;
Batandikira mu nsi 
Ne mu ggulu basuuta.

title: ETTENDO LINGI MU GGULU
text:
Ennyimba ez'ettendo,
Zikusuute,Kitaffe;
Naawe Yesu Omwana,
N'Omwoyo-Omutukuvu.

title: OMUSAAYI-OGW'ENSOLO
text:
-OMUSAAYI-ogw'ensolo
Gwe baayiwa-ab'edda;
Gwonna tegwayinza bibi
Kubibanaazaako.

title: OMUSAAYI-OGW'ENSOLO
text:
Yesu Mulpkozi 
Omwana gw'endiga;
Ggwe-oyinza okutugyako
ebyonoono byonna.

title: OMUSAAYI-OGW'ENSOLO
text:
Ssaddaaka yo ntuufu,
Emalamu-ebibi;
-Omusayi gunaaza byonna,
Bye twonoona ku nsi.

title: OMUSAAYI-OGW'ENSOLO
text:
Ntunuulidde gy'oli,
Ggwe Mukama wange,
Nga njatula-ebibi byange,
Nga mboneredde nnyo.

title: OMUSAAYI-OGW'ENSOLO
MUMUTENDE YESU-OMUNUNUZI WAFFE
text:
MUMUTENDE Yesu-Omununuzi waffe
Ab'omu nsi mwatule-ekisa kye;
Mumwebaze bamalayika-abakulu
Erinnya lye-eddungi lyebazibwe.
Ng'omusumba,anaakuumanga-ababe
Alibatwala mu mikono gye.

title: MUMUTENDE YESU-OMUNUNUZI WAFFE
text:
Mumutende,olw'ekitiibwa ky(e) ekingi,
Mumwebaze n'ennyimb(a) ez'essanyu.

title: MUMUTENDE YESU-OMUNUNUZI WAFFE
text:
Mumutende Yesu-Omununuzi waffe 
Yatufiirira-olw'ebibi byaffe,
Ye lwe lwazi lwaffe-omuva-obulokozi,
Mumwebzae eyakomererwa;
Ye yatwala ennaku zaffe zonna,
Ye wa maanyi era wa kwagala.

title: MUMUTENDE YESU-OMUNUNUZI WAFFE
text:
Mumutende,olw'ekitiibwa ky(e) ekingi,
Mumwebaze n'ennyimb(a) ez'essanyu.

title: MUMUTENDE YESU-OMUNUNUZI WAFFE
MUMUTENDE YESU-OMUNUNUZI WAFFE
text:
Mumutende,olw'ekitiibwa ky(e) ekingi,
Mumwebaze n'ennyimb(a) ez'essanyu.

title: BW'ALIJJA MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
BW'ALIJJA Mukama waffe
Okuyita gy'ali
Abeesigwa be bonna
Abamwagala

title: BW'ALIJJA MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
Ng'emmunyeenye mu bbanga 
Bwe zaaka waggulu 
Nabo bwe balibeera 
Abaagalwa be.

title: BW'ALIJJA MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
Alikungaanyiza w'ali
Abaana be bonna;
abanyiikira ennyo
-Okumufaanana.

title: BW'ALIJJA MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
Mumutende,olw'ekitiibwa ky(e) ekingi,
Mumwebaze n'ennyimb(a) ez'essanyu.

title: BW'ALIJJA MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
Abakulu-era- n'abato;
Abaagala Yesu 
Talibaawulamu ye 
Bw'alikomawo.

title: BW'ALIJJA MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
Mumutende,olw'ekitiibwa ky(e) ekingi,
Mumwebaze n'ennyimb(a) ez'essanyu.

title: OMUKULU W'EKKANISA
text:
-OMUKULU w'ekkanisa
Ffe tukutendereza;
Nga tonnaba kulabika,
Tukulindirire ggwe.
Tuyimuse-eddoboozi
Ery'okwebaza kwaffe,
Tujaguza nga twewaayo
Gyoli Katonda waffe.

title: OMUKULU W'EKKANISA
text:
Nga tukyalumwa-ennaku,
Omuliro bwe gwaka;
Tusanyukira-okwagala 
Yesu kwe watulaga.
Edda twali basibe 
Mu kkomera-ery'amaanyi
Watujjira,n'enjegere 
Zaakutuka mangwago.

title: OMUKULU W'EKKANISA
text:
Abantu bo bayita 
Mu migga si mitnde,
Egy'okukemebwa, naye 
Tebatya ng'obatwala;
Amaanyi ga Ssetaani,
N'ag'ekibi,n'ag'ensi,
Galemeddwa,tuwangula,
Ku bwa Mukama waffe.

title: OMUKULU W'EKKANISA
text:
tunyooma-eby'ensi byonna,
Tunoonya-eby'onu ggulu,
Engule etawotoka,
Etutegekeddwa-eri.
Mu nsi tulaba-ennaku,
Naye gyoli mu ggulu,
Essanyu lituukirira 
Mirembe n'emirembe.

title: KATONDA-EYANNONDA NZE
text:
KATONDA-eyannonda nze
Si lwa bulungi bwange,
Eyannonda-obulonzi
N'anzigyako ebibi.
Nnyinza ntya-okumalayo
-Ebbanja lyange-eryenkanaawo-?

title: KATONDA-EYANNONDA NZE
KATONDA-EYANNONDA NZE
MWENNA MUSANYUKE
text:
MWENNA musanyuke
Yesu ye Kabaka;
Ebitonde byonna,
Biyimbe n'essanyu:
Muyimuse emitiima,
Musanyuke,mujaguze.

title: MWENNA MUSANYUKE
MWENNA MUSANYUKE
text:
Obwakabaka bwe 
Bwe butaliggwaawo;
Alina-obuyinza,
Mu nsi ne mu ggulu.
Muyimuse emitiima,
Musanyuke,mujaguze.

title: MWENNA MUSANYUKE
text:
Ali ku mukono 
Gwa ddyo gwa Katonda;
-Abalabe be bonna 
Balikungubaga.
Muyimuse emitiima,
Musanyuke,mujaguze.

title: GGWE-EKKUBO LYAFFE,-ERA MU GGWE
text:
GGWE-ekkubo lyaffe,-era mu ggwe
Mwe twekweka-okufa
Tuyita mu ggwe,Mukama
-Okulaba Kitaffe.

title: GGWE-EKKUBO LYAFFE,-ERA MU GGWE
text:
Ggwe ow'amazima ddala 
Ggwe-ogaba-okumanya;
Omatiza-ebirowoozo 
Onaaza emitima.

title: GGWE-EKKUBO LYAFFE,-ERA MU GGWE
GGWE-EKKUBO LYAFFE,-ERA MU GGWE
text:
Tuwe-okumanya,ggwe kkubo;
Era ggwe mazima.
-Obulamu bwo bwe twetaaga,
Obw'essanyu-eringi.

title: MUGABI W'EBIRABO-EBIRUNGI
text:
MUGABI w'ebirabo-ebirungi,
Ebiva-eri Katonda Kitaffe,
Otuwe ffe-abeetaaga okwagala;
Kye kirabo ekitenkanika.

title: MUGABI W'EBIRABO-EBIRUNGI
text:
Engabo yaffe kwe kukkiriza,
N'effumu kye Kigambo kya Yesu;
Ekyo ku kifuba butukuvu,
Tunaanika mu bigere-ekisa.

title: MUGABI W'EBIRABO-EBIRUNGI
text:
Naye-ekirabo kyo tukyetaaga,
Ekisinga-ebirala-obulungi,
Kwe kwagalana,nga bw'otwaga 
Yesu,bwe tutyo twagalanenga

title: MUGABI W'EBIRABO-EBIRUNGI
text:
Okwagala kugumiikiriza,
Kulina ekisa so si buggya;
Tekunoonya byakwo,tekunyiiga
Tekwegulumiza,tekukoowa.

title: MUGABI W'EBIRABO-EBIRUNGI
text:
Mwoyo-Omutukuvu,otuwenga 
Okwagala kwa Yesu yennyini 
Alyoke atubale mu babe,
Eby'omu nsi-eno bwe biriggwaawo.

title: YESU EKISA KYO-EKINGI
text:
YESU ekisa kyo-ekingi
Kinjiike ku mwoyo,
Guleme-okukyama nate
Gunywerere ku ggwe.

title: YESU EKISA KYO-EKINGI
text:
Omuliro gwa Katonda 
Gwake mu nze leero;
Gwokye-amasengere gonna,
Guntukuze-omwoyo.

title: YESU EKISA KYO-EKINGI
text:
Eyakka-edda ku baddu bo,
Omwoyo,kka ku nze;
Omwana wo nkukoowoola,
Ebyonoono-obyokye.

title: YESU EKISA KYO-EKINGI
text:
Omuliro-ogutukuza,
Gunjiike ku mwoyo:
Leeta-omnusana n'obulamu,
Byake bintukuze.

title: YESU EKISA KYO-EKINGI
text:
Ne ndyoka nfuna-amaayi go,
Obutasirika;
-Obugagga bwange,Mukama,
-Obulamu bwange-era.

title: OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU
text:
OMWOYO Omutukuvu,
Omugabi w'obulamu;
Jjangu,tukwegayiridde,
Jjangu-,okke mu myoyo gyaffe.

title: OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU
text:
Tutegeeze ffe bwe tuli,
Tunakuwalire-ebibi:
Tutegeeze Yesu bw'ali,
Tumwebaze-obulokozi.

title: OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU
OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU
text:
Eddagala bwe likaawa,
akambe ko bwe kasala,
Twesiga-,Omusawo waffe;
Endwadde yaffe-etuyinze.

title: OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU
text:
Kale,omuliro gujje,
Gummalemu-amasengere,
-Amalala,-ettima,ne byonna 
Ebitasiimibwa Yesu.

title: OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU
text:
Tujjuze-amaanyi n'ekisa,
-Emirembe n'okusanyuka 
N'okwewombeeka,twagale 
Bannaffe okukira ffe.

title: KABAKA W'EGGULU
text:
KABAKA w'eggulu,
Jjangu-Omusanyusa,
Omwoyo abeere naffe
Atubeere.

title: KABAKA W'EGGULU
text:
Ggwe-ensalo y'obulamu-
Otugaggawaze,
Otuwe emirembe gyo 
-Ennaku zonna.

title: KABAKA W'EGGULU
text:
Kka-okuva mu ggulu
Obeerenga naffe;
Otwetoolooze-okwagala
-Ennaku zonna.

title: GGWE-OLI MUTUKUVU,MUKAMA KATONDA
GGWE-OLI MUTUKUVU,MUKAMA KATONDA
text:
Ggwe-oli Mutukuvu,bakusinza bonna,
Abali mu ggulu bakuvuunamira;
Kkerubi ne Sseraafi bakutendereza,
Eyali,aliwo-,alibeerawo.

title: GGWE-OLI MUTUKUVU,MUKAMA KATONDA
GGWE-OLI MUTUKUVU,MUKAMA KATONDA
text:
Ggwe-oli Mutukuvu,Mukama Katonda;
Byonna bye watonda biraga-ettendo lyo.
Ggwe-oli Mutukuvu,wa kisa,wa maanyi,
Katonda omu,mu Busatu.

title: KA TUSUUTE KITAFFE
text:
KA tusuute Kitaffe,
Ka tumugulumize,
Eyatonda ffe-abantu
N'atuyita-abaana be

title: KA TUSUUTE KITAFFE
text:
Ka tusuute n'Omwana,
Omulokozi Yesu;
Eyafiira ku muti 
Ku lwa-abalina-ebibi.

title: KA TUSUUTE KITAFFE
text:
Ka tusuute bwe tutyo,
Omwoyo-Omutukuvu 
Atukoza-ebyo byonna 
Ebisiimibwa Yesu.

title: KA TUSUUTE KITAFFE
text:
Tusuute mu Busatu,
Oyo eyatutonda,
N'oyo-eyatununula,
N'oyo atutukuza

title: TUKWEBAZA KITAFFE
text:
TUKWEBAZA Kitaffe,
N'Omwana,n'Omwoyo!
Twebaza-Obusatu,
Tusinza ggwe omu!
Tuyingire ku ggye lyo
-Erya bamalayika
-Okukusuuta-obulungi
Nga bwe kisaanira.

title: TUKWEBAZA KITAFFE
text:
Kitaffe ggwe watuwa
Byonna bye tulina.
-Obulamu n'amagezi 
N'essanyu lingi nnyo.
Naye-okusinga byonna 
Watuwa-Omwana wo,
Okujja nu nsi muno,
 Okutulokola.

title: TUKWEBAZA KITAFFE
text:
Okwagala kwo Yesu 
Kwakwetoowazisa;
Era kwe kwakufuula 
Omwana w'omuntu;
Kwe kwakuwaliriza 
-Okugumiikiriza 
-Okunyoomebwa abantu,
Era n'okutiibwa.

title: TUKWEBAZA KITAFFE
text:
Era Katonda-Omwoyo 
Naawe tukusuuta,
Eyajja olw'ekisa.
Okututukuza.
Otuwe,Ayi Katonda,
-Amagezi mangi nnyo,
Twatule Obusatu,
Tusinze ggwe omu.

title: NZE NZIKIRIZA DDALA
text:
NZE nzikiriza ddala
Katonda Obusatu,
Ne Yesu-okufuuka-omuntu,
Nkyatulira ddala.

title: NZE NZIKIRIZA DDALA
text:
Neesiga era nsuubira 
Yesu-eyanfiirira 
Ebikolwa-ebibi byonna 
Bife nga bwe yafa.

title: NZE NZIKIRIZA DDALA
text:
Amaanyi era n'obulamu-
Biri gy'ali yekka,
Gwe nsinga-okwagala yekka
Mutukuvu ddala.

title: NZE NZIKIRIZA DDALA
text:
Nze ntenda ne Kkanisa yo 
Ggwe wagitonda-edda;
Ne by'eyigiriza byonna,
Bye biibyo by'osiima.

title: NZE NZIKIRIZA DDALA
text:
Ensi zonna zikutende
N'eggye-ery'omu ggulu;
Bikusuute ggwe Kitaffe,
N'Omwana n'Omwoyo.

title: GGWE MUKULU WEKKA
text:
GGWE Mukulu wekka,
Byonna ggwe-obifuga,
Tukusinza;
Tega okutu kwo
Eri byr tusaba,
Bunya-ekigambo kyo
Mu nsi zonna.

title: GGWE MUKULU WEKKA
text:
Ggwe-eyatuweereza,
Obulukozo bwo,
Tukusinza;
Ggwe bulamu bwabwe,
Bonna-abakwesiga,
Yasa-omusana gwo 
Ku nsi zonna.

title: GGWE MUKULU WEKKA
text:
Omwoyo-ow'ekisa,
Nannyini kwagala,
Tukusuuta;
Tuula mu nda zaffe 
Omalemu-ebibi,
N'enzikiza y'ensi 
Gimaleewo.

title: GGWE MUKULU WEKKA
text:
Omu mu Busatu,
Oli Mutukuvu,
Tukusuuta;
Toliiko kusooka
Era tolikoma,
Obwakabaka bwo 
Bwa mirembe.

title: MUKAMA TWAGALA
text:
MUKAMA twagala,
Ekifo mw'obeera,
Kye kitusanyusa
Okukijjukira.

title: MUKAMA TWAGALA
text:
Ye nnyumba yo ddala 
Mwe tukumgaanira,
Otusembeze gy'oli 
Abazze-okusaba

title: MUKAMA TWAGALA
text:
Gye babatiriza
Abava mu kibi;
Wonna watukuvu,
Kye kifo-ekirungi.

title: MUKAMA TWAGALA
text:
We wali-emmeeza yo,
Gye tulira naawe
N'owa-abakwagala 
Emmere y'obulamu.

title: MUKAMA TWAGALA
text:
Bwe batubuulira 
Ebyawandiikibwa;
Ennaku ziggwaawo,
Tubeera n'essanyu.

title: MUKAMA TWAGALA
text:
Ennyimba-entukuvu 
ziwoomesa-ennaku;
Ziyimusa-emyoyo,
Tubeera n'amaanyi.

title: MUKAMA TWAGALA
text:
Otuwe-ekisa kyo 
Okukwagala mu nsi,
Era ne mu ggulu 
Okukusuutanga

title: ENDAGAANO-ENTUKUVU
text:
ENDAGAANO-entukuvu,
Gye njagalira ddala,
Byonna bye neetaaga nze,
Birabikira mu yo.

title: ENDAGAANO-ENTUKUVU
text:
Omwoyo-Omutukuvu,
Yagiwandiisa edda;
Teyagunjibwa bantu,
Kyenaavanga ngyesiga.

title: ENDAGAANO-ENTUKUVU
text:
Bwe nkyama enkomyawo,
Bwemba ngwa ennyimusa,
Bwe siraba mu kkubo,
Eba gye ndi-omusana.

title: ENDAGAANO-ENTUKUVU
text:
Mu nnaku ensanyusa 
Yesu ng'anjigiriza,
Era-ewoomesa gye ndi 
Obulamu,n'okufa.

title: JJANGU! KOLA
text:
JJANGU! Kola.
Ayinza-ani leero okugayaala,
Ebikungulwa bingi byengedde;
Wulira Yesu ng'akuyita nti:
Jjangu1 Kola

title: JJANGU! KOLA
text:
Jjangu! Kola.
Kino kitiibwa kyaffe ky'atuwa:
Bamalayika tabakkiriza 
Okubuulira nti-Obwakabaka bwe 
Busembedde.

title: JJANGU! KOLA
text:
Jjangu! Kola.
Mu nnimiro eno-eya Katonda 
Mulimu-ebbanga ddene mwebali 
Abantu bangi abatamanyi
Mulokozi.

title: JJANGU! KOLA
text:
Jjangu! Kola.
Omulabe waffe anyiikira 
Okuggyamu-esingo-ennungi bulijjo 
N'okusigamu ez'omu nsiko,
Nga twebase.

title: JJANGU! KOLA
text:
Jjangu! Kola 
Situla-ekikoligo kye-ekyangu;
Bw'ogumiikiriza alikuwa 
Empeera-ennungi n'essanyu lingi,
Mukama wo

title: AYI YESU NKWEGAYIRIDDE
text:
AYI Yesu nkwegayyiridde,
Okunjigiriza wekka;
Kaakano mbuulire-abantu
Abali mu kizikiza.

title: AYI YESU NKWEGAYIRIDDE
text:
Bwe nnali nkyali mu bibi,
Wampita okujja gy'oli
N'osasula-ebbanja lyange 
N'ompa-obulamu bwa buwa.

title: AYI YESU NKWEGAYIRIDDE
text:
Ku lw'ekisa kyo ekingi 
Ombeere leero-omuddu wo;
Nkole by'oyagala byonna,
Mgende gy'ondagira yonna.

title: AYI YESU NKWEGAYIRIDDE
text:
Ayi Yesu,nkwegayiridde,
Okunnongoosa-eby'omunda,
Mbeere-ekibya-ekisaanira 
Mukama-okumuweereza.

title: AYI YESU NKWEGAYIRIDDE
text:
Onjijuze Omwoyo wo,
N'essanyu eriva gy'oli 
Abantu bakuwulire,
Ne balyoka bakwesiga.

title: AYI YESU NKWEGAYIRIDDE
text:
Onnyweze ,nneme-okwekuba 
Ku nkonge-ennyingi-eziriwo;
Bannange ndyoke mboolese 
Obuyinza bwo nga bwe buli.

title: AYI YESU NKWEGAYIRIDDE
text:
Ompummuzenga bulijjo,
Nneme-okweraliikirira;
Bannange mbategeezenga 
Bw'owummuza abakooye.

title: AYI YESU NKWEGAYIRIDDE
text:
Bwe ntyo ka nkugulumize 
Mu maaso g'abantu bonna;
Bo balyoke bajje gy'oli,
Nga bafuuse abaana bo

title: KU LWANGE NE KU LW'ENJIRI
text: KU lwange ne ku lw'enjiri,

title: KU LWANGE NE KU LW'ENJIRI
text:
Mugende baana bange:
Ne baddamu Ka tugende;

title: KU LWANGE NE KU LW'ENJIRI
text:
Ekitiibwa kibe gy'oli,
Yajja-okufiirira abantu,
Kitaawe ng'amutuma:
N'amalawo-ebibi byaffe,
Ggwe-okufa tokyaluma.

title: KU LWANGE NE KU LW'ENJIRI
text:
Amakondere ga Jjubiri,
Gavuga mu nsi zonna:
Gategeeza-obulokozi 
Eri-amawanga gonna.
Ssetaani n'obuyinza bwe,
Binaatera-okuggwaawo:
Obwakabaka bwa Yesu,
Bujja,obutavaawo.

title: KU LWANGE NE KU LW'ENJIRI
text:
Kale bannange,twesibe,
Tulwane nnyo masajja:
Tuleme okugayaala,
Mukama waffe ajja.
Laba emmambya esaze,
Ekizikiza kidduka;
Kusembedde-okuwummula,
Tunaatera-okunnyuka.

title: KU LWANGE NE KU LW'ENJIRI
text:
Naye wakyasigaddeyo 
Okulwana-ekiseera,
Tulyoke tugende gy'ali 
Tugabirwe empeera.
Weewaawo,nze njija mangu,

title: KU LWANGE NE KU LW'ENJIRI
text:
Okufuga-ensi zonna.
Amiina tuddamu Jjangu,

title: KU LWANGE NE KU LW'ENJIRI
text: Mukama waffe Yesu.

title: MUGENDE MU NSI ZONNA
text: MUGENDE mu nsi zonna,

title: MUGENDE MU NSI ZONNA
text:
Mubuulire-Enjiri
Eri-amawanga gonna 
Agabeera mu nsi,
Balyoke bategeere 
Yesu gwe tusinza 
Bw'ali Katonda ddala,
Bw'alokola bonna.

title: MUGENDE MU NSI ZONNA
text:
Mukama waffe Yesu 
-Otunyiikize fenna 
Tukolerenga ddala 
Ebitusaanira;
Tweweeyo gy'oli leero 
-Emibiri n'emyoyo 
Tuleetenga-ebirabo 
N'essanyu lingi nnyo

title: MUGENDE MU NSI ZONNA
text:
(O)kugaba kwa mukisa 
-Okusinga-Okutoola
Byonna bye tuli nabyo 
Biva-eri Katonda;
Otukkirizise-ebyo,
Tukwegayiridde
Tuleme okugamba nti 
Bye byaffe ku bwaffe.

title: MUGENDE MU NSI ZONNA
text:
Ayi Katonda Kitaffe,
Oyimuse mu ffe 
Abakunguzi-abangi,
Balyoke bagende 
Banyiikirenga wonna 
-Okubunya-Enjiri yo,
Babuulirenga bonna,
-Abakulu n'abato

title: MUGENDE MU NSI ZONNA
text:
Yesu Mukama waffe,
-Otuwe ku maanyi go,
Tukwatirenga ddala
Empisa-ennungi-ennyo 
Tuleme-okugayaala,
Naye tufube nnyo 
Mu mirimu gyo gyonna 
Olw'omukisa gwo.

title: OBWAKABAKA BWO
text:
OBWAKABAKA bwo,
Yesu,bujje mu nsi;
Menya n'omuggo gwo,
Obuddu bw'ekibi.

title: OBWAKABAKA BWO
text:
Twetaaga-emirembe
N'obutuukirivu 
-Okukyawagananga
-Otumalemu mangu.

title: OBWAKABAKA BWO
text:
Ebyasuubizibwa 
Bye tulindirira;
Bituukirizibwe,
Ayi Yesu Mukama.

title: OBWAKABAKA BWO
text:
Tukwegayiridde,
Okutusaasira;
Tukemgentererwa,
Jjangu otubeere.

title: OBWAKABAKA BWO
text:
Enzikiza-ekutte 
Ebuna-ensi zonna;
Musana gw'obulamu,
Yaka-obutaggwaawo.

title: OBWAKABAKA BWO BUJJE
text:
OBWAKABAKA bwo bujje
Kaakano tukyogedde:
Yesu onjigirize
-Okukisabira ddala.

title: OBWAKABAKA BWO BUJJE
text:
Yesu,sooka oyigire 
Muno mu mwoyo gwange:
Naakusembeza gye ndi,
Ongobemu ebibi.

title: OBWAKABAKA BWO BUJJE
text:
Ombeerenga bulijjo
Mbuulire-ekigambo kyo;
Olyoke ojje nate,
Mu mwoyo gya bannange.

title: OBWAKABAKA BWO BUJJE
text:
Ebiro bwe biriggwaawo-;
Kitaawo bye yalaga,
Olijja n'ettendo lyo,
N'olya-obwakabaka bwo

title: BULI MUNTU YENNA AWULIRE
text:
BULI muntu yenna awulire
Ebigambo by'Omulokozi w'ensi,
Bunya wonna wonna nti Akkiriza
Alirokoka mu ye.

title: BULI MUNTU YENNA AWULIRE
text:
Mujje nno gye ndi abakooy(e) ennyo 
Mulyoke muwummulenga n'essanyu.
Buli muntu ajja naamwaniriza,
Siimugobere bweru.

title: BULI MUNTU YENNA AWULIRE
text:
Buli muntu yenna asembere 
Oluggi lw'omu ggulu lugguddwaawo,
Yesu ge mazima,lye kkubo lyaffe;
Ekibalwisa kiki?

title: BULI MUNTU YENNA AWULIRE
text:
Mujje nno gye ndi abakooy(e) ennyo 
Mulyoke muwummulenga n'essanyu.
Buli muntu ajja naamwaniriza,
Siimugobere bweru.

title: BULI MUNTU YENNA AWULIRE
text:
Buli muntu yenna amwagala
Kye kigambo kya Katonda-atalimba;
Kale bannange,tubunye-ettendo lye,
Atugabidde buwa.

title: BULI MUNTU YENNA AWULIRE
text:
Mujje nno gye ndi abakooy(e) ennyo 
Mulyoke muwummulenga n'essanyu.
Buli muntu ajja naamwaniriza,
Siimugobere bweru.

title: KATONDA WAFFE,WA KISA, WA MAANYI
text:
KATONDA waffe,wa kisa ,wa maanyi
Kabaka-afuga amawamga gonna:
Ggwe-eyatumuliisa mu nzikiza ekutte,
Ggwe watusaasira mu nnaku ez'edda.

title: KATONDA WAFFE,WA KISA, WA MAANYI
KATONDA WAFFE,WA KISA, WA MAANYI
text:
Tukutendereza;tukwebazizza,
Tukugulumiza,ne tukusaba:
Ggwe-eyatubeeranga mu nnaku ezayita;
Otuyambenga emirembe gyonna.

title: BULIJJO TUMUSUUTENGA
text:
BULIJJO tumusuutenga
Mukama waffe Yesu,
Tumwebaze-olw'okukuuma
Kw'akuumye-Ekkanisa ye
Okuva mu nnaku ezo,
-Enjiri bwe yaleetebwa,
Mu nsi yaffe y'e Uganda  N'eyigganyizibwa nnyo.

title: BULIJJO TUMUSUUTENGA
text:
Bulijjo tukitendenga,
Ekitiibwa kye kyokka 
Bw'abawangudde-abalabe 
Ab'amaanyi-,ab'entiisa;
Tugobererenga abo 
Abaasooka-okutiibwa 
Ne batamwegaana Yesu,
Mu nnimi z'omuliro.

title: BULIJJO TUMUSUUTENGA
text:
Bulijjo ka twewengayo 
Yesu-okumuweereza;
Okusooka-emyoyo gyaffe 
Gifuuke nga ssaddaaka;
Ate tumutonerenga,
-Ebintu,n'abaana baffe 
Atuggyemu obukodo,
Atuwe ku ssanyu lye.

title: BULIJJO TUMUSUUTENGA
text:
Bulijjo twewombeekenga,
Tusabenga Mukama 
Atuggyemu obunafu,
Agabenga-Omwoyo we;
Mu mawanga-agaliraana 
-Ensi yaffe-enjuyi zonna,
Ebika bikkirizenga,
-Eddiini ebune mu-Africa.

title: BULIJJO TUMUSUUTENGA
text:
Bulijjo tweyongerenga 
Yesu-okumufaanana,
Tuyige-okutuukiriza 
-Empisa z'obuwombeefu 
Nga tusuubira-okujja kwe,
Nga tumwesiga yekka;
Nga tukola,nga tusuuta,
Nga tumulindirira

title: MMWE-ENSOZI-EMPANVU-ENNYO
text:
MMWE-ensozi-empanvu-ennyo,
Mujaguze mwenna!
-Ensenyi n'ebiwonvu,
Mumutendereze.
Muwulire-eddoboozi lye
Libuulira-eby'okujja kwe.

title: MMWE-ENSOZI-EMPANVU-ENNYO
MMWE-ENSOZI-EMPANVU-ENNYO
text:
Mmwe-amawanga mwenna,
Muzuukuke mangu;
-Abantu bammwe bonna 
Beefunire-eddembe 
Ery'Omwana wa Katonda 
Ly'abaleetera kaakano.

title: MMWE-ENSOZI-EMPANVU-ENNYO
text:
Amawanga gonna 
Agali-ewala ennyo,
Agatamanyanga 
Mulokozi w'ensi;
Kale,mwenna mujje gy'ali,
Oyo eyakomererwa.

title: MMWE-ENSOZI-EMPANVU-ENNYO
MUWULIRE MMWE-ABANTU BE
text:
MUWULIRE mmwe-abantu be
Abamukiriza;
Mubunye ebigambo bye
Kristo wa Katonda.

title: MUWULIRE MMWE-ABANTU BE
text:
Mubuulire wonna wonna,
Mu mawanga gonna;
Banabbi ye gwe baalanga 
Ye musana gw'ensi.

title: MUWULIRE MMWE-ABANTU BE
text:
Katonda-ow'olubeerera,
Eyeefuula omuntu,
Eyatwala omubiri,
Ye Katonda ddala.

title: MUWULIRE MMWE-ABANTU BE
text:
Katonda-ava mu Kitaffe 
Asinzibwa bonna,
Eyatuwonya mu kufa 
N'atufuula abaana.

title: MUWULIRE MMWE-ABANTU BE
text:
Fenna abamukkiriza
Atuwe-omwoyo gwe;
Bwe tuba tataataagana,
Ye atulumgamya

title: OLWAZI KWE YAZIMBA KATONDA-EKKANISA
text:
OLWAZI kwe yazimba Katonda-Ekkanisa,
Ye Mulokozi waffe eyagitukuza,
-Olwamazzi n'ekigambo-,okuba-omugole we;
N'ava mu ggulu,n'akka ku nsi,erokoke.

title: OLWAZI KWE YAZIMBA KATONDA-EKKANISA
text:
Abantu bonna-ab'ensi bayingira omwo,
Kyebava bagiyita yokka-Ebuna wonna;
Eyatula Mukama omu n'ekkiriza,
-Ekigambo kye, n'etoola emmere-emu yokka.

title: OLWAZI KWE YAZIMBA KATONDA-EKKANISA
text:
Leero newankubadde enyoomebwa-abantu,
Olw'obukyamu bwamu,n'olw'okwesalamu;
 -Abatukuvu beekuuma ngabakukaabira,
 Olijja ddi Mukama? tukulindirira.

title: OLWAZI KWE YAZIMBA KATONDA-EKKANISA
text:
Mu mitawaana gyayo, mu ntalo n'obwowe,
-Emirembe gya Katonda gyo gy'erindiridde;
Terirema kuweebwa bye yagisuubiza,
Ekkanisa erwana n'eryoka-ewummula.

title: OLWAZI KWE YAZIMBA KATONDA-EKKANISA
text:
Yagattibwa-era ku nsi ne Katonda waffe,
N'esseekimu mu mwoyo n'abo abeebaka,
Baweereddwa n'essanyu;Yesu otuwe ffe,
-Okubeeranga mu ggulu nga bo-awamu naawe.

title: LWANANGA MU LUTALO LWO
text:
LWANANGA mu lutalo lwo,
Okulwana okulungi,
Nyweza ggwe obulamu bwo,
Yesu atuwa empeera.

title: LWANANGA MU LUTALO LWO
text:
Wakana ggwe-omuwakanyi,
Leeta amaanyi go gonna,
Gumira-olugendo lwo,
Yesu atuwa empeera.

title: LWANANGA MU LUTALO LWO
text:
Leka-okweraliikirira,
Tulina-Omusaale waffe;
Mwesige ye,oliraba 
Yesu bw'atuwa-ebirungi.

title: LWANANGA MU LUTALO LWO
text:
Tozirika,ali kumpi,
Tajjulula kwagala kwe,
Kkiriza ggwe,oliraba 
Yesu bw'ali-Omulokozi

title: MMWE BANNANGE ABALWANYI
text:
MMWE bannange-abalwanyi,
Mujje mangu gye tuli,
Abalabe weebali,
So nga tetutya.

title: MMWE BANNANGE ABALWANYI
text:
Ku by'ensi tetussaako 
Myoyo gyaffe kaakano,
Yesu atuwanguza.
Atuwa-amaanyi.

title: MMWE BANNANGE ABALWANYI
text:
Abalumba ba maanyi,
Batutaayiza bubi,
Tulina-Omulokozi,
Alijja mangu.

title: MMWE BANNANGE ABALWANYI
text:
Kye twegomba kye kino
Okuleka-ebyonoono,
Yesu anaatuggyako,
Ebibi byaffe.

title: MMWE BANNANGE ABALWANYI
text:
Kaakano kizikiza,
Mugume temwekanga;
Mu ggulu omusana 
Gulirabika.

title: MMWE BANNANGE ABALWANYI
text:
Mwekalirize-amaaso,
Nga muddamu nnyo-amaanyi,
Okufa gwe mulyango,
Ogw'obulamu.

title: MMWE BANNANGE ABALWANYI
text:
Abalwanyi be mwenna,
Temujja kugobebwa:
Yesu abawanguza,
-Olw'omusaayi gwe.

title: MMWE BANNANGE ABALWANYI
text:
Ka tuyimuse-emyoyo,
Nga tuguma bulijjo,
Okutuusa ku biro 
Yesu lw'alijja.

title: YESU,BWE NNAKUSENGA
text:
YESU,bwe nnakusenga,
Ne nsuubiza kino,
-Okukugoberenga
Obutaddirira.
Naye Mukama wange,
Beeranga nange ggwe,
Nnemenga okwesittala-,
Oba kukyamanga.

title: YESU,BWE NNAKUSENGA
text:
-Abalabe bange bangi,
Ba kyejo,ba ttima;
Naye ggwe-osinga bonna
-Okubeera n'amaanyi,
Sijja kuggwaamu mwoyo,
Ggwe ononnyinzisanga 
-Olutalo-olw'entiisa.

title: YESU,BWE NNAKUSENGA
text:
Bwe mba nga neesittala,
Nkwata ku mikono,
-Awatali ggwe siireme
Kukyamira ddala;
Bwe mba nga nafuwadde,
Onzizeemu-omwoyo,
-Obusungu nga bunkutte,
Onkomeko mpola.

title: YESU,BWE NNAKUSENGA
text:
Naawe,Mukama wange,
Wasuubiza kino,
Ankwesiga-amazima,
-Okumutuusa-ewuwo 
Kale, nze nnakusenga,
Ombeere lwa kisa,
Nnemenga-okudda-ennyumba,
Mbeerenga mwesigwa.

title: YESU AJJA! ABALABE
text:
YESU ajja! Abalabe
Tulibagoba;
Yesu Mulokozi waffe,
Alitujuna.

title: YESU AJJA! ABALABE
text: Yesu agambaMmwe mugume

title: YESU AJJA! ABALABE
text:
Nze njija mangu:
Tumuddemu Tunaalwana,

title: YESU AJJA! ABALABE
text: Olw'ekisa kyo.

title: YESU AJJA! ABALABE
text:
Laba,eggye-erya Ssetaani,
Liba lingi nnyo;
Naye Yesu ali wamu,
Naffe bulijjo.

title: YESU AJJA! ABALABE
text: Yesu agambaMmwe mugume

title: YESU AJJA! ABALABE
text:
Nze njija mangu:
Tumuddemu Tunaalwana,

title: YESU AJJA! ABALABE
text: Olw'ekisa kyo.

title: YESU AJJA! ABALABE
text:
Amafamu ga Ssetaani,
Kwe kusoomoza:
Gonna ganaamenyebwanga,
Naye-aligobwa.

title: YESU AJJA! ABALABE
text: Yesu agambaMmwe mugume

title: YESU AJJA! ABALABE
text:
Nze njija mangu:
Tumuddemu Tunaalwana,

title: YESU AJJA! ABALABE
text: Olw'ekisa kyo.

title: YESU AJJA! ABALABE
text:
Ebigambo bya Katonda 
Bitugumya nnyo;
Bye biyinza okugoba
Abalabe be.

title: YESU AJJA! ABALABE
text: Yesu agambaMmwe mugume

title: YESU AJJA! ABALABE
text:
Nze njija mangu:
Tumuddemu Tunaalwana,

title: YESU AJJA! ABALABE
text: Olw'ekisa kyo.

title: KALE GGYE LYA YESU, MUGOLOKOKE
text:
KALE ggye lya Yesu, mugolokoke,
Mulabe Mukama akulembedde:
Mu balabe bangi Yesu Mugambe;
Mukama-atuyita;tugende naye.

title: KALE GGYE LYA YESU, MUGOLOKOKE
text:
Kale ggye lya Yesu,mugolokoke,
Mulabe Mukama akulembedde.

title: KALE GGYE LYA YESU, MUGOLOKOKE
text:
Tugende mu maaso,ng'abalwanyi be,
Tusinge Ssetaani n'amagezi ge.
Tukkirize Yesu ye ngabo yaffe 
N'ekitala kyaffe kye kitabo kye.

title: KALE GGYE LYA YESU, MUGOLOKOKE
text:
Kale ggye lya Yesu,mugolokoke,
Mulabe Mukama akulembedde.

title: KALE GGYE LYA YESU, MUGOLOKOKE
text:
Erinnya lya Yesu bwe liwulirwa,
Abantu ba Ssetaani badduka bonna.
Mmwe mugume-emyoyo,abooluganda;
Mu Mukama waffe tuliwangula.

title: KALE GGYE LYA YESU, MUGOLOKOKE
text:
Kale ggye lya Yesu,mugolokoke,
Mulabe Mukama akulembedde.

title: KALE GGYE LYA YESU, MUGOLOKOKE
text:
Mubayite bangi bagende naffe,
Balyoke babeere abalwanyi be.
Kale abooluganda,tugume-emyoyo;
Omugabe waffe ye wa maanyi nnyo.

title: KALE GGYE LYA YESU, MUGOLOKOKE
text:
Kale ggye lya Yesu,mugolokoke,
Mulabe Mukama akulembedde.

title: BALWANYI BA YESU MWESIBE-ENKOLA
text:
BALWANYI ba Yesu mwesibe-enkola,
Mulwane masajja,tuliwangula;
Tulina-Omugabe,asinga bonna,
Ye Kabaka Yesu-Omukulembeze.

title: BALWANYI BA YESU MWESIBE-ENKOLA
text:
Balwanyi ba Yesu,mwesib(e) enkoba;
Muwulir(e) enmgoma,Kabak(a) alaya.

title: BALWANYI BA YESU MWESIBE-ENKOLA
text:
Bajjajjaffe-ab'edda baalwananga nnyo,
Tulwane bannaffe,naye si nga bo;
Abalabe baffe,bwe bubi bwonna,
N'obulimba bw'ensi; bye tuligoba.

title: BALWANYI BA YESU MWESIBE-ENKOLA
text:
Balwanyi ba Yesu,mwesib(e) enkoba;
Muwulir(e) enmgoma,Kabak(a) alaya.

title: BALWANYI BA YESU MWESIBE-ENKOLA
text:
Tetwetaaga mmandwa oba mayembe,
So n'eby'obufumu,tebitugumya;
Yesu ye kennyini,atuwa-amaanyi,
Kale nno tugume nnyo tuwangule.

title: BALWANYI BA YESU MWESIBE-ENKOLA
text:
Balwanyi ba Yesu,mwesib(e) enkoba;
Muwulir(e) enmgoma,Kabak(a) alaya.

title: BALWANYI BA YESU MWESIBE-ENKOLA
text:
Ayi Kabaka waffe,tuzze-okuwera,
Twesibye enkoba ng'abalwanyi bo:
Mu lutalo lwonna,lw'otugabyemu,
Genda wamu naffe ggwe,tuwangule.

title: BALWANYI BA YESU MWESIBE-ENKOLA
text:
Balwanyi ba Yesu,mwesib(e) enkoba;
Muwulir(e) enmgoma,Kabak(a) alaya.

title: MULWANYI WA YESU OLINA-ENNAKU
text:
MULWANYI wa Yesu olina-ennaku,
Abalabe bangi bakutaayiza,
Zuukuka-obakube,oliwangula.
Yesu ali naawe,omweyabize.

title: MULWANYI WA YESU OLINA-ENNAKU
text:
Mulwanyi wa Yesu,laba-emitego,
Ssetaani wa maanyi okukusuula;
Totya,guma-omwoyo,tolwana wekka,
Olina-Omubeezi,-erinnya lye Yesu.

title: MULWANYI WA YESU OLINA-ENNAKU
text:
Mulwanyi wa Yesu,obawulira,
Ebigambo byabwe bikuwoomera?
Byonna bya bulimba,tobikkiriza;
Obukuusa bwabwe bulirabika.

title: MULWANYI WA YESU OLINA-ENNAKU
text:
Yesu agamba nti Mbimanyi byonna,
Okooye-,olemeddwa,tokyasuubira,
Teweekanga n'akamu-,ddamu amaanyi,
Mu ggulu entalo zonna ziriggwa.

title: MMWE MWENNA-ABOOLUGANDA
text:
MMWE mwenna-abooluganda
Mubeere n'essanyu;
Ensi zijjule-ettendo
Ery'omulokozi
-Abantu-abatabalika
Bamugulumiza;
Leero bafunye-eddembe
Lwa linnya lye-lyokka.

title: MMWE MWENNA-ABOOLUGANDA
text:
Mmwe mwenna-abooluganda 
Mulwane n'amaanyi;
Eyeeraga-amasajja;
Empeera ye nnyingi.
Yesu Mugabe waffe,
Wa maanyi mangi nnyo:
Tufube nnyo bannaffe,
Tuwangule leero.

title: MMWE MWENNA-ABOOLUGANDA
MWENNA MUYIMUKE
text:
MWENNA muyimuke,
Ng'abasserikale;
Mwambale-eby'okulwanyisa
Byonna-ebya Katonda.

title: MWENNA MUYIMUKE
text:
Mubeere ba maanyi,
Mumutunuulire;
Ye ge maanyi gaffe gonna,
Agatuwanguza.

title: MWENNA MUYIMUKE
text:
Temutya mulabe,
Yesu yawangula;
Amaanyi gonna-ag'okufa 
Tegakyasobola.

title: MWENNA MUYIMUKE
MWENNA MUYIMUKE
text:
Mwesibe-amazima,
N'obutuukirivu;
Nga mutunuulira Yesu,
Omukulembeze.

title: GGWE KIBUGA KYA KATONDA
text:
GGWE kibuga kya Katonda
Ekitiibwa kyo kingi,
Yakukuba,so toyinza
Okusimbulwa nate.
Emisingi gyo gibeera
Ku lwazi lw'emirembe
Kuliko bbugwe wa maanyi,
Atalumbika babi.

title: GGWE KIBUGA KYA KATONDA
text:
Munda laba-emigga mingi 
Egikulukuta-ennyo,
Mwe basena-obutayosa 
Okunywesa-abaana bo;
Ago-amazzi g'obulamu 
-Agatumalamu-ennyonta,
Agagaba ye Katonda;
Nga baweereddwa-ekisa!

title: GGWE KIBUGA KYA KATONDA
GGWE KIBUGA KYA KATONDA
BATUULA MU GGULU
text:
BATUULA mu ggulu
Wamu naawe
Abatuukirivu;
Basanyuka.
Bayimba bulijjo,
Tweyanze ekisa kyo,
Ggwe-eyatwagala-ennyo,
Mulokozi.

title: BATUULA MU GGULU
text:
-Omusaayi gwa Yesu 
Gwanaaza nnyo;
Ebyambalo e'bya-
Batukuvu.
Kyebava batuula 
Wamu naawe,Katonda;
Kyebava bayimba 
Ettendo lyo.

title: BATUULA MU GGULU
text:
Ani ayagala 
-Okutuuka-eyo?
Jjangu Yesu gy'ali;
Yanguwako.
Anaakusonyiwa,
Taaleme kukkiriza,
Nga bwe yasuubiza,
Mukama wo.

title: BATUULA MU GGULU
text:
Tasingika ddala 
Ekisa kye:
Alibalokola 
Abantu be. 
Asangula-ebibi 
N'omusaayi-ogw'amaanyi:
Asinga obubi 
Taamuleme.

title: BULIJJO TUTENDEREZA
text:
BULLIJO tutendereza
Ekibuga kyaffe,
Ekyakubibwa mu ggulu,
Yesu kye yazimba.

title: BULIJJO TUTENDEREZA
text:
Singa mbadde n'ebiwawa 
 Nga bamalayika,
 Nandibuuse,nandituuse
 Eri mu Sayuuni

title: BULIJJO TUTENDEREZA
text:
Era-ennyumba zaakyo zonna
 Ziringa nga zaabu;
 Ze zisinga zonna ddala
 Ezizimbibwa abantu.

title: BULIJJO TUTENDEREZA
text:
Singa mbadde n'ebiwawa 
 Nga bamalayika,
 Nandibuuse,nandituuse
 Eri mu Sayuuni

title: BULIJJO TUTENDEREZA
text:
Yesu mwali,ye Mukama,
 Abafuga bonna;
 Bamalayika beeyanza,
 Nga bamuweereza.

title: BULIJJO TUTENDEREZA
text:
Singa mbadde n'ebiwawa 
 Nga bamalayika,
 Nandibuuse,nandituuse
 Eri mu Sayuuni

title: BULIJJO TUTENDEREZA
text:
4 
 Mu ntebe ye mufuluma 
 -Amazzi g'obulamu 
 Agamasamasa ddala 
 Nga-effeeza-ennungi.

title: BULIJJO TUTENDEREZA
text:
Singa mbadde n'ebiwawa 
 Nga bamalayika,
 Nandibuuse,nandituuse
 Eri mu Sayuuni

title: BULIJJO TUTENDEREZA
text:
5 
 Era gy'ali gye gumera
 -Omuti gw'Obulamu 
 Amalagala kwe gali
 Agawonya-abantu

title: BULIJJO TUTENDEREZA
text:
Singa mbadde n'ebiwawa 
 Nga bamalayika,
 Nandibuuse,nandituuse
 Eri mu Sayuuni

title: BULIJJO TUTENDEREZA
text:
6 
 Ffe tusiime ekibuga 
 Yesu Kristo waffe 
 Kye yatulongoosereza 
 Ekiri mu ggulu.

title: BULIJJO TUTENDEREZA
text:
Singa mbadde n'ebiwawa 
 Nga bamalayika,
 Nandibuuse,nandituuse
 Eri mu Sayuuni

title: BULIJJO TUTENDEREZA
text:
7 
 Otuzibule amaaso,
 Yesu tukulabe;
 Tubiwulire-ebigambo
 Bya Mukama waffe.

title: BULIJJO TUTENDEREZA
text:
Singa mbadde n'ebiwawa 
 Nga bamalayika,
 Nandibuuse,nandituuse
 Eri mu Sayuuni

title: MU NSI Y'OMU GGULU
text:
MU nsi y'omu ggulu
Tewabaawo kiro,
Emirimu tegikoya
Bakoza-okwagala.

title: MU NSI Y'OMU GGULU
text:
Eri teri nnaku,
Essanyu lingi nnyo:
Katonda waffe-asangula 
Amaziga gonna.

title: MU NSI Y'OMU GGULU
text:
Eri teri kibi:
Abaliyo bonna 
Bambadde-engoye-entukuvu,
Bayimbira Yesu.

title: MU NSI Y'OMU GGULU
text:
Eri teri kufa:
Abaayingira-eyo,
Baamala bo okusikira
Obulamu-obutaggwaawo.

title: MU NSI Y'OMU GGULU
text:
Yesu,musaale ggwe,
Otukulembere;
-Otuyise mu kabi konna 
Otutuuse mu ggulu

title: WALIWO-ENSI ESINGA-ENO
text:
WALIWO-ensi esinga-eno,
Nga nnungi! nga nnungi!
Tetuukayo kibi kyonna,
Ensi-eyo,nga nnungi!
Tulikuba ennanga-empya,
Wamu ne bamalayika,
Ennanga zaabwe za zaabu:
Ensi-eyo,nga nnungi!

title: WALIWO-ENSI ESINGA-ENO
text:
Mbu teri bire ku ggulu,
Ensi-eyo,nga nnungi!
Teri nnaku na kukaba,
Ensi-eyo,nga nnungi!
Banywa mu luzzi-olw'ekisa
Ne balaba-Omulokozi
Amaaso ge gwe musana;
Ensi eyo,nga nnungi!

title: WALIWO-ENSI ESINGA-ENO
text:
Newankubadde nga fenna
Tujjudde ekibi,
Naye Yesu yakkiriza 
Okufa,ku lwaffe!
Tulitukuzibwa fenna
Olw'omusaayi gwa Yesu,
Tulifuga wamu naye,
Mu nsi-eyo ennungi.

title: SAAYUUNI MU GGULU
text:
SAAYUUNI mu ggulu,
Katonda gy'abeera;
Bwe ndifa,ndigenda
N'essanyu lingi nnyo.

title: SAAYUUNI MU GGULU
text:
Katonda wang(e),eyo gy'oli 
Ndituuka dd(i) okukulaba?

title: SAAYUUNI MU GGULU
text:
-Omulokozi gy'ali,
Gwe baayigganyanga;
Ne bamalayika 
Bayimba-ettendo lye.

title: SAAYUUNI MU GGULU
text:
Katonda wang(e),eyo gy'oli 
Ndituuka dd(i) okukulaba?

title: SAAYUUNI MU GGULU
text:
Ab'edda baali-eyo,
Baakomekkereza
Emgendo Zaabwe,era 
Baalaba Mukama.

title: SAAYUUNI MU GGULU
text:
Katonda wang(e),eyo gy'oli 
Ndituuka dd(i) okukulaba?

title: SAAYUUNI MU GGULU
text:
Eri n'abatume 
Gye balabikira;
Bonna-abamwesiga,
Nga bakuba-ennanga

title: SAAYUUNI MU GGULU
text:
Katonda wang(e),eyo gy'oli 
Ndituuka dd(i) okukulaba?

title: SAAYUUNI MU GGULU
text:
Era-abajulirwa 
-Abaalangibwa Yesu,
-Era abamwesiga 
Eyabalokola.

title: SAAYUUNI MU GGULU
text:
Katonda wang(e),eyo gy'oli 
Ndituuka dd(i) okukulaba?

title: AWAMU NE YESU,EMIREMBE GYONNA
text:
AWAMU ne Yesu,emirembe gyonna
Bwe bulamu bwange nnyini,bwe yampa bwa buwa:
Wansi ndi muyise,Yesu nga taliiwo:
Buli lunaku lwe mmala,mba nsembedde gy'ali.

title: AWAMU NE YESU,EMIREMBE GYONNA
text:
Gy'abeera Kitange,gye ndibeera nange:
Ne nfaanana-okulabayo,olw'okukkiriza:
Ne ndyoka nkaaba nnyo-okutuukayo mangu
Bwe busika bwabwe bonna abeesiga Yesu.

title: AWAMU NE YESU,EMIREMBE GYONNA
text:
Ate nga wambuze; nga-ejjiba lya Nuuwa
Bwe lyaddimgana ku mazzi,nange bwe mba bwe ntyo:
Naye-oluvannyuma,omusana gwaka
Bwe ntyo bwe nsanyuka nnyini, nga ndabyeyo nate

title: AWAMU NE YESU,EMIREMBE GYONNA
text:
Ennaku si nnyingi,kw'alijjira Yesu
Okututwala ewuwe gy'atulongooseza:
Kyevudde njaguza,essanyu linsize 
Yesu! awamu ne Yesu emirembe gyonna.

title: OBULAMU BWAFFE BUNO
text:
-OBULAMU bwaffe buno
Bujjudde nnyo-ennaku;
Naye obw'ensi eyo
Bwa ssanyu jjereere.

title: OBULAMU BWAFFE BUNO
text:
N'entalo-eza kaakano 
Za ntiisa bulijjo,
-Omulabe waffe-ow'edda
Wa maanyi mangi nnyo.

title: OBULAMU BWAFFE BUNO
text:
Naye Omubeezi waffe
Asingira ddala;
Era-abamwesiga ye
Be baliwangula.

title: OBULAMU BWAFFE BUNO
text:
Fenna kyetunaavanga 
Tunyiikira nnyini;
Kubanga tumanyi nti:
Ye-alituwummuza.

title: OBULAMU BWAFFE BUNO
text:
-Ekiseera si kinene 
Ekirimu-akabi,
Ne tulyoka tutuuka 
Awali Katonda.

title: OBULAMU BWAFFE BUNO
text:
Obudde bwe bulikya 
Enzikiza n'eggwa,
Yesu Musana gwaffe
Aliba-atwakidde

title: MU KIBUGA KYA KATONDA
text:
MU kibuga kya Katonda,
Nga guva mu ntebe ye,
Waliwo-omugga-omulungi
Ogw'amazzi ag'obulamu.

title: MU KIBUGA KYA KATONDA
text:
Abatukuvu ba Yesu 
Bagusanyukirako:
Naffe twagal(a) okutuka
Ku mabbali g'omugga guli.

title: MU KIBUGA KYA KATONDA
text:
Yesu Omusumba waffe 
Anatulumggamyanga,
Mu ddundiro ly'okwesiima
Eririraanye-omugga guli

title: MU KIBUGA KYA KATONDA
text:
Abatukuvu ba Yesu 
Bagusanyukirako:
Naffe twagal(a) okutuka
Ku mabbali g'omugga guli.

title: MU KIBUGA KYA KATONDA
text:
Naye nga tetunnatuuka 
Awali-omugga guli,
Otutikkule-emigugu
Egy'ennaku era n'ebibi.

title: MU KIBUGA KYA KATONDA
text:
Abatukuvu ba Yesu 
Bagusanyukirako:
Naffe twagal(a) okutuka
Ku mabbali g'omugga guli.

title: MU KIBUGA KYA KATONDA
text:

title: WULIRA-EDDOBOOZI
text:
WULIRA-eddoboozi
Erijja gy'oli
Genda Yesu gy'ali
Akugamba nti:

title: WULIRA-EDDOBOOZI
text:
Mpa omutima gwo,
Nnakufiirira,
Nze,nze nkuyita ggwe,
Sembera gye ndi

title: WULIRA-EDDOBOOZI
text:
Bw'onoobanga-onoonya
Ekiddukiro;
Ddukira-eri Yesu,
Omulokozi.

title: WULIRA-EDDOBOOZI
text:
Eddoboozi ttono 
Naye lya maanyi;
Laba-okwagala kwe,
Ggwe omwonoonyi.

title: WULIRA-EDDOBOOZI
text:
Muwe omwoyo gwo 
Yakufiirira;
Ye akuyita ggwe,
Genda mangu nnyo.

title: OMUZIBE W'AMAASO EDDA
text:
-OMUZIBE w'amaaso edda
Eyali ng'asabiriza
N'awulira-abantu bangi
N'ababuuza nti Ekyo ki?
Bonna ne bamubuulira,
Yesu Omunazaaleesi.

title: OMUZIBE W'AMAASO EDDA
text:
Kiki ekimuyinzisa 
Okubavumula bonna?
Si ye mugenyi bugenyi?
Ekibamwagaza kiki?
Laba bwe bayogerera 
Waggulu: Yesu ayita.

title: OMUZIBE W'AMAASO EDDA
text:
Yesu ye wuuyo eyava
Mu ggulu,okulokola
Abalina-ebibi,n'abo
Abazitoowereddwa-ennyo.
Bali kyebava boogera 
Yesu Omunazaaleesi.

title: OMUZIBE W'AMAASO EDDA
text:
Bannange mu nnaku zino
Yesu atuyita fenna,
Ng'abuulira abantu be 
-Ebirabo by'abaleetedde.
Tewali n'omu-amwenkana
Yesu Omunazaaleesi.

title: OMUZIBE W'AMAASO EDDA
text:
Naye bwe muba munyooma 
Ekisa-ekitenkanika 
Ennaku ziribasanga 
Yesu bw'alibagamba nti:
Muve we ndi aboonoonyi,
-Ekiseera kyammwe kyayita

text:

title: JJANGU MUNNANGE OWULIRE-ENJIRI
text:
JJANGU munnange owulire-enjiri
Y'okwagala kwa Yesu,
Bwe yaleka ennyumba y'ekitiibwa
N'ebintu byonna eby'essanyu,
Yesu yafa,Yesu yatufiirira.

title: JJANGU MUNNANGE OWULIRE-ENJIRI
text:
Ffe fenna tulina ebibi,
Katonda atunuulira,
Ebyonoono byaffe abimanyi byonna,
Ye wa kisa yatutumira Yesu.

title: JJANGU MUNNANGE OWULIRE-ENJIRI
text:
Ababi abaamukyawa Yesu,
Baamuwanika ku muti,
Naye okufa kwe kutuwa eddembe,
Okuva mu musango-omubi.

title: JJANGU MUNNANGE OWULIRE-ENJIRI
text:
Kale omulenzi,ne mwannyina,
Mukkirize kaakano Yesu;
Tewali bulokozi mu mulala,
Mu nsi zonna oba mu ggulu

title: MWOYO GWANGE, WULIRA
text:
MWOYO gwange,wulira,
Yesu Mulokozi wo;
Akubuuza ggwe bw'ati:
Mwana wange-onjagala?

title: MWOYO GWANGE, WULIRA
MWOYO GWANGE, WULIRA
text:
Nnyina ki-atajjukira
Bulijjo omwana we?
Ye yeerabira-omwana:
Naye siirekenga ggwe.

title: MWOYO GWANGE, WULIRA
MWOYO GWANGE, WULIRA
MWOYO GWANGE, WULIRA
text:
Mulokozi,gunsinze;
Nnali nga sikwagala:
Naye leero mpa ekisa,
Nnyongere kukwagala.

title: WULIRA MU LUYOOGAANO
text:
WULIRA mu luyoogaano
Eddoboozi lya Yesu,
Bw'akuyita omunaku
Okumugoberera.

title: WULIRA MU LUYOOGAANO
text:
Nga basuula obutimba 
Mu nnyanja-abatume be,
Yabayita ng'abagamba
Bw'ati:Muyite nange.

title: WULIRA MU LUYOOGAANO
text:
Bo ne balekawo mangu 
Obutimba,ne bajja,
Bwe baawulira-eddoboozi
Erya Yesu ntiMujje.

title: WULIRA MU LUYOOGAANO
text:
Bw'atyo Yesu bw'atuyita 
Okuleka-ebyonoono,
Era n'okutambulanga 
Mu makubo g'obulamu-.

title: WULIRA MU LUYOOGAANO
text:
Mu ssanyu era mu nnaku,
Mu ndwadde ne mu bulamu-;
Tukyawulira-eddoboozi
Ly'Omulokozi waffe.

title: WULIRA MU LUYOOGAANO
text:
Mwana wange tosuulanga 
Bye nkugabira buwa,
Laba bwe nnafiirira ggwe,
Mpa-omutima gwo gwonna

MUJJE-ERI YESU, TEMULWAWO
text:

Mujje mwenna naabawummuza
Mujje mwenna gye ndi.

text:
MUJJE mwenna-abakooye
Nze naabawummuza:
-Eddoboozi nga lya kisa
Ery'Omulokozi:
Litutegeeza bw'ali
Ow'ekisa kyonna,
Bw'ayagala-okuwonya
Emyoyo gy'abantu

title: MUJJE MWENNA-ABAKOOYE
text:
Mujje mwenna-abakyamye
Nze naabamulisa:
-Eddoboozi nga lya ssanyu 
Mu nzikiza-ekutte.
Mu nsiko ey'omu nsi
Twali tuwabye nnyo,
Mu kkubo lye yatuzza,
Ffe ne tusanyuka

title: MUJJE MWENNA-ABAKOOYE
text:
Mujje mwenna-abafudde 
Naabawa obulamu-:
-Eddoboozi lye lya manyi,
Lituzzaamu-omwoyo.
Entalo zaffe nzibu;
-Omulabe mukambwe;
Amaanyi g'okulwana
Gava eri Yesu.

title: MUJJE MWENNA-ABAKOOYE
text:
Era-anajjanga gye ndi
Nze siimugobenga:
-Eddoboozi lya Mukama 
Lye litugumya-ennyo:
Ekisa-ekyenkanaawo
Tewali-asaanidde,
Ye ye-atusembezezza
Kale tumwebaze

Wummula

text:

title: MUJJE MWENNA ABAKOOYE
text:
MUJJE mwenna abakooye
N'okutegana kw'ensi,
Yesu ye-anaabaaniriza
N'okusaasira-okungi.
Mujje mwenna!
Abayita temutya.

title: MUJJE MWENNA ABAKOOYE
text:
Temutya,newankubadde 
Ng'ebibi byammwe bingi.
Ky'abakuutira kye kino-
Mwenenye musonyiyibwe;
Omwoyo we
Ye anaabatukuza.

title: MUJJE MWENNA ABAKOOYE
text:
Laba! Omwana wa Katonda 
Leero-abawolereza,
Lwa musaayi-gwe munaawona
Bwe mwesigira ddala:
Ekisa kye 
Ekirokola kyokka.

title: MUJJE MWENNA ABAKOOYE
text:
Abatukuvu be bonna
Bamusinza n'essanyu;
Ab'ensi n'ab'omu ggulu
Bayimba-amatendo ge:
Aleruuya!

text:
