TWAGALANE;-OKWAGALA
text:
TWAGALANE-; okwagala
Kwe kuva-eri Katonda:
Kale,ffe-abooluganda,
Tube nnyo n'okwagala.

title: TWAGALANE;-OKWAGALA
text:
Twagalanenga;twagalanenga;
Twagalanenga;Katonda kwagala.

title: TWAGALANE;-OKWAGALA
text:
Twali tulina-ebibi 
Yesu n'afa ku muti:
Oyo gwe yafiirira,
Ffe tunaaakyawa tutya?

title: TWAGALANE;-OKWAGALA
text:
Twagalanenga;twagalanenga;
Twagalanenga;Katonda kwagala.

title: TWAGALANE;-OKWAGALA
text:
Bonna ffe tubaagale,
Twagale-abatukyaye 
N'abo abalina-ebibi 
Twagalenga bwagazi.

title: TWAGALANE;-OKWAGALA
text:
Twagalanenga;twagalanenga;
Twagalanenga;Katonda kwagala.

title: TWAGALANE;-OKWAGALA
text:
Kale-ekisa mu myoyo 
Kyakenga ng'omuliro;
Kyokere ddala byonna 
Ebitali bya kisa.

title: TWAGALANE;-OKWAGALA
text:
Twagalanenga;twagalanenga;
Twagalanenga;Katonda kwagala.

title: TEMUSOOKANGA KUNOONYA
text:
TEMUSOOKANGA kunoonya
Ssanyu na bugagga bwa nsi,
Na kwesiima kwa mubiri
Biriggwaawo-,biriggwaawo-.

title: TEMUSOOKANGA KUNOONYA
text:
Temusookanga-kunoonya 
Bwami bwa nsi na kitiibwa:
Oliba-oli-awo mangwago 
Ne biggwaawo-,ne biggwaawo-.

title: TEMUSOOKANGA KUNOONYA
text:
Temusookanga kunoonya 
Bisusunku na birerya 
Ebitali bya Katonda:
Bisusunku na birerya 
Ebitali bya Katonda:
Biriggwaawo-,birigwaawo-.

title: TEMUSOOKANGA KUNOONYA
text:
Mmwe musookenga-okunoonya 
Obwakabaka bwa Katonda:
Ekisa kye-eky'ekitalo
Tekiggwaawo-,tekiggwaawo-.

title: TEMUSOOKANGA KUNOONYA
text:
Mmwe musookenga-okunoonya 
Obulokozi bw'abantu:
Mubaleete eri Yesu;
Tebuggwaawo-,tebuggwaaawo-.

title: TEMUSOOKANGA KUNOONYA
text:
Ebyo bye muba munoonya,
Muliweeebwa bye yagamba:,
Muliweebwa-eby'omu ggulu 
Tebiggwaawo-,tebiggwaawo-.

title: MU NSI Y'ABAGENYI
text:
MU nsi y'abagenyi,
Gye wagenda ggwe,
Wulira-eddoboozi
-Enkuyita:

title: MU NSI Y'ABAGENYI
text:
Komaw(o) omutambuze 
Komawo mangu,
Ggwe wakyamira ddala,
Naye jjangu.

title: MU NSI Y'ABAGENYI
text:
Enjala-ey'omwoyo 
Ekuluma nnyo 
Tolina mukwano,
Oli muyi.

title: MU NSI Y'ABAGENYI
text:
Komaw(o) omutambuze 
Komawo mangu,
Ggwe wakyamira ddala,
Naye jjangu.

title: MU NSI Y'ABAGENYI
text:
Ebibi byo byonna 
Lekera ddala,
Gye ndi kye kitiibwa,
N'essanyu nnyo.

title: MU NSI Y'ABAGENYI
text:
Komaw(o) omutambuze 
Komawo mangu,
Ggwe wakyamira ddala,
Naye jjangu.

title: MU NSI Y'ABAGENYI
text:
Oluggi luggule,
Okyali wange,
Tojja kugobebwa,
Siikunyoome.

title: MU NSI Y'ABAGENYI
text:
Komaw(o) omutambuze 
Komawo mangu,
Ggwe wakyamira ddala,
Naye jjangu.

title: MU NSI Y'ABAGENYI
text:
Byonna bye wakola,
Nnakusonyiwa,
Nnakusonyiwa,
Nnawaayo-obulamu 
Ne mbiriwa.

title: MU NSI Y'ABAGENYI
text:
Komaw(o) omutambuze 
Komawo mangu,
Ggwe wakyamira ddala,
Naye jjangu.

title: MU NSI Y'ABAGENYI
text:
Laba-emmeza yange 
Etegekeddwa,
Jjangu naakuliisa 
Nze-akwagala.

title: MU NSI Y'ABAGENYI
text:
Komaw(o) omutambuze 
Komawo mangu,
Ggwe wakyamira ddala,
Naye jjangu.

title: AYI YESU-OW'EKISA
text:
AYI Yesu-ow'ekisa
Ggwe bulamu-obw'abantu,
Omutonzi wa byonna,
Otuwulire.

title: AYI YESU-OW'EKISA
text:
Ebibi bwe byabunya 
Ku bantu bonna-okufa 
Ggwe eyabalokola,
Otusonyiwe.

title: AYI YESU-OW'EKISA
text:
Ggwe-eyalinnya mu ggulu 
-Okulya-obwakabaka bwo,
Mukama w'abakama,
Otuwulire.

title: AYI YESU-OW'EKISA
text:
Ggwe-olikomawo nate 
Okusala-omusango 
Gw'abalamu n'abafu,
Otulokole

title: NZE NKUTUNUULIDDE
text:
NZE nkutunuulidde
N'amaaso g'omwoyo,
Mulokozi.
Ompulire leero,
Onnaazeko-ebibi,
Ontuule-omwana wo
Omwesigwa.

title: NZE NKUTUNUULIDDE
text:
Ekisa kyo kimpe,
Kindeetere-amaanyi
Ag'omwoyo.
Ggwe eyafiirira,
Onjijukizenga 
-Ekisa kyo bwe kiri 
Ekinkuuma.

title: NZE NKUTUNUULIDDE
text:
Bwe mba nkyatambula,
Mu nsi,neetooloddwa 
-Ebibi bingi:
Naye ggwe-onsaasire 
Mu nzikiza muno:
-Onjakize lwa kisa 
Omusana.

title: NZE NKUTUNUULIDDE
text:
Era ne bwe ndiba 
Nga ntuusiza-okufa,
Tondekanga:
-Onkwatenga mu ngalo,
Nneme-okukankana:
Ontwale ewuwo 
Nga ndokose.

title: KA NKWAGALE KATONDA;SIYINZA
text:
KA nkwagale Katond;siyinza
Kwerokola lwa kwagala kwange;
Kuba-ebibi byange nnakusobya
So ne sisaanira mukisa gwo.

title: KA NKWAGALE KATONDA;SIYINZA
KA NKWAGALE KATONDA;SIYINZA
text:
-Obulumi bwo tebulowoozeka,
So tewali mu baana b'abantu 
Ayinza-okwelesa-obuyinike 
Newankubadde-ennaku zo zonna.

title: KA NKWAGALE KATONDA;SIYINZA
text:
Bye walumwa tebikomezeka,
Byonna ku lwange nze-alina-ebibi,
Wava ku ntebe y'ekitiibwa kyo,
Okumponya-atali mulongoofu.

title: KA NKWAGALE KATONDA;SIYINZA
text:
Yesu,siiremenga kukwagala 
-omulokozi,nga bwe wanjagala;
Ggwe kennyini so si birabo byo,
Ggwe njagala obutayosaawo.

title: MU BIRO-EBY'ENNAKU
text:
MU biro-eby'ennaku
Yesu-onnyambenga
Nneme-okugwa wansi,
Nga nkwerabidde.
Bwe mba mbuusabuusa,
Ontunuulire,
Ompanirirenga
Olw'amaanyi go.

title: MU BIRO-EBY'ENNAKU
text:
Enkwe za Ssetaani 
Ze zinnumba-ennyo,
Obugagga-obw'ensi 
Businza-omwoyo 
Ka njijukireggwe 
Eyafiirira:
Ggwe-oli kigo kyange 
Mwe neekweka nze.

title: MU BIRO-EBY'ENNAKU
text:
Yesu bw'onoobanga 
Onkangavvula,
Byonna-ebijja ku nze 
Ka mbikkirize;
Neewaayo nze gy'oli 
Ndi wuwo wekka,
-Ontukuze,ombeere,
Ennaku zonna.

title: MU BIRO-EBY'ENNAKU
text:
Mu ntalo-ez'entiisa 
Nkwesiga wekka 
Bwe ndinafuwala,
Ojjanga gye ndi;
Omubiri gwange 
Ne bwe gulifa,
-Onzuukize mu bafu 
Nze-akweyabiza.

title: KITAAWE WA BONNA-ERI GGWE
text:
KITAAWE wa bonna-eri ggwe,
Tuyimusa-emitima gyaffe:
Ku bwa Yesu,lye-ekkubo lyaffe
Eritutuusa mu maaso go;
Ofuke emikisa gyo
Ku ffe abafukamidde.

title: KITAAWE WA BONNA-ERI GGWE
text:
Kitaawe wa bonna-eri ggwe,
Tuyimusa emyoyo gyaffe,
Abeenenyezza-ebibi byaffe,
Abatamanya kukutenda;
Otujjuze Omwoyo wo,
Tukuyimbire-amatendo.

title: KITAAWE WA BONNA-ERI GGWE
text:
Kitaawe wa bonna-eri ggwe,
Tukuleetera-okutya kwaffe,
Okutalabibwa bannaffe 
Naye okumanyibwa gy'oli;
Otukwate ku mukono 
Tulemenga okubungeeta.

title: KITAAWE WA BONNA-ERI GGWE
text:
Kitaawe wa bonna-,otuwe,
Okukutenderezanga-ennyo;
Tusanyukirenga Mukama 
Ffe abantu be-abalokole.
Mu biro byonna-otulage 
-Ekkubo-eddungi-eridda gy'oli.

title: ZUUKUKA MWOYO GWANGE
text:
ZUUKUKA mwoyo gwange,
Katonda-akusembeza,
Taakugobere bweru,
Akwagalira ddala.

title: ZUUKUKA MWOYO GWANGE
text:
Gw'osaba ye Kabaka 
Omuyinza wa byonna,
-Okumukooyesa teri 
Olw'ekisa kye-ekingi.

title: ZUUKUKA MWOYO GWANGE
text:
Yesu,sooka-ontikkule 
Omugugu ogw'ebibi,
Ogunzitoowerera,
Gwe sijja kusobola.

title: ZUUKUKA MWOYO GWANGE
text:
Mu musaayi-ogwayiika
Edda ku musaalaba;
Ku lw'abalina-ebibi,
Yesu,-onnaalize ddala.

title: ZUUKUKA MWOYO GWANGE
text:
Nkooye nnyo,ompummuze 
Weemale-omwoyo gwange,
Njagala-Omulokozi 
Anammalamu-ebibi.

title: ZUUKUKA MWOYO GWANGE
text:
Bwe ntyo bwe nkuyimbira 
Bulijjo ettendo lyo;
Abakwesiga wekka,
Baliraba-ekisa kyo

title: ENSUNU NGA BW'EWEEVUUMA
text:
ENSUNU nga bw'eweevuuma,
Ne yeegomba amazzi,
Bwe bagiyigga ewala-ennyo,
Bwe ntyo bwe nsinda nze.

title: ENSUNU NGA BW'EWEEVUUMA
text:
Neegomba-amzzi g'obulamu 
Agava waggulu;
Omwoyo ne gunnuma nnyo 
Okunywa,nzikute.

title: ENSUNU NGA BW'EWEEVUUMA
text:
Ka ngume omwoyo;Yesu 
Ye wa kisa kyonna;
Taalemenga kunsanyusa,
Bwe ngumiikiriza.

title: ENSUNU NGA BW'EWEEVUUMA
text:
Eri Katonda Kitaffe,
N'Omwana we Yesu,
N'Omwoyo Omutukuvu,
Esaanidde ettendo

title: MUKAMA-OTUYIGIRIZE
text:
MUKAMA-otuyigirize
-Okusaba-n'okutya,
Twang'anga-abaana b'enfuufu,
-Okukusemberera.

title: MUKAMA-OTUYIGIRIZE
AYI YESU MUKAMA
text:
AYI Yesu Mukama,
Onsonyiwe-ebibi,
Omponye-okwegomba kw'ensi:
Mbeere mulongonfu.

title: AYI YESU MUKAMA
text:
Ayi Yesu Mukama,
Ommalemu okutya,
Mbeere omuddu wo-akwagala,
Ndyoke ntuuke gy'oli.

title: AYI YESU MUKAMA
AYI YESU MUKAMA
text:
Ayi Yesu Mukama,
Ntuusa mu ssanyu lyo;
Mbeerenga eyo mu ggulu,
Emirembe gyonna.

title: YIMIRIRA MU FFE
YIMIRIRA MU FFE
text:
Fuka Omwoyo wo,
Mu mitima gyaffe;
Tugobeemu-okutya 
N'okunakuwala.

title: YIMIRIRA MU FFE
text:
Tulyoke tugende 
Nga tujjudde-essanyu 
Nga tulindirira 
Okukomawo kwo.

title: YESU BULIJJO NKWETAAGA
text:
YESU bulijjo nkwetaaga,
Tondeka bw'omu;
Beera nange ggwe okumoi,
So tonvaamu.

title: YESU BULIJJO NKWETAAGA
text:
Bwe mba nsanyuka nkugamba 
ebinsanyusa;
Era-ombeere okukola,
Ky'oyagala.

title: YESU BULIJJO NKWETAAGA
text:
Bwe mba ndaba-ennaku nnyingi 
Ezintengezza;
Ggwe-ozimanyi ggwe Mukama 
N'onsaasira

title: YESU BULIJJO NKWETAAGA
text:
Bwe mba nsobya ku ggwe Yesu 
Olw'obunafu;
Nsaasira-obunafu bwange 
Ompe-amaanyi.

title: KATONDA-ONSEMBEZE
text:
KATONDA-onsembezw
Kumpi naawe,
Ne bwe ndikwatibwa
-Obuyinike.
Neeyongerenga-era
Okusemberera
-Okumpi naawe.

title: KATONDA-ONSEMBEZE
text:
Obudde-obw'obulamu 
Buwungeera:
So siraba n'omu 
Anambeera,
Nga nkwegayirira 
Olw'ekyo,sembera 
-Okumpi nange.

title: KATONDA-ONSEMBEZE
text:
Kale-okwolesebwa 
Kuve-eri ggwe;
Era-awalinnyibwa 
Walabike.
Nga bamalayika 
Bampenyezza-okujja 
-Okumpi naawe

title: KATONDA-ONSEMBEZE
text:
Kyenva nsanyukira 
Ekisa kyo,
Kubanga-owulira 
Omuddu wo
Katonda tondeka,
Nga mbulubuutira 
-Ewala naawe.

title: KATONDA-ONSEMBEZE
text:
Edda ndiyingira 
Wa Kitange;
Nga nkomekkereza 
-Emgendo zange.
Ekirinsanyusa 
Yesu,kubeerera 
-Awamu naawe.

title: YESU EYASOOKA
text:
YESU eyasooka
Okutwagala;
Saasira-obunafu
Bwaffe-abaddu bo.

title: YESU EYASOOKA
text:
Yesu ggwe muteefu 
Ggwe muwombeefu;
N'obuvumu bungi,
Ffe tujja gy'oli.

title: YESU EYASOOKA
text:
Naye tuli bayi,
Ffe tuyidde nnyo:
Era-ebibi byaffe
Bituyinze nnyo.

title: YESU EYASOOKA
text:
Ggwe Ayinza-byonna,
Otuwe-amaanyi 
Okuwangulanga 
Mu kukemebwa.

title: YESU EYASOOKA
text:
Tuli bagayaavu;
Ggwe munyiikivu 
Tuwe-fenna-amaanyi,
Okunyiikira.

title: YESU EYASOOKA
text:
Tuli banafu nnyo,
Ggwe-oli wa maanyi;
Otunywerezenga 
Mu mazima go.

title: YESU EYASOOKA
text:
Ggwe mubeezi waffe,
Otuzibire 
Eri omulabe 
Eri omulabe 
Waffe Ssetaani.

title: YESU EYASOOKA
text:
Tukweyanza Yesu,
Ggwe-atujuna-ennyo:
Otuwe Omwoyo 
Omutukuvu.

title: OMUYAGA GWALI GUWUUMA
text:
OMUYAGA gwali guwuuma,
-Abatume ne bakankana;
Naye wali nga weebase,
Ng'okooye.

title: OMUYAGA GWALI GUWUUMA
text: Baakuyita,-Otusaasire,

title: OMUYAGA GWALI GUWUUMA
text:
Tolaba nga tufa bufi?
-Ekigambo kyo kyawulirwa:
Muteeke.

title: OMUYAGA GWALI GUWUUMA
text:
Empewo ne zisirika,
Ennyanja n'ebeera nteefu,
-Omuyaga nga guwulidde 
-Eddoboozi lyo.

title: OMUYAGA GWALI GUWUUMA
text:
Bwe tutyo ffe tukwatibwa 
Entiisa nnyingi bulijjo;
Ennaku bwe zitujjira 
Nga-omuyaga.

title: YESU KINO KYE NJAGALA
text:
YESU kino kye njagala,
Omwoyo nga gugwo;
-Omugonvu n'omuwombeefu,
Ogukukkiriza.

title: YESU KINO KYE NJAGALA
text:
Era-omwoyo-oguwulira 
-Ebiragiro byonna;
Mukama mw'anaatuulanga 
Okugusanyusa.

title: YESU KINO KYE NJAGALA
text:
Omwoyo ogunaazibwa 
-Omusaayi gwa Yesu;
Ogutabeeramu kibi,
Ogujjudde-ekisa.

title: YESU KINO KYE NJAGALA
text:
Omwoyo-ogwenkaniddaawo 
Ogumpe Katonda;
Oneemale nze kaakati,
Onfugire ddala.

title: KATONDA EYANTONDA NZE
text:
KATONDA eyantonda nze
Mu mubiri-omwangu;
Ndyoke nnyinze-okusobola
-Okutambula wonna;
Singa mbuliddwa-amagezi,
Naye mujjukira
Mu mutima ogw'essanyu
Ng'omwana omuto.

title: KATONDA EYANTONDA NZE
text:
Yesu Kabaka, Mukama;
Ompe-ekitala kyo 
Ekyangu era ekyogi 
Nnwanyise-abalabe;
Ndyoke mbawangule abo,
Era nkuweereze 
-Emisana era n'ekiro,
Mbeerenga-omusajja.

title: KATONDA EYANTONDA NZE
text:
Omwoyo ogw'amazima 
Oguwa-omubiri 
-Essanyu mu kifo ky'ennyombo,
-Omusana-omulungi;
Amagezi nga gambuze 
Ojje embeerenga;
Ompe ekirabo kino 
-Otwale-omwoyo gwange.

title: KITAFFE-ATWAGALA FENNA
text:
KITAFFE-atwagala fenna,
-Oyambenga-abaana bo;
Bakuumenga-ennaku zonna
-Obusika-obulungi.

title: KITAFFE-ATWAGALA FENNA
text:
Twetikke-omusaalaba gwo 
N'obwesigwa bwonna;
-Amazima gobunenga 
Mu mawanga gonna.

title: KITAFFE-ATWAGALA FENNA
text:
Tuwe twegenderezenga 
Tube balongoofu;
-Essaddaaka-ey'obuntu bwaffe 
Esiimibwe gy'oli.

title: KITAFFE-ATWAGALA FENNA
text:
Tuwe okwesiganga ggwe,
-Omulamuzi waffe;
-Ensonyi n'entiisa bireme 
Kutukwata fenna.

title: KITAFFE-ATWAGALA FENNA
text:
Tuwe-amaanyi n'obuvumu 
Ebituyinzisa 
-Okuyamba bonna-ab'ennaku 
N'obutabajooga.

title: KITAFFE-ATWAGALA FENNA
text:
Tuwe-okusonyiwagana 
N'okwagala bonna;
Tube n'essanyu lingi nnyo 
Eriva eri ggwe.

title: MUKAMA WAFFE-OW'EKISA
text:
MUKAMA waffe-ow'ekisa,
Tusonyiwe fenna;
-Ebirowoozo-ebitukuvu
N'empisa ezisaanira
-Otujjuzenga fenna.

title: MUKAMA WAFFE-OW'EKISA
text:
Ku nnyanja,abtume bo 
Baakuwuliranga;
Fenna fenna tusituke 
Era tukugoberere 
Amangu nga bali.

title: MUKAMA WAFFE-OW'EKISA
text:
Tujjukira ennyanja eyo 
N'ensozi ennungi;
Yesu kwe yafukamira 
Ng'asba-eri Katonda we 
Atwagala fenna.

title: MUKAMA WAFFE-OW'EKISA
text:
Otereeze-emyoyo gyaffe 
Ennaku ziggweewo;
-Emitima nga giteredde 
gijjukire-emirembe gyo
Egitasingika.

title: MUKAMA WAFFE-OW'EKISA
text:
Era okwegomba kwaffe 
Kumalibwe mu ggwe;
Eby'omubiri n'eby'ensi 
Bisirike,tuwulire,
By'oyogera naffe.

title: SIYINZA,AYI-OMULOKOZI
text:
SIYINZA,Ayi-Omulokozi
Ow'ekitiibwa-ennyo
Siyinza,nze-omuntu-omubi
Kusuuta-erinnya lyo:
Mu ggulu bamalayika
N'abaanunulibwa
Basinza bulijjo,naye
Simanyi,nsirika.

title: SIYINZA,AYI-OMULOKOZI
text:
Jjangu,-Omwoyo-Omutukuvu,
Onjigirize nze 
Ekitibwa kyo n'okutya,
N'obutuukirivu;
Bwe ntyo bwe nsaanira ddala 
-Okuyimba-ettendo lyo 
Awamu n'abatukuvu 
Ne bamalayika.

title: WULIRA-OKUSABA KWANGE
text:
WULIRA-okusaba kwange,
Okw'omwana wo-omuto nze,
Fuka ebirabo byo,
Fuka ku nze bulijjo:
Ssasira-omunafu bwange
Obw'omwana wo-omuto nze
Saasira-omunafu nze;
Nsaasiranga bulijjo.

title: WULIRA-OKUSABA KWANGE
WULIRA-OKUSABA KWANGE
text:
Kkiriza omwoyo gwange 
Gwe nkuwadde-okugukuuma;
Nsanyuse n'ekisa kyo,
Nsanyusanga bulijjo:
Olw'obwesigwa bwo bwonna,
Ayi Katonda,onnyambenga;
Mbeere gy'oli omwesigwa.
Onnyambenga bulijjo.

title: AYI KITAFFE-OW'OMU GGULU
text:
AYI Kitaffe-ow'omu ggulu
Leero twewaayo gy'oli;
Mu nsi eno-ejjudde-ennaku
Kuuma-obulamu bwaffe
Tewali mubeezi yenna
Wabula ggwe Kitaffe.

title: AYI KITAFFE-OW'OMU GGULU
text:
Ayi Mukama waffe Yesu,
Tusaba-otusonyiwe 
Kubanga-obunafu bwaffe 
Gggwe-obumanyidde ddala;
Omanyi bwe buli-obungi 
Otusnyiwe Yesu.

title: AYI KITAFFE-OW'OMU GGULU
text:
Naawe-Omwoyo-Omutukuvu 
Kka leero mu nda zaffe 
Tujjuze okwagala kwo 
Okw'enkalakkalira,
Tunaabeera n'emirembe,
Ng'otusonyiwa-ebibi.

title: OTUKULEMBERE, MUSUMBA WAFFE
text:
OTUKULEMBERE,Musumba waffe
Tukwetaaga bulijjo;
-Otugalamize mu ddundiro lyo
Ery'omuddo omuto.
Watugula n'omusaayi-gwo
Otukuume mu kabi;
Watugula n'omusaayi-gwo
Otukuume mu kabi.

title: OTUKULEMBERE, MUSUMBA WAFFE
text:
Tuli baana bo-otuzibirenga 
Mu balabe ab'-amaanyi 
Otuyingize mu kisibo kyo 
Mwe tubeera-obulungi.
Nga bwe tukaabirira ggwe 
Otuwulire mangu.

title: OTUKULEMBERE, MUSUMBA WAFFE
text:
Ajja gye ndi;bwe wagamba bw'otyo 
Siimugobere bweru, 
Okomyewo emitima gyaffe 
Otunaaze mu bibi.
-Otulumgaamye mu makubo 
Ag'obutuukirivu;
-Otulumgamye mu makubo 
Ag'obutuukirivu.

title: MUKAMA GGWE-OMUFUZI WA BYONNA
text:
MUKAMA ggwe-Omufuzi wa byonna,
Bye wakola bikusuuta byonna.
Ggwe-Omukuumi w'amawanga gonna,
Ogamulisizza-omusana gwo.
Fuga-emyoyo gyaffe,Ayi Mukama,
Tukuume-era-otuwe amaanyi go.

title: MUKAMA GGWE-OMUFUZI WA BYONNA
text:
Ffe-abaana bo b'oyagala ennyo,
B'ogaase awamu n'Omwana wo,
Naawe-Omwoyo-Omutukuvu jjangu 
Tugatte fenna mu mwoyo gyaffe 
Tubeerenga mu ggwe omu wekka;
Fenna twagalanenga bulijjo.

title: MUKAMA GGWE-OMUFUZI WA BYONNA
text:
Tuwe tukyawe obubi bwonna,
Twagalenga-ebyo ebisaanira.
Essanyu lyaffe lituukirire,
-Obuyinike bwaffe-obumalewo.
Gabira-abaana bo amaanyi go 
Tukugoberere n'amazima.

title: MUKAMA GGWE-OMUFUZI WA BYONNA
text:
Ayi Mukama,-otwambaze amaanyi go 
Tube-abasserikale bo leero.
Tujjuze-amaanyi g'ekigambo kyo 
Tuwangule mu lutalo lwaffe 
Wanirira obuzibu bwaffe.
Tuleme oktya entiisa yonna.

title: MUKAMA GGWE NGABO YAFFE
text:
MUKAMA ggwe ngabo yaffe,
Ggwe musana gw'ensi;
Ggwe wekka okeesa-obudde
Era ggwe-obuzibya.

title: MUKAMA GGWE NGABO YAFFE
text:
Tuwaayo gy'oli ssadddaaka-,
Ey'okwebaza kwaffe;
Era tusaba-otukuume 
Okuzibya obudde.

title: MUKAMA GGWE NGABO YAFFE
text:
Tusonyiwe bye tusobya,
ffe-abaana b'abantu;
Tuma Omwoyo-ow'ekisa 
Ajje mu nda zaffe.

title: AYI KATONDA WAFFE
text:
AYI Katonda waffe
Ggwe watonda ffe,
Naye twakuvaako
Dda,ne twonoona.

title: AYI KATONDA WAFFE
text:
Ayi Katonda waffe,
Twakujeemera;
Naye tukusinza 
Tuli baana bo.

title: AYI KATONDA WAFFE
text:
Ayi Katonda waffe,
Watusaasira;
Twebaze ggwe leero,
Olw'okutwagala.

title: AYI KATONDA WAFFE
text:
Ayi Mukama waffe.
watununula;
Twagala-okukusenga 
Tukuweereze.

title: AYI KATONDA WAFFE
text:
Ayi Mukama waffe,
Twali bajeemu;
Naye otusenze,
Tube-abaddu bo.

title: AYI KATONDA WAFFE
text:
Ayi Katonda-,Omwoyo 
Omutukuvu,
Fenna otukuume,
Leero mu bibi.

YESU,LEERO NKUKOOWOOLA
text:

Mala gasenza nze:

text:

title: YESU,LEERO NKUKOOWOOLA
text:
Nze nkuvuunamidde leero 
Neewaayo mu mikono gyo:
Mukama,nze ndi muddu wo:

title: YESU,LEERO NKUKOOWOOLA
text:
Yesu nkusenze ggwe:
Yesu nkusenze ggwe:
(O)musaa(yi) gwo gwe gundokodde:
Yesu nkusenze ggwe.

title: YESU NJIJA GY'OLI
text:
YESU njija gy'oli,
Nga nsuubira,
Nkufukaamirira,
Nga nkwesiga;
Njijudde nnyo-ebibi,
Naye kye mpoza nti:
Wanfiirira.

title: YESU NJIJA GY'OLI
text:
Mukama njatula 
Ebyonoono;
Ne nkubikkulira 
Ebibi byange.
Jjangu onnongoose 
Onnalize ddala,
Ontukuze.

title: YESU NJIJA GY'OLI
text:
Yesu-otusonyiwe 
Ggwe-omwesigwa 
Laba,nfukamidde 
Mu maaso go.
Onnaze mu musaayi-,
Ggwe-Omwana gw'endiga 
Wa Katonda.

title: YESU NJIJA GY'OLI
text:
Ne nyoka nsanyuka 
Nga ndokose,
Nze ne ntambulira 
Wamu naawe.
Ne bwe ndizirika,
Ggwe-olimpanirira 
Nneme-okugwa.

title: ONNUMIRIZE OLW'EBIBI
text:
ONNUMIRIZE olw'ebibi
Mwoyo Mutukuvu;
Eby'omu bulamu bwange
Byerulibwe mangu.

title: ONNUMIRIZE OLW'EBIBI
text:
Yesu amaanyi ebyama,
N'esulo-ez'omu nda 
Ez'ebirowoozo bynge,
Ozimbikkulire.

title: ONNUMIRIZE OLW'EBIBI
text:
Onjakize-omusana gwo,
Ommulise mu nda,
Ommanyise-ebibi byange 
Byonna-ebikisibwa.

title: ONNUMIRIZE OLW'EBIBI
ONNUMIRIZE OLW'EBIBI
text:
Bwe ntyo bwe ndifukamira 
Mu maaso ga Yesu,
Naakwebalizanga ddala,
Nga neewombeese nnyo

title: SIYINZA N'AKATONO
SIYINZA N'AKATONO
text:
Nze ndi munafu ddala.
Amaanyi gampweddemu;
So sirina magezi,
Ekkubo limbuze.
Beera-Omusaale wange,
Mu masamganzira,
Bw'onkwata n'omukono 
Ndituuka-emirembe.

title: SIYINZA N'AKATONO
text:
Siyinza n'akatono,
Kutambula nzekka;
Ggwe-oli Mubeezi wange 
Mu biro-eby'ennaku:
Ggwe tonjabuliranga,
Nneme-okubungeeta,
Siritya kabi konna,
Mu ntuuko-ez'okufa

title: GGWE-OMANYI YESU OBUKOOWU BWAFFE
text:
GGWE-omanyi Yesu obukoowu bwaffe,
Otegedde byonna-ebikwekeddwa;
Tukemggentereddwa-abalabe bangi,
Ggwe wekka-,oli kiddukiro kyaffe
Tuzze gy'oli,oyise ffe-abanaku
Kubanga-ebyama byonna-obimanyi.

title: GGWE-OMANYI YESU OBUKOOWU BWAFFE
text:
Ggwe-omanyi ebibi byaffe-ebyabaawo 
Bwe twakujeemera,bwe twabula;
Twawaba nnyo ng'endiga-ezisaasaana,
Twali tuzaaye n'otuzaawula.
Ggwe-eyanyiga-ebiwundu byaffe byonna 
N'otuwa-amaanyi,otusaasire.

title: GGWE-OMANYI YESU OBUKOOWU BWAFFE
text:
Ggwe-omanyi byonna-,ebiriwo kaakano 
Omulabe waffe bw'atukema-ennyo 
Entalo ze tulwana zituyinze,
Twetaaga ggwe,-ekiddukiro kyaffe.
Be twagala nabo banakuwala,
N'ensi-eno-oluusi tetusanyusa.

title: GGWE-OMANYI YESU OBUKOOWU BWAFFE
text:
Ggwe-omanyi byonna-,ebigenda-okubaawo,
Oluusi ssanyu,oluusi nnaku;
tunoonya bye tutayinza kufuna,
Naye gy'oli tujjula essanyu,
Obudde bw'obulamu buwungeera 
Era-okufa kutusemberera 
Era-okufa kutusemberera.

title: GGWE-OMANYI YESU OBUKOOWU BWAFFE
text:
Kyovudde-omanya byonna-ebituluma,
Kubanga watwala-obuntu bwaffe,
Mu nsi baakuyitanga ow'ennaku,
Era-eyamanyiira-obuyinike.
Kyetuvudde twanmgganga-okujja gy'oli,
Tufune amaanyi ge twetaaga.

title: GGWE-ASUUTIBWA BULI MUNTU
EKITIIBWA KYO KINENE
text:
EKITIIBWA kyo kinene,
Omununuzi waffe;
Emimwa gy'abantu bonna
Giyimba-ettendo lyo!

title: EKITIIBWA KYO KINENE
text:
Erinnya lya Yesu ddungi 
Limalawo-okutya;
Lituleetera-obulamu 
N'emirembe mu nda.

title: EKITIIBWA KYO KINENE
text:
Amaanyi g'ekibi gonna 
Yesu yagamenya;
Ffe abaali abasibe 
Twafuuka ba ddembe!

title: EKITIIBWA KYO KINENE
text:
Buli akkiriza Yesu 
Alirokolebwa;
N'abo abaafiira mu ye 
Kaakano balamu!

title: EKITIIBWA KYO KINENE
text:
Muwulire mmwe-abanaku 
Nammwe bakasiru,
Bwe munaasembera gy'ali 
Munaawonyezebwa!

title: EKITIIBWA KYO KINENE
text:
Mukama waffe-ow'ekisa 
Tukwegayirira,
Otuyigirize fenna 
Okukusuutanga.

title: ABAALUMWA-EMISOTA-ABAYISIRAYIRI
text:
ABAALUMWA-emisota-Abayisirayiri.
Mu lukoola bwe baatambula;
Buli muntu yawona eyatunnuulira
Omusota ogwo ku muti.

title: ABAALUMWA-EMISOTA-ABAYISIRAYIRI
text:
Mutunule:munaawona mwenna,bwe mukkiriza Yesu:
Munaawona kaakano mwenna.

title: ABAALUMWA-EMISOTA-ABAYISIRAYIRI
text:
Temulwa,mumutunuulire Mulokozi,
Mmwe mwenna abalumwa-ebibi:
Munaawona mwenna bwe mukkiriza Yesu,
Eyatufiirira ku muti.

title: ABAALUMWA-EMISOTA-ABAYISIRAYIRI
text:
Mutunule:munaawona mwenna,bwe mukkiriza Yesu:
Munaawona kaakano mwenna.

title: ABAALUMWA-EMISOTA-ABAYISIRAYIRI
text:
Naye ku lw'ebikolwa ebituukirivu,
Temuyinza kulokolebwa:
Abisiima Katonda,naye tebiyinza 
Kutuggyako-omusango gwaffe.

title: ABAALUMWA-EMISOTA-ABAYISIRAYIRI
text:
Mutunule:munaawona mwenna,bwe mukkiriza Yesu:
Munaawona kaakano mwenna.

title: ABAALUMWA-EMISOTA-ABAYISIRAYIRI
text:
Naye ku lw'okufa kwe ku muti ku lwaffe 
Tulibera-abalamu mu ye;
Tulisanyuka bwe tusonyiyibwa-ebibi,
Ne tutuuka mu ggulu fenna.

title: ABAALUMWA-EMISOTA-ABAYISIRAYIRI
text:
Mutunule:munaawona mwenna,bwe mukkiriza Yesu:
Munaawona kaakano mwenna.

title: YESU YAJJA ALOKOLE
text:
YESU yajja alokole
Abalina-ebibi:
Naffe fenna aboonoonyi
Anaatusonyiwa.

title: YESU YAJJA ALOKOLE
text:
Neeyanz(e)nno Yesu ku lw'okwagal(a) okunene,
Ne ndaba-essanyu lingi nnyo,
Kubanga ndokose.

title: YESU YAJJA ALOKOLE
text:
Tegwatuyiikira-omusaayi-
Ogusinga byonna?
Tewali gw'atayinza ye 
Okulongoosa-ennyo.

title: YESU YAJJA ALOKOLE
text:
Neeyanz(e)nno Yesu ku lw'okwagal(a) okunene,
Ne ndaba-essanyu lingi nnyo,
Kubanga ndokose.

title: YESU YAJJA ALOKOLE
text:
Tetuyinza ffe-okwetuusa 
Mu ggulu n'akamu:
Mu kifo-ekyo mulituuka 
Abatuukirivu.

title: YESU YAJJA ALOKOLE
text:
Neeyanz(e)nno Yesu ku lw'okwagal(a) okunene,
Ne ndaba-essanyu lingi nnyo,
Kubanga ndokose.

title: YESU YAJJA ALOKOLE
text:
Naye bwe tumukkiriza 
Katonda Kitaffe 
Atulaba ng'abalina 
Obutuukirivu.

title: YESU YAJJA ALOKOLE
text:
Neeyanz(e)nno Yesu ku lw'okwagal(a) okunene,
Ne ndaba-essanyu lingi nnyo,
Kubanga ndokose.

title: YESU YAJJA ALOKOLE
text:
Mukale mumukkirize
Muweebwe-obulamu:
Kubanga Yesu tagoba 
Mu maaso ge n'omu.

title: YESU YAJJA ALOKOLE
text:
Neeyanz(e)nno Yesu ku lw'okwagal(a) okunene,
 Ne ndaba-essanyu lingi nnyo,
 Kubanga ndokose.

title: YESU-AMANYI BWE MBEERA
text:
YESU-amanyi bwe mbeera
N'ebirowoozo byonna
N'obunafu bwange-era,
Byonna ye abimanyi.

title: YESU-AMANYI BWE MBEERA
text:
Ng'omuzadde w'omwana 
Bw'asaasira-omwana we,
Yesu bw'asaasira nze 
Mu-ebyo byonna bye nkola.

title: YESU-AMANYI BWE MBEERA
text:
Yesu fenna-atwagala 
Abakulu n'abato;
Anaatusonyiwanga 
Bwe tuba twenenyezza.

title: YESU-AMANYI BWE MBEERA
text:
Weenenye ggwe-omwonoonyi 
Ye anaakusonyiwa;
Omusembeze gy'oli 
Mwenenyereze ddala.

title: YESU-AMANYI BWE MBEERA
text:
Ojja kulokolebwa 
Mu bibi byo-ebyo byonna;
Teweeraliikirira,
Ali kumpi nnyo naawe.

title: MWENNA MUSANYUKE LEERO
MWENNA MUSANYUKE LEERO
text:
Bwe twali tuli mu kabi,
Yawulira bwe tusinda;
Tumwesigenga bulijjo,
Okwagala kwe kuyamba.
Tuyimuse gy'ali 
Emitima gyaffe,
Nga bonna bayimba,
Mutenderezenga:
Mmw(e) abatukuvu musuute!

title: MWENNA MUSANYUKE LEERO
text:
Mwenna musanyuke leero 
Muyimbe n'okujaguza,
Mmwe mumutunde Mukama 
Wa maanyi,Omulokozi:
By'okola biraga 
Erinnya lye-eddungi;

title: KATONDA TUKUTENDA GGWE
text:
KATONDA tukutenda ggwe;
Tukkiriza-obukama bwo;
Aleruuya! Aleruuya!
Ayi Kitaffe ataggwaawo,
Ensi zonna zikusinza:
Aleruuya! Aleruuya!
Aleruuya! Aleruuya! Aleruuya!

title: KATONDA TUKUTENDA GGWE
text:
Abakukoowoola ennyo,
Be bamalayika bonna:
Aleruuya! Aleruuya!
Basseraafi,Bakkerubi,
N'obuyinza-obw'omu ggulu:
Aleruuya! Aleruuya! 
Aleruuya! Aleruuya! Aleruuya!

title: KATONDA TUKUTENDA GGWE
text:
Mutukuvu,Mutukuvu,
Mutukuvu,Omugabe;
Aleruuya! Aleruuya!
Mukama ow'egye lyonna,
Kitiibwa kyo kyala wonna.
Aleruuya! Aleruuya! 
Aleruuya! Aleruuya! Aleruuya!

title: KATONDA TUKUTENDA GGWE
text:
Ekibiina-ekya batume 
Ekyayatiikirira-ennyo:
Aleruuya! Aleruuya! 
Ab'ekibiina-ekirungi 
Ekya Banabbi ab'edda:
Aleruuya! Aleruuya! 
Aleruuya! Aleruuya! Aleruuya!

title: KATONDA TUKUTENDA GGWE
text:
Abattibwa ku lwa Yesu 
Nabo bayimba-ettendo lye:
Aleruuya! Aleruuya! 
Ekkanisa entukuvu 
Mu nsi zonna ekwatula:
Aleruuya! Aleruuya! 
Aleruuya! Aleruuya! Aleruuya!

title: KATONDA TUKUTENDA GGWE
text:
Kitaffe ggwe-omukulu-ennyo;
Omwana wo ow'ekitiibwa:
Aleruuya! Aleruuya! 
N'omwoyo Omutukuvu,
Obusatu-obw'ekitiibwa:
Aleruuya! Aleruuya! 
Aleruuya! Aleruuya! Aleruuya!

title: KAAKANO TWEBAZA
text:
KAAKANO twebaza,
Katonda-ow'emirembe
Eyatukolera
Ebitusanyusa ffe;
Okuva mu buto
Yatuwa omukisa;
Era-ebirabo bye
Tebitegeezeka.

title: KAAKANO TWEBAZA
text:
Katonda ow'ekisa 
Weemale-emyoyo gyaffe;
Tuwe-emirembe gyo 
Beeranga kumpi naffe,
Otulung'amyenga
Mu kkubo ly'obulamu;
Ffe naawe mu ggulu.
tusanyuke fenna.

title: KAAKANO TWEBAZA
text:
Tweyongere fenna 
Okwebaza Katonda,
Kitaffe,n'Omwana,
N'-Omwoyo Omutukuvu,
Abeererawo-wekka,
Tukuvuunamira,
Ggwe asinzibwa bonna 
Mu nsi ne mu ggulu.

title: EKISA KYA YESU
text:
EKISA kya Yesu,
Kisinga-obulungi:
Kiki-ekyamutufiiriza?
Ekisa kye kingi.

title: EKISA KYA YESU
text:
Yesu ku muti,kwe yanfiirira;
Yesu ye yandokola;neeyanz(a) ekisa kye.

title: EKISA KYA YESU
text:
Mu kisa neeraba 
Nze nga nnina-ebibi;
Era kyennaavanga nteeka 
Byonna Yesu gy'ali.

title: EKISA KYA YESU
text:
Yesu ku muti,kwe yanfiirira;
Yesu ye yandokola;neeyanz(a) ekisa kye.

title: EKISA KYA YESU
text:
Mu kisa nafuna,
-Omutima omuggya;
Kyenvudde nsaba bulijjo 
-Okusiimwa Katonda.

title: EKISA KYA YESU
text:
Yesu ku muti,kwe yanfiirira;
Yesu ye yandokola;neeyanz(a) ekisa kye.

title: EKISA KYA YESU
text:
Mukama,yongera 
Okumpa-ekisa kyo;
Era nze bwe ntyo nnyongere 
-Okukwagala ennyo.

title: EKISA KYA YESU
text:
Yesu ku muti,kwe yanfiirira;
Yesu ye yandokola;neeyanz(a) ekisa kye.

title: MUKAMA BWE YAMGGAMBA NTI
MUKAMA BWE YAMGGAMBA NTI
text:
Mukama bwe yamgamba nti 
Kye nkuwa kya buwa;
Amazzi g'obulamu,nywa,
Ggwe-alumiddwa-ennyonta;
Ne nnywa amazzi-ago,
Ne nzikuta;-omwoyo gyange 
Ne gufuna-amaanyi.

title: MUKAMA BWE YAMGGAMBA NTI
text:
Mukama bwe yamgamba nti 
Ensi-eno-ekutte nnyo;
Tunuulira nze,ofune 
Omusana bulijjo;
Ne mutunuulira Yesu,
Ye ye njuba yange:
So saagala njuba ndala 
Kunjakiranga nze.

title: OMPISE,MUKAMA
text:
OMPISE,Mukama,
Okujjanga gy'oli,
Onnanze n'omusaayi gwo
Ogusinga byonna.

title: OMPISE,MUKAMA
text:
Ka njije,Yesu;ka njije gy'oli:
Nnaaza,nnaaza n'omusaayi

title: OMPISE,MUKAMA
text:
Nange ndi munafu;
Omubi-omwereere:
Ajja gye ndi simugoba
Bwe bwesige bwange.

title: OMPISE,MUKAMA
text:
Ka njije,Yesu;ka njije gy'oli:
Nnaaza,nnaaza n'omusaayi

title: OMPISE,MUKAMA
text:
Yesu,wanfiirira 
Nze alina-ebibi 
Okwagala kumpaludde,
Laba,nzize gy'oli.

title: OMPISE,MUKAMA
text:
Ka njije,Yesu;ka njije gy'oli:
Nnaaza,nnaaza n'omusaayi

title: OMPISE,MUKAMA
text:
Katonda Kitaffe,
Katonda Omwana,
N'Omwoyo Omutukuvu,
Tweyanze bulijjo!
Ka njije,Yesu;ka njije gy'oli:
Nnaaza,nnaaza n'omusaayi

title: BYE TUKUWA BIVA GY'OLI
text:
BYE tukuwa biva gy'oli,
Newankubadde nga bingi;
Bibyo byonna bye tulina,
Birabo by'otuteresa.

title: BYE TUKUWA BIVA GY'OLI
text:
-Otuwe-ekisa tubeerenga 
-Abawanika bo-abeesigwa;
Nga twesolooza n'omwoyo 
Ku bintu bye tuli nabyo.

title: BYE TUKUWA BIVA GY'OLI
text:
-Amawanga gonna-ag'omu nsi 
Geetaaga nnyo-Omulokozi 
Abantu be yafiirira 
Bawaba-era basaasaana.

title: BYE TUKUWA BIVA GY'OLI
text:
Gy'emirimu gyaffe fenna,
-Okukomyawo abakyama;
-Okunoonya-ababula,era 
-Okujjanjaba-abafiiriddwa.

title: BYE TUKUWA BIVA GY'OLI
text:
Bw'atyo Yesu bwe yakola,
Ne yeewaayo-okubawonya;
Naffe tumugoberere,
Aboonoonyi balokoke.

title: BYE TUKUWA BIVA GY'OLI
text:
Yesu otuyigirize,
Ebyo bwe bikukolerwa;
Fenna-otunyiikize wonna 
-Okugoba n'okwesolooza

title: MUKAMA,NZE NNINA-EBIBI
MUKAMA,NZE NNINA-EBIBI
MUKAMA,NZE NNINA-EBIBI
text:
Ajja gyendi simugoba,
-Ekigambo kyo nkikkiriza,
Kuba okulimba toyinza;
Yesu,njija.

title: MUKAMA,NZE NNINA-EBIBI
YESU WANFIIRIRA MU KWAGALA KWO
text:
YESU wanfiirira mu kwagala kwo,
Nnyinza ntya okukumma by'onooyagala?
Byonna mbikuwa ggwe,ka nfuuke-omuddu wo,
Obuddu ggwe gy'oli lye ddembe ddala.

title: YESU WANFIIRIRA MU KWAGALA KWO
text:
Ku ntebe-ey'ekisa ompolereza,
Ompe-emirembe gyo Yesu nkwesiga;
Ka mbuulire wonna ettendo lyo lyonna,
Mu bulamu-,mu kufa,bw'onondokola.

title: YESU WANFIIRIRA MU KWAGALA KWO
text:
Kye njagala kyokka kukufaanananga,
Nzire mu kkubo lyo nga nkuweereza;
Emirimu gyange gyonna gikolebwe,
Okwebazanga ggwe eyanjagala.

title: OMWOYO N'OMUBIRI
OMWOYO N'OMUBIRI
OMWOYO N'OMUBIRI
text:
Yesu Omulokozi,
Neesiga-erinnya lyo;
Era nga bwe wagamba,
Kibeere bwe kityo.

title: OMWOYO N'OMUBIRI
OMWOYO N'OMUBIRI
text:
Toola-ebitundu byange 
Bye waggya mu nvuba;
Nnwanenga ne Ssetaani 
N'okumuwangula.

title: OMWOYO N'OMUBIRI
KATONDA WANGE BYE NKYAMA
text:
KATONDA wange bye nkyama,
Ewala mu kkubo lyange,
-onjigirize-okkukiriza
Byonna, byonna, by'oyagala.

title: KATONDA WANGE BYE NKYAMA
KATONDA WANGE BYE NKYAMA
text:
-Obuyinike bwe bunsanga,
Nga nfiiriddwa be njagala,
Oyimuse-omwoyo gwange
Onnyimuse, onnyimuse,

title: KATONDA WANGE BYE NKYAMA
text:
Bw'obanga-ompita-okuleka
Bye nsinga-okwagala, byonna
Bitwale, si byange, bibyo;
Nzikiriza, nzikiriza.

title: KATONDA WANGE BYE NKYAMA
text:
Kino kye neetaaga kyokka,
Omwoyo wo-okuyingira
Mu mutima gwange mu nda,
Ayingire, ayingire.

title: KATONDA WANGE BYE NKYAMA
EKISA KYO
text:
EKISA kyo tekitegeerekeka;
Mukama wannge, naye njagala
-Okuyiga bulijjo n'okwongera
Okutegeera mu mwoyo gwange
Bwe kyenkana.

title: EKISA KYO
text:
Okwagala kwo kukira byonna
Bye tulowooza ffe-abantu, naye
Neegomba nnyo-okubuulira wonna
Ekisa kyo-ekinene bwe kiri
Eri bonna.

title: EKISA KYO
text:
Ekisa kyo kinnemedde ddala
Okukitendereza-obulungi:
Naye emimwa gyannge gyagala,
Mukama okuyimba ettendo lyo
-Ennaku zonna.

title: EKISA KYO
text:
Newankubadde nga nnemwa leero
Okutegeera-oba-okubuulira
Oba kukweyanza nga bw'osaana,
Naye nzize gy'oli onjijuze
Okwagala.

title: EKISA KYO
EKISA KYO
text:
Mukama onjijuze-okwagala,
Ntwala awali oluzzi olwo
-Olw'obulamu, nneme-okuluvaako
Okunoonya-amazzi gonna-amalala
-Ennaku zonna.

title: EKISA KYO
text:
Era bwe ndikulaba n'amaaso
Ndiyiga-okukutendereza-ennyo;
Kubanga-okwagala-okwenkanaawo
Nga bwe kuli okw'ekitalo-ennyo,
Kumpalula.

title: SIRIIKO KYE MPOZA,YESU
SIRIIKO KYE MPOZA,YESU
text:
Obunafu bwange buliggwa:
Mu maaso go teri kibi,
Ekisa kyo kibeerera 
Emirembe gyonna.

title: YESU,NEESIGA GGWE OKUNDOKOLA
text:
YESU,neesiga ggwe okundokola
Mu musango gwonna ne mu kwonoona:
Ali mgganga ggwe mu ggulu taliwo;
Ne mu nsi ggwe wekka ggwe Mulokozi.

title: YESU,NEESIGA GGWE OKUNDOKOLA
text:
Neesig(a) ekisa kyo,kyenvudde njinja 
Nkwebaza,nkusinz(a) olw'okusaasira.
Yesu,neesiga ggwe okundokola,
Mu musango gwonna ne mu kwonoona.

title: YESU,NEESIGA GGWE OKUNDOKOLA
text:
Yesu,nkwesiga n'olw'ekigambo kyo,
Naakawulira-omwo eddoboozi lyo:
Omwoyo-omulungi bw'anjigiriza,
Ka ntuule nga njija-era nga nsanyuka.

title: YESU,NEESIGA GGWE OKUNDOKOLA
text:
Neesig(a) ekisa kyo,kyenvudde njinja 
Nkwebaza,nkusinz(a) olw'okusaasira.
Yesu,neesiga ggwe okundokola,
Mu musango gwonna ne mu kwonoona.

title: YESU,NEESIGA GGWE OKUNDOKOLA
text:
Yesu,neesiga ggwe,Omulokozi;
Toyinza kugoba yenna-akkiriza 
Ekyo kya mazima,nange nsanyuka 
Olw'obulokozi bwo,obw'obuwa.

title: YESU,NEESIGA GGWE OKUNDOKOLA
text:
Neesig(a) ekisa kyo,kyenvudde njinja 
Nkwebaza,nkusinz(a) olw'okusaasira.
Kyeva neesiga ggwe,kyenza nsanyuka 
Yesu (O)mulokozi,era Katonda.

title: NEEWAAYO MU MIKONO
text:
NEEWAAYO mu mikono
Gya Yesu kaakano;
Essanyu lyo linkutte,
Sirema kwewaayo.

title: NEEWAAYO MU MIKONO
text:
Omwana wa Katonda,
Yesu anjagala;
Neewaayo gy'oli wekka,
N'ebyange-era byonna.

title: NEEWAAYO MU MIKONO
NEEWAAYO MU MIKONO
text:
Kabaka wange-ontwale 
Ne bye nnina byonna;
Onkuume n'ekisa kyo,
Mbeerenga mwesigwa.

title: OTULUMGGAMYE,MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
OTULUMGGAMYE,Mukama waffe,
Eri essanyu ly'olina wekka;
Kuuma-emisana ffe-abaana-abato,
Era-otukuume-ekiro.

title: OTULUMGGAMYE,MUKAMA WAFFE
OTULUMGGAMYE,MUKAMA WAFFE
YESU,SIKYALI KU BWANGE
text:
YESU,sikyali ku bwange,
Nze ndi muddu wo buddu;
Nali mu nsi ya Ssetaani
N'ojja n'oginziyamu.

title: YESU,SIKYALI KU BWANGE
text:
Muddu wo,muddu wo:
Yesu,nze ndi muddu wo.

title: YESU,SIKYALI KU BWANGE
text:
Obulamu bwange bwonna 
Mpaayo mu mikono gyo;
Ggwe-olinkuuma n'okutuusa
Olintuusa ewuwo.

title: YESU,SIKYALI KU BWANGE
text:
Muddu wo,muddu wo:
Yesu,nze ndi muddu wo.

title: YESU,SIKYALI KU BWANGE
text:
Era mpaayo-ensimbi zange 
N'ebintu byange byonna;
N'ekitiibwa n'emikwano,
Leero byonna mbiwa ggwe.

title: YESU,SIKYALI KU BWANGE
text:
Muddu wo,muddu wo:
Yesu,nze ndi muddu wo.

title: YESU,SIKYALI KU BWANGE
text:
Omubiri gwange gwonna,
Ebigere n'engalo;
N'amagezi gange gonna,
Byonna byonna bye bibyo.

title: YESU,SIKYALI KU BWANGE
text:
Muddu wo,muddu wo:
Yesu,nze ndi muddu wo.

title: YESU,SIKYALI KU BWANGE
text:
Nsanyuse,Yesu andeeta 
Mu ggye ly'abatukuvu;
Be baweereza Katonda,
Be batuuka mu ggulu.

title: YESU,SIKYALI KU BWANGE
text:
Muddu wo,muddu wo:
Yesu,nze ndi muddu wo.

title: GGWE KWAGALA KWA KATONDA
text:
GGWE kwagala kwa Katonda
Tomanyika bukulu bwo,
Nze nnyimiridde-ewala-ennyo
Nga mkufumiitirizaako;
-Obuyinike bunjijudde
-Okutuusa lw'olimpummuza.

title: GGWE KWAGALA KWA KATONDA
text:
Wampita-edda lwa kisa kyo 
N'olyoka-empa-emirembe gyo 
Naye bwe mba nkyatambula 
Mu mpisa-enkyamu ez'ensi,
Emirembe-egyo gimbula 
Ndituuka ddi-okuwummula?

title: GGWE KWAGALA KWA KATONDA
text:
Kyonna,kyonna-,ekigezaako
-Okunfuga leero mu mwoyo 
Nsaba nti Okimmalemu 
Okisse ku musaalaba;
Nneme-okwegomba-eby'abantu 
-Omwoyo gunywerere ku ggwe.

title: GGWE KWAGALA KWA KATONDA
TWETAAGA YESU: YESU,SO SI MULALA
text:
TWETAAGA Yesu:Yesu,so si mulala
Ekisa kye kinaatumala ffe.
Twetaaga Yesu: tugobe Ssetaani
Ng'atusemberera mu ttima lye.

title: TWETAAGA YESU: YESU,SO SI MULALA
TWETAAGA YESU: YESU,SO SI MULALA
TWETAAGA YESU: YESU,SO SI MULALA
TWETAAGA YESU: YESU,SO SI MULALA
text:
Twetaaga Yesu:nga tufiiriddwa-abantu 
Be twagala-,abeebakira mu ye:
Atukubagiza ne tutakaaba,
Nga tulowooza ku bigambo bye.

title: TWETAAGA YESU: YESU,SO SI MULALA
text:
Twetaaga Yesu:anaatuukirizanga 
Buli kye twetaaga-olw'ekisa kye;
Tuweebwa-obutuukirivu ku lulwe,
Nga tuyima mu ye tulokola.

title: AYI KATONDA, ONNUMGGAMYE
text:
AYI Katonda,onnumggamye
Okumpisa mu ddungu;
Ndi munafu:ggwe w'amaanyi,
Nnyweza mu mikono gyo.
Ggwe-oli mmere y'omu ggulu,
Ondisenga,nzikute.

title: AYI KATONDA, ONNUMGGAMYE
text:
Omusaayi gwo-ogunaaza 
Gunnaaze,guntukuze;
Empagi ey'omuliro 
Ggwe Mubeezi ow'amaanyi 
Onkuume n'engabo yo.

title: AYI KATONDA, ONNUMGGAMYE
text:
Bwe ndituuka ku Yoludaani
Ombeere nneme-okutya.
Ggwe-eyawangula okufa 
Ontuuse mu kanani.
Nnyimbe-ennyimba-ez'amatendo
Bulijjo nga ndi naawe.

title: OMWOYO GWANGE,WULIRA-AMALOBOOZI
text:
OMWOYO gwange,wulira-amaloboozi,
Ba-malayika be nga basuuta;
Nga batenda-obulungi bwe obungi,
N'obulamu obw'olubeerera.

title: OMWOYO GWANGE,WULIRA-AMALOBOOZI
text:
Mmwe bamalayika abaddu be,
Mutwanirize ffe abatambuze.

title: OMWOYO GWANGE,WULIRA-AMALOBOOZI
text:
Kale tugende nga tuwuliriza,
-Ennyimba zaabwe,Yesu ng'atuyita;
Tuyite mu nzikiza y'ensi eno,
Enjiri ye ng'etukulembera.

title: OMWOYO GWANGE,WULIRA-AMALOBOOZI
text:
Mmwe bamalayika abaddu be,
Mutwanirize ffe abatambuze.

title: OMWOYO GWANGE,WULIRA-AMALOBOOZI
text:
-Eddoboozi lya Yesu likoowoola nnyo 
Nga liva-eri waggulu gy'atudde;
Nga lituuka eri abantu bangi,
-Abanafu n'abazitooweredwa.

title: OMWOYO GWANGE,WULIRA-AMALOBOOZI
text:
Mmwe bamalayika abaddu be,
Mutwanirize ffe abatambuze.

title: OMWOYO GWANGE,WULIRA-AMALOBOOZI
text:
Bwe tulituuka mu ggulu gy'abeera,
Ennaku z'omu nsi zirikoma:
Tulibeera mu ssanyu ejjereere.
Nga tutendereza-Omulookozi

title: OMWOYO GWANGE,WULIRA-AMALOBOOZI
text:
Mmwe bamalayika abaddu be,
Mutwanirize ffe abatambuze.

title: OMWOYO GWANGE,WULIRA-AMALOBOOZI
text:
Mmwe-ab'omu ggulu,bamalayika be,
Mutuyimbire-ennyimba ez'essanyu;
-Okutuusa olunaku olwo-olukulu 
-Obuyinike bwonna lwe buliggwaawo.

title: OMWOYO GWANGE,WULIRA-AMALOBOOZI
text:
Mmwe bamalayika abaddu be,
Mutwanirize ffe abatambuze.

title: BWE TUTAMBULIRA AWAMU NE YESU
text:
BWE tutambulira awmau ne Yesu
Mu musana ogw'enjiri ye,
Tubeera mu kkubo ery'ekitiibwa kye
Wamu n'abeesigwa be boona.

title: BWE TUTAMBULIRA AWAMU NE YESU
text:
Mugondere era omwesige,
Tewali kkubo ddala 
Erireet(a) essanyu.

title: BWE TUTAMBULIRA AWAMU NE YESU
text:
Ebisiikirize n'ebire biggwaawo 
Okutya n'okubuusabuusa;
Era n'amaziga nago tegabaawo 
Eri abeesigwa be boona.

title: BWE TUTAMBULIRA AWAMU NE YESU
text:
Mugondere era omwesige,
Tewali kkubo ddala 
Erireet(a) essanyu.

title: BWE TUTAMBULIRA AWAMU NE YESU
text:
Obubi n'ennaku abitwetikkira,
Atuggyako n'obuyinike;
Ebituganya obikomerere 
Singa tukwesiga ggwe Yesu.

title: BWE TUTAMBULIRA AWAMU NE YESU
text:
Mugondere era omwesige,
Tewali kkubo ddala 
Erireet(a) essanyu.

title: BWE TUTAMBULIRA AWAMU NE YESU
text:
Tetunnakakasa kwagala na ssanyu 
Fenna bye tulibeera nabyo,
Okutuusa Yesu lwe tulimulaba 
Wamu n'abeesigwa be bonna.

title: BWE TUTAMBULIRA AWAMU NE YESU
text:
Mugondere era omwesige,
Tewali kkubo ddala 
Erireet(a) essanyu.

title: BWE TUTAMBULIRA AWAMU NE YESU
text:
Tu libeera naye,tulituula naye 
Tulitambula wamu naye 
By'anaatugambanga tunaabikolanga,
Kino kyokka tumwesiga ye.

title: BWE TUTAMBULIRA AWAMU NE YESU
text:
Mugondere era omwesige,
Tewali kkubo ddala 
Erireet(a) essanyu.

title: NG'EMPEEWO BW'EWEJJAWEJJA
text:
NG'EMPEEWO bw'ewejjawejja.
Olw'amazzi-ewummule
Abayizzi gye bagoba
-Ewala nnyo mu kibira,
Bw'atyo omutambuze
Ye bw'awejjawejjera
Ggwe,amazzi g'obulamu,
Ggwe,omugga-ogutaggwaawo.

title: NG'EMPEEWO BW'EWEJJAWEJJA
text:
-Emmeeme yange-erumwa-enjala 
Ku lw'Oyo-Omutukuvu,
-Emmere yange ge maziga 
Emisana n'ekiro;
Abayigganya bonna 
Nga banvuma-edda n'edda 
Nti -Omulokozi yeekweka.
Ali ludda wa Katonda?

title: NG'EMPEEWO BW'EWEJJAWEJJA
text:
Kiki-ekikukutamizza,
Ky'ozitoowereddwa ggwe?
Kiki,ggwe emmeeme yange,
-Ekikweraliikiriza?
Weesige-Omulokozi 
Bulijjo-weeyanze nnyo;
Sanyusanga-omuzira wo,
Suubiranga-eri Katonda

title: MUJJE MWEKKA KYAMA MUWUMMULE
text:
MUJJE mwekka kyama muwummule,
Nange,mu kifo eteri bantu,
Emitawaana gibayinzeeko,
Oluyoogaano lubakooyezza.

title: MUJJE MWEKKA KYAMA MUWUMMULE
text:
Muleke byonna-ensi by'yagala,
Munoonye-ebitanoonyezeka nsi,
Awamu nange-era ne Kitange 
So temuli mwekka,tuli nammwe.

title: MUJJE MWEKKA KYAMA MUWUMMULE
text:
Mumbuulire byonna bye mukola,
Bye mwogera-era bye muwangula,
Mu nnaku zammwe bwe mulemeddwa,
Bimanyibwa-Atakisika byama.

title: MUJJE MWEKKA KYAMA MUWUMMULE
text:
Ekkubo lya wala,muwummule,
Olugendo lunaabazirisa;
Mutoole-emmere-eva gye ndi mulye,
-Amazzi ag'obulamu muganywe.

title: MUJJE MWEKKA KYAMA MUWUMMULE
text:
Ate mudde ku mirimu gyammwe,
Muli banafu,naye ndi nammwe;
Omwesigwa-aliweebwa-empeera ye,
Njija mangu emmambya esaze.

title: KWATA-OMUKONO GWANGE,NDI MUNAFU
text:
KWATA-omukono gwange,ndi munafu;
Sirina maanyi,nafuwadde nnyo.
Naye bw'onkwata,siriiko kye naatya.
Naasobolanga byonna-eby'entiisa.

title: KWATA-OMUKONO GWANGE,NDI MUNAFU
text:
Mulokozi,kwata-omukono gwange,
Onsembeze kumpi n'omwoyo gwo 
Enzikiza-ekutte,onjakire nze,
Nneme-okukyamanga mu kkubo lyo

title: KWATA-OMUKONO GWANGE,NDI MUNAFU
text:
Kwata-omukono gwange,ggwe-otegeera,
Enkwe n'obulimba bwa Ssetaani;
Bw'obeeera nange naafuna-emirembe,
Naatambulanga n'essanyu lingi.

title: KWATA-OMUKONO GWANGE,NDI MUNAFU
text:
Kwata-omukono gwange,mu bulwadde,
Nga nzirika nga sissa mukka nnyo;
Onsomose-omugga-ogw'okufa kwange 
Ontuuse gy'oli-olwa ssaddaaka yo.

title: OTUKULEMBERE
OTUKULEMBERE
text:
Mu buyinike 
-Ka tugumenga 
Newankubadde nga tuli 
Mu kabi kanene katya,
Tujjukirenga 
Ggwe watusooka.

title: OTUKULEMBERE
text:
Bwe wanajjanga,
-Ekigambo kyonna 
Ekirumya-emyoyo gyaffe 
Ekimalamu amaanyi,
Yimusa-amaaso 
Tukulabenga.

title: OTUKULEMBERE
text:
Tulongooseze 
-Olugendo lwaffe;
Tulagirirenga-ekkubo,
Tuwe-entanda y'omu mwoyo,
N'oluvannyuma 
-Otutuuse-ewuwo.

title: ABATAMBUZE,BAYITA
text:
ABATAMBUZE ,bayita
Mu kiro ek'ennaku,
Nga bayimba eby'essuubi
Nga bagenda mu ggulu.

title: ABATAMBUZE,BAYITA
text:
Tewali kutya nzikiza 
Baakirwa omusana;
Bakwatagana mu ngalo 
Ne gubakulembera.

title: ABATAMBUZE,BAYITA
text:
Abalonde ba Katonda,
Atuwa-omusana gwe 
-Okutubeera mu lugendo,
Twekkaanye-ekkubo lyaffe.

title: ABATAMBUZE,BAYITA
text:
Ffe tugenderera kimu 
N'okukkiriza kumu;
Katonda fenna atuwa 
-Essubi limu eddamu.

title: ABATAMBUZE,BAYITA
text:
Tulina-oluyimba lumu 
Nga tulwanyisa-ebibi;
Olugendo lwaffe lumu 
Omusaale ye Yesu.

title: ABATAMBUZE,BAYITA
text:
Okwesiima kwaffe kumu 
Bwe tulituuka gy'ali;
Gy'afuga mu kwagala kwe,
Kitaffe fenna omu.

title: MMWE MUGENDA WA BANNANGE
text:
MMWE mugenda wa bannange
Be ndaba ng'abayise?
Ffe tukutte nno-olugendo,
Lwe yalagira Yesu.
Olugrndo nno luwanvu,
Ffe tugenda ku kibuga:
Ffe tugenda ku kibuga:
Mu ns(i) eyoesinga ennyo.

title: MMWE MUGENDA WA BANNANGE
text:
Mutugambe kye mwetaaga,
Mu nsi-eyo ennungi ennyo:
Ebirungi-n'ekitiibwa,
By'alituwa Mukama.
Tulituula ne Katonda
Tuliraba-Omulokozi;
Tuliraba-Omulokozi:
Mu ns(i) eyo esinga ennyo.

title: MMWE MUGENDA WA BANNANGE
text:
Abayise mutugaanye 
Okugendayo nammwe?
Mujje mangu mwanguweeko 
Mugende naffe mwenna.
Mujje nno temutuvaako,
Alibaaniriza Yesu;
Alibaaniriza Yesu;
Mu ns(i) eyo esinga ennyo.

title: MU NZIKIZA GGWE-oMUSANA OGWAKA
text:
MU nzikiza ggwe-Omusana ogwaka,
Onjakire.
-Obudde bukutte nange ntidde nnyo,
Onjakire.
Nkulembera,siraba gye mggenda,
Naye ggwe omanyi byonna,Ayi Yesu.

title: MU NZIKIZA GGWE-oMUSANA OGWAKA
text:
Edda saakwagala ggwe kunnumggamya,
Nakukyawa.
Nali njagala-okweronderanga 
-Ekkubo lyange 
Naye leero-onsaasire-olw'ekisa,
Tojjukira byonoono byange-eby'edda.

title: MU NZIKIZA GGWE-oMUSANA OGWAKA
KINO KYE NSIIMA-ENNYO
text:
KINO kye nsiima-ennyo
Bwe nkirowoozaako,
-Okusembera-okumpi
N'okufa nga sitya.

title: KINO KYE NSIIMA-ENNYO
text:
Buli kiro mmala 
Ebbanga mu kkubo;
Eririntuusa-eyo 
Ewaffe mu ggulu.

title: KINO KYE NSIIMA-ENNYO
text:
Siriiko kye ntya nze 
Mu lugendo luno,
Gye mgenda mu ggulu 
Kitange gy'abeera.

title: KINO KYE NSIIMA-ENNYO
text:
Byonna ndibiraba 
Bye nasomangako,
-Abatukuvu bonna 
Abankulembera.

title: KINO KYE NSIIMA-ENNYO
text:
Ne bamalayika 
Nga bakuba-ennanga,
Era ne Katonda,
Mukama w'obulamu-.

title: KINO KYE NSIIMA-ENNYO
text:
Namuwammantira 
Mu nzikiza-ey'ensi;
Yanzaawula,era 
Mu kufa-alimponya.

title: BWE NTAMBULIRA MU KKUBO
text:
BWE ntambulira mu kkubo,
Yesu ankulembera;
Nnyinza-ntya-okubuusabuusa
Ye bw'antwala bulijjo?

title: BWE NTAMBULIRA MU KKUBO
text:
Byonna ebibaawo ku nze 
Tebiyinza kunnuma;
Yesu ye Mukuumi wange,
Ye angabira-obulamu-

title: BWE NTAMBULIRA MU KKUBO
text:
Abalabe-abalinnumba 
Ye alibawangula;
Era-alintuusa n'essanyu 
Lingi mu mirembe gye.

title: BWE NTAMBULIRA MU KKUBO
text:
Enjala bw'eba nga-ennuma,
Andiisa ku mmere ye;
Era-ampozaawoza mangu 
Ng'ampa-amazzi-ag'obulamu-

title: BWE NTAMBULIRA MU KKUBO
text:
Yesu Mulokozi wange,
Eyanfuula-omuddu wo;
Ka nkutendereze bwe ntyo,
Emiremb-egitaggwaawo-.

title: YESU OMULOKOZI, OTUWULIRE
text:
YESU-Omulokozi,otuulire
-Amaloboozi gaffe nga tuyimusa.
Tukuwadde-ebyaffe,tukusenze ggwe.
Kkiriza-emibiri n'emyoyo gyaffe.

title: YESU OMULOKOZI, OTUWULIRE
YESU OMULOKOZI, OTUWULIRE
text:
Kaakano twamgganga okujja gy'oli,
Kye kisa kyo kyokka ekitusembeza;
Watununula ffe-abalina ebibi,
N'otufuula-abaana,ne tukwebaza.

title: YESU OMULOKOZI, OTUWULIRE
text:
Bulijjo ekisa nga kyeyongera 
Ebigenda-okujja tebisingika;
Eyo gye wagenda-okuteekateeka 
Eby'omu ggulu ebitamanyika.

title: YESU OMULOKOZI, OTUWULIRE
OMUTAMBUZE NG'AKOOYE
text:
-OMUTAMBUZE ng'akooye
Bw'alengera-ekisulo kye,[ennyo,
Newankubadde nga wala,
Omwoyo ne gumuddamu.

title: OMUTAMBUZE NG'AKOOYE
text:
-Omukristaayo era bw'atyo;
Bwe yeddamu omwoyo gwe,
Bw'alaba-olw'okukkiriza,
Ekifo kye eky'omu ggulu

title: OMUTAMBUZE NG'AKOOYE
text:
Ensi-eyo emusanyusa,
So takyakaabira bya dda;
So n'eby'okujja tabitya,
Kasita alituuka eyo.

title: OMUTAMBUZE NG'AKOOYE
text:
Naabeeranga eyo ne Yesu;
Bw'agamba bw'atyo;ennaku

title: OMUTAMBUZE NG'AKOOYE
text:
Zirinvaako,n'amaziga,
Katonda-aligasangula.

title: OMUTAMBUZE NG'AKOOYE
text:
Yesu,tukwesiga wekka,
Otukulembere gy'oli;
Ne bwe tukoowa mu kkubo,
Ggwe-olitusanyusa-ewuwo.

title: OMUZIRA YENNA
text:
OMUZIRA yenna
Ayagala-ennyo
-Okugobereranga
Mukama we ye;
Tewali na kabi
-Akalimuziyiza,
Bw'alayira-okubeera-
-Omutambuze.

title: OMUZIRA YENNA
text:
Abamubuulira 
-Eby'okumutiisa,
Balemwa-okumalawo-
Obuzira bwe:
Tewali mulabe 
Alimuwangula;
Alituukiriza 
Ng'omutambuze.

title: OMUZIRA YENNA
text:
Mukama bw'anaaba 
Ng'atukuuma ffe,
Tulifuna-obulamu-
Obutaliggwaawo-:
-Eby'omu nsi biriggwaaawo-!
Siityenga-eby'abantu;
Naabeeranga bulijjo-
Omutambuze

title: BULIJJO,BULIJJO
text:
BULIJJO,bulijjo,
Sooka-omulimu ku nkya;
Nyiikira,beeera muteefu,
Tambula mu bwesigwa,
Saanira n'okolera nnyo
Mpeera yo-ey'obutuukirirvu,
Bulijjo,bulijjo.

title: BULIJJO,BULIJJO
text:
Bulijjo,bulijjo,
Ddayo-eka wo ekiro
Omubiri gwo longoosa,
Lya emmere ya leero 
Era weebake-otulo two,
Nga bwe kikusaanidde ddala;
Bulijjo,bulijjo.

title: BULIJJO,BULIJJO
text:
Bulijjo,bulijjo;
Jjukira Katonda wo,
Bw'akulembera,bw'akuuma 
Amakubo go gonna;
Era jjukira-okusaba 
N'okutendereza-erinya lye,
Bulijjo,bulijjo.

title: ABANTU BA YESU ABALOKOLE
text:
ABANTU ba Yesu abalokole,
Abalaba-ekisa,era-ab'eddembe:

title: ABANTU BA YESU ABALOKOLE
text:
Tuli baddu b'ani? Tuli ba Yesu;
Twali ba Ssetaani,ne tusenguka.

title: ABANTU BA YESU ABALOKOLE
text:
Yesu be yalonda,be yanunula,
Baana ba Katonda,ab'emmeeme empya;

title: ABANTU BA YESU ABALOKOLE
text:
Tuli baddu b'ani? Tuli ba Yesu;
Twali ba Ssetaani,ne tusenguka.

title: ABANTU BA YESU ABALOKOLE
text:
Tuli ba kika kye,ab'omu nnyumba,
Baana mu kisa kye,talituboola.

title: ABANTU BA YESU ABALOKOLE
text:
Tuli baddu b'ani? Tuli ba Yesu;
Twali ba Ssetaani,ne tusenguka.

title: ABANTU BA YESU ABALOKOLE
text:
Kiki-ekyatufuula ffe-abalwanyi be?
Yesu yatugula n'omusaayi gwe.

title: ABANTU BA YESU ABALOKOLE
text:
Tuli baddu b'ani? Tuli ba Yesu;
Twali ba Ssetaani,ne tusenguka.

title: YESU MUKAMA WANGE
text:
YESU Mukama wange,
Neesiga-amaanyi go;
Sitya balabe bange
Ne bwe bannumba.
Bw'onkuuma-ennyo-olw'ekisa,
Siriiko kye ntidde;
Mu ngalo za Kitange,
Mwe mpummulira.

title: YESU MUKAMA WANGE
text:
Ssetaani bw'aba-annumba 
N'ettima lye-eringi;
Buli lw'ajja-okunnumba 
Nenziramu bwe nti:
Weegendere Ssetaani,
Yesu yakusinga;
Nali nkusenze edda,
Ne nkusenguka.

title: YESU MUKAMA WANGE
text:
Omulokozi Yesu,
Tewali ayinza 
Okutusikula ffe 
Mu mikono gyo;
Alituloopa ye-ani?
Ggwe watununula;
Wawangula Ssetaani,
Tetukyamutya.

title: EDDA NALI MBUUSABUUSA
text:
EDDA nali mbuusabuusa,
Mu bigambo bya Yesu;
-Oluusi ssanyu,-oluusi nnaku,
Oluusi kukanakana.

title: EDDA NALI MBUUSABUUSA
text:
Emirembe gya Yesu 
Gye ginsanyusa leero:
Era ye wa maanyi nnyo-
Mwesize ye bwesizi.

title: EDDA NALI MBUUSABUUSA
text:
Yampita okusembera,
N'okuleka okutya;
Bwe namala nze-okwewaayo
Emirembe n'agimpa.

title: EDDA NALI MBUUSABUUSA
text:
Emirembe gya Yesu 
Gye ginsanyusa leero:
Era ye wa maanyi nnyo-
Mwesize ye bwesizi.

title: EDDA NALI MBUUSABUUSA
text:
Leero sikyabuusabuusa 
-Okwesiga ye kumala;
Yesu antwala bulungi,
Era-ankuuma mu bubi.

title: EDDA NALI MBUUSABUUSA
text:
Emirembe gya Yesu 
Gye ginsanyusa leero:
Era ye wa maanyi nnyo-
Mwesize ye bwesizi.

title: EDDA NALI MBUUSABUUSA
text:
Bulijjo ankuuma-omwoyo 
Mbeerenga wa maanyi nnyo;
Era ne mmutendereza,
Ye Mulokozi nnyini.

title: EDDA NALI MBUUSABUUSA
text:
Emirembe gya Yesu 
Gye ginsanyusa leero:
Era ye wa maanyi nnyo-
Mwesize ye bwesizi.

title: GYE MIREMBE NGA TULI MU BIBI?
text:
GYE mirembe nga tuli mu bibi?
Olw'omusaayi-gwa Yesu gye giri.

title: GYE MIREMBE NGA TULI MU BIBI?
text:
Mu miteeru tuwummule tutya?
Aweereza Yesu ye-awummula.

title: GYE MIREMBE NGA TULI MU BIBI?
text:
Mirembe banaffe bwe babula?
Yesu akuuma bo naffe era.

title: GYE MIREMBE NGA TULI MU BIBI?
text:
Waali Ssetaani-omulabe waffe?
Yesu yamusinga n'amaanyi ge.

title: GYE MIREMBE NGA TULI MU BIBI?
text:
Tetumanyi ebiritubaako;
Yesu,tukumanyi n'ekisa kyo.

title: GYE MIREMBE NGA TULI MU BIBI?
text:
Wonna wonna waabuna okufa;
Yesu yawangula n'azuukira.

title: GYE MIREMBE NGA TULI MU BIBI?
text:
Atuyita-eyo Yesu;ennaku 
Ez'omu nsi mu ggulu zikoma.

title: YESU MUKAMA WANGE
text:
YESU Mukama wange.
Mweyamba bulijjo;
Yesu Mukuumi wange,
Yesu gwe neesiga.
Nange ntegeera Yesu
Ye y'alindokola,
Mmanyi tulitugoba
Abamukkiriza.

title: YESU MUKAMA WANGE
text:
Yesu Mukama wange 
Mweyamba bulijjo;
Yesu Mukuumi wange,
Yesu gwe neesiga

title: YESU MUKAMA WANGE
text:
Yesu Mukama wange,
Mpummulire mu ggwe;
Sisingibwa Ssetaani,
Bwe nkukaabirira.
Gy'oli tebakyakoowa,
Bonna bawummula,
Beerabidde-okukaaba,
Balina-essanyu lyo.

title: YESU MUKAMA WANGE
text:
Yesu Mukama wange 
Mweyamba bulijjo;
Yesu Mukuumi wange,
Yesu gwe neesiga

title: YESU MUKAMA WANGE
text:
Yesu,naakweyambanga,
Ggwe-eyatufiirira;
Naakutunuuliranga,
Okunkulembera.
Kale,Mukama wange,
Ka nkulindirire;
Olikomawo ku nsi,
Olikomawo ku nsi,
Okuntwala-ewuwo.

title: YESU MUKAMA WANGE
text:
Yesu Mukama wange 
Mweyamba bulijjo;
Yesu Mukuumi wange,
Yesu gwe neesiga

title: NKWESIGA YESU MUKAMA
text:
NKWESIGA Yesu Mukama,
Nkwesiga wekka:
Laba,ntodde-obulokozi
Bwa buwa.

title: NKWESIGA YESU MUKAMA
text:
Nkwesiga okunzigyako 
Ebibi byonna:
Nkuvuunamidde,Mukama 
-Omuddu wo.

title: NKWESIGA YESU MUKAMA
text:
Nkwesiga-okunnongoosanga 
N'omusaayi gwo;
Emisana nkwesigenga 
N'ekiro.

title: NKWESIGA YESU MUKAMA
text:
Nkwesiga-okunnumggamyanga 
Gye mggenda yonna;
Bulijjo naawuliranga 
Ggwe wekka.

title: NKWESIGA YESU MUKAMA
text:
Nkwesiga-okumpanga amaanyi 
Nze ndi munafu.
Olina gonna ggwe,mu nsi 
N'eggulu.

title: NKWESIGA YESU MUKAMA
text:
Nkwesiga ggwe,Yesu,nneme 
Okuzirika;
Mu byonna n'ennaku zonna
Nkwesiga.

title: NNINA-OMUKWANO GWANGE,YE
text:
NNINA-omukwano gwange,ye
Yasooka-okwagala nze
N'ampalula mu kisa kye,
Kye kyakkirizisa nze.
Leero ndi muddu we,naye
Abaddu be ba ddembe;
Nze ndi wuwe,naye wange.
-Emirembe n'emirembe.

title: NNINA-OMUKWANO GWANGE,YE
text:
Nnina-omukwano gwange,ye 
Yafa-okundokola nze,
Kubanga obulamu bwe 
Ye bwe yagabira nze.
Nange sikyalina byange,
Ebyange bibye byonna;
Neewaayo mu mikono gye,
Mukwano gwange ddala.

title: NNINA-OMUKWANO GWANGE,YE
text:
Nnina-omukwano gwange,ye 
Yaweebwa-amaanyi gonna;
Ge galintuusa ewuwe;
Sitya balabe bonna.
Eb'eggulu mbirengedde,
Bimyansa nnyo nga-effeza:
Kale nkole,nfube,nnwane! 
Ye alintendereza.

title: NNINA-OMUKWANO GWANGE,YE
text:
Nnina-omukwano gwange,ye 
Mulungi,ow'ekisa;
Angabira ku maanyi ge,
Annumggamya-era andiisa.
Ebiriwo n'ebiribaawo 
Tebirinjawukanya;
Emirembe-,egitaliggwaawo
Yesu,mukwano gwange

title: OMUKWANO GWA YESU
text:
OMUKWANO gwa Yesu
Tegutegeerekeka;
Omwoyo-Omutukuvu
Y'anjigiriza yekka;
Emirembe gijuza
Bwe gityo-omwoyo gwange,
Era gikulukuta Bulijjo-okunsanyusa.

title: OMUKWANO GWA YESU
text:
Byonna-ebitalabika 
Kaakano mbirengedde;
Bibikkuliddwa gye ndi 
Ku lw'ekisa kya Yesu;
Era-ebinafu by'ensi 
Katonda yabironda,
Alyoke-akwase-ensonyi 
Eby'amaanyi mangi nnyo.

title: OMUKWANO GWA YESU
text:
Eby'entiisa sibitya;
Nvumbudde-ekiwummulo;
Sikyayengetana,so 
Sikyataagana nate.
Nnina-ennono y'obulamu,
Kwe kukkiriza Yesu,
Era nnyimba n'essanyu 
Ye Mulokozi wange.

title: NAKOLA NNYO NAYE SAAGASIBWA
NAKOLA NNYO NAYE SAAGASIBWA
text:
Byonna birungi ye by'ampeereza,
Newankubadde sibisaanira;
Bw'abeera nange nfuuse-omugagga,
Bw'atabaawo mba mwavu lunkupe.
Mukama jjo ne leero-aba bumu 
Nze ndi wuwe naye wange ddala.

title: NAKOLA NNYO NAYE SAAGASIBWA
text:
Gy'oli-okufuukafuuka tewali,
Newankubadde-ekisiikirize 
Eky'okukyauka; mu kizikiza 
Ggwe-omulisa-abantu mu nsi zonna.
Nze siwaba,bonna nga bandeka;
Nze siwaba,bonna nga bandeka;
Nze ndi wuwe naye wange ddala.

title: NAKOLA NNYO NAYE SAAGASIBWA
text:
Mu nsi ntegeerako ekitundu 
-Eky'ekisa kye-ekitakomezeka,
Bw'alintwala ewuwe ndyesiima 
Okumusinza n'essanyu lingi,
Naabuuliranga n'obugumu nti:
Nze ndi wuwe naye wange ddala.

title: YESU BYONNA ABIMANYI
text:
YESU byonna abimanyi,
Kinsanyusa;
Antwala yekka mu kkubo,
Seetaaga mukulembezi,
Wabula ye,wabula ye.

title: YESU BYONNA ABIMANYI
text:
Ebiribaawo sibitya,
Ng'antwala nze;
Yesu yekka-ankulembera 
Nange ka mugoberere,
Kinsaanidde,kinsaanidde.

title: YESU BYONNA ABIMANYI
text:
Siyinza kwerabirira 
Ndi munafu;
Ankutte-omukono gwange 
Antambuza mu bulabe,

title: YESU BYONNA ABIMANYI
text:
Nnina-ekiddukiro gy'ali,
Kya maanyi nnyo;
Ekitalumbika babi 
Ekirimu bye neetaaga,
Ne mpummula,ne mpummula.

title: YESU BYONNA ABIMANYI
text:
Kyenvudde musanyukira 
Bw'ambeera nze,
Ebitayinzika gye ndi 
By'asoboola,by'amala ye,
Gwe njagala,gwe njagala.

title: NGA BEESIIMYE ABAKWAGALA
text:
NGA beesiinye-abakwagala
Abakukkiriza;
Mu musaalaba gwo Yesu
Mwe bawummulira.

title: NGA BEESIIMYE ABAKWAGALA
text:
Nga kulungi okuyimba 
Nga batendereza;
N'okwegayirira kwabwe 
Kuwulirwa Yesu.

title: NGA BEESIIMYE ABAKWAGALA
text:
Baweereddwa emirembe 
Bonna-abakwagala 
Balifuga wamu nawe 
Ggwe Katonda wabwe.

title: NGA BEESIIMYE ABAKWAGALA
text:
Tetwalina ssanyu lyona 
Nga tujjudde-ebibi
Ekkubo erituuka-ewuwo,
Nga tetuliraba,

title: NGA BEESIIMYE ABAKWAGALA
YESU MUKAMA OMULOKOZI
text:
YESU Mukama Omulokozi
Yajja mu nsi okunoonya-
ababi;
Nga kwa kitalo okwagala kwe,
Yajja-okunnoonye nze,
Yajja okunnoonya-nze,
Nga kwa kitalo okwagala kwe,
Yajja-okunnoonya nze.

title: YESU MUKAMA OMULOKOZI
text:
Yesu Mukama Omulokozi 
Bwe nnali mu nvuba ya Ssetaani,
Yannunula n'omusaayi gwe ye,
Yesu yanfiirira.
Yesu yanfiirira,

text:
Yesu Mukama Omulokozi 
Bwe nnali nga nkyamye mu 
kkubo lye,

Yesu yampita nze.
