title: YESU MUKAMA OMULOKOZI
text:
Yesu Mukama Omulokozi 
-Ekigambo kino kye kinsanyusa 
Ndimulaba lw'alijja n'ebire 
Okuntwala-ewuwe.
Okuntwala-ewuwe,
Okuntwala-ewuwe,
Ndimulaba lw'alijja n'ebire 
Okuntwala-ewuwe.

title: NALYOKA NE NKUSENGA GGWE
text:
NALYOKA ne nkusenga ggwe,
Omulokozi Katonda:
Kyenvudde nsanyuka nnyini,
Ne njatula bwe nsanyuse

title: NALYOKA NE NKUSENGA GGWE
NALYOKA NE NKUSENGA GGWE
text:
Namusenga n'atangoba,
Nze ndi wuwe,naye wange 
Yampita ne nditegeera,
-Eddoboozi lye nga lya Yesu

title: NALYOKA NE NKUSENGA GGWE
NALYOKA NE NKUSENGA GGWE
text:
Edda nasagaasagana,
Kaakano nteredde ku ye;
Sikyamusenguka-,alina 
Mukama,ye-alina byonna.

title: NALYOKA NE NKUSENGA GGWE
NALYOKA NE NKUSENGA GGWE
NALYOKA NE NKUSENGA GGWE
KATONDA MUSUMBA WANGE
text:
KATONDA Musumba wange
Era ye andiisa;
Nze ndi wuwe naye wange,
Byonna-ebibye byange.

title: KATONDA MUSUMBA WANGE
text:
Andiisa-omuddo-omulungi,
Nzikuta,mpummula;
N'awali-emigga-emirungi,
Annywea lwa kisa.

title: KATONDA MUSUMBA WANGE
text:
Bwe nkyama ye ankomyawo 
N'amggumya omwoyo;
So si lwa bulungi bwange,
Lwa linnya lye lyokka.

title: KATONDA MUSUMBA WANGE
text:
Mu kiwonvu eky'okufa 
Ndiyita nga sitya;
Oluga lwo n'omuggo gwo 
Bye binankuumanga.

title: KATONDA MUSUMBA WANGE
text:
Okwagala kwo-okulungi 
Kunaabanga nange;
N'okutendereza kwange,
Kunaabeerangawo.

title: LABA OMUSUMBA OMULUNGI
text:
LABA-Omusumba-omulungi
Bw'ayita-endiga ze:
Ennafu azisitula,
Ento azirisa.

title: LABA OMUSUMBA OMULUNGI
text:
Azitwala ku mabbali 
-Ag'amazzi g'obulamu-;
Era n'awali omuddo 
-Omulungi omuto.

title: LABA OMUSUMBA OMULUNGI
text:
Bwe zikyama nga zireka 
Ekkubo lye-effunda;
-Omusumba oyo-omwesigwa 
Azigoberera.

title: LABA OMUSUMBA OMULUNGI
text:
Bwe tutyo ffe tutambule,
Tugende n'essanyu;
Ye ng'atukuuma bulijjo 
Mu kkubo lye-eddungi.

title: JJO NE LEERO N'OKUTUUSA
text:
JJO ne leero n'okutuusa
Emirembe gyonna,Yesu
Aba bumu.

title: JJO NE LEERO N'OKUTUUSA
text:
Kye kiddukiro-eky'amaanyi 
Mwe tuwummulira fenna 
Nga tukooye.

title: JJO NE LEERO N'OKUTUUSA
text:
Edda twabula,twatuula 
Mu kizikiza-ekikutte,
Yatunoonya.

title: JJO NE LEERO N'OKUTUUSA
text:
Yatunoonya mu lukoola 
Mwe twabulubuutiranag,
Nga tubula.

title: JJO NE LEERO N'OKUTUUSA
text:
N'atuleetera-obulamu,
N'atutikkula-omugugu,
Gw'ebyonoono.

title: JJO NE LEERO N'OKUTUUSA
text:
Ebibi bye twakolanga.
Yesu abinaaza byonna,
Mu musaayi gwe.

title: JJO NE LEERO N'OKUTUUSA
text:
Anaatutuukirizanga 
Era-alitutuusa-ewuwe,
Mu mirembe,

title: JJO NE LEERO N'OKUTUUSA
text:
Yesu Mulokozi waffe,
Mukama w'abantu bonna,
Tukusuuta.

title: KIKAKAFU NNYO,YESU WANGE
text:
KIKAKAFU nnyo,Yesu wange;
Ekitiibwa kye akimpadde:
Omwoyo we Omutukuvu
Yannaazaako ebibi byange.

title: KIKAKAFU NNYO,YESU WANGE
text:
Ndi musika omununule 
Ndi wa mu kika ky'abaana be;
Kino kinnyimbisa n'essanyu 
Nga ntenderez(a) Omulokozi.

title: KIKAKAFU NNYO,YESU WANGE
text:
Lituukiridde-essanyu lyange;
Anjolesezza-eby'omu ggulu:
Bamalayika abatumye 
Okutegeeza-okwgala kwe.

title: KIKAKAFU NNYO,YESU WANGE
text:
Ndi musika omununule 
Ndi wa mu kika ky'abaana be;
Kino kinnyimbisa n'essanyu 
Nga ntenderez(a) Omulokozi.

title: KIKAKAFU NNYO,YESU WANGE
text:
Sibuusabuusa,neewaddeo;
Bwe mba ne Yesu mba mirembe:
Nze nindiridde-eby'omu ggulu 
Okwagala kwekube mu nze.

title: KIKAKAFU NNYO,YESU WANGE
text:
Ndi musika omununule 
Ndi wa mu kika ky'abaana be;
Kino kinnyimbisa n'essanyu 
Nga ntenderez(a) Omulokozi.

title: NSANYUKIRA EKIGAMBO KINO
text:
NSANYUKIRA ekigambo kino
Yesu Mukama atwagala nnyo:
Alina bingi ebisanyusa;
Naye-ekisinga nti Nze kwagala.

title: NSANYUKIRA EKIGAMBO KINO
NSANYUKIRA EKIGAMBO KINO
NSANYUKIRA EKIGAMBO KINO
NSANYUKIRA EKIGAMBO KINO
text:
Bwe nditunuulira-ekitiibwa kyo,
Ndiyimuba ntya,bwe siyimba bwe ntyo?
Nnyimba emirembe n'emirembe,
Yesu kiki-ekyakunjagaza nze?

title: NSANYUKIRA EKIGAMBO KINO
NSANYUKIRA EKIGAMBO KINO
NSANYUKIRA EKIGAMBO KINO
ABAANA-ABATO EDDA
text:
ABAANA-abato edda
Bwe bajja-eri Yesu,
Yabalaga-okwagala,
N'abawa-omukisa.

title: ABAANA-ABATO EDDA
text:
Naffe Mukama Yesu,
Tuzze mu maaso go;
Ng'abaaba-abato edda,
Tuwe-omukisa gwo.

title: ABAANA-ABATO EDDA
text:
Ggwe nnannyini kwagala,
Tuwe-okwagala kwo;
Naffe tukwagalenga 
Wamu ne bannaffe.

title: ABAANA-ABATO EDDA
text:
Tukweyanza ggwe Yesu,
Olw'obulungi bwo;
N'olw'okwagala-abaana 
Era n'abakulu.

title: AYI MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
AYI Mukama waffe,
tuzze mu maaso go;
Tusembeze n'ekisa kyo
Ffe-abaana bo-abato.

title: AYI MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
Tuwaayo ssaddaaka 
Ey'okwebaza kwaffe;
Okkirize-ettendo lyaffe 
Lye tuleeta gy'oli.

title: AYI MUKAMA WAFFE
text:
Tujjuze-okwagala 
Mu buzibu byaffe;
Era-otuyigirizenga 
Twagale-erinnya lyo.

title: AWO-YESU BWE YATAMBULA
text:
AWO-Yesu bwe yatambula
Edda mu nsi entukuvu,
Abakyala-Abayudaaya
Baamusemberera.

title: AWO-YESU BWE YATAMBULA
text:
Bajja nga bamuleetera 
Abaana baabwe abato 
-Abateeke mu mikono gye 
Baweebwe-omukisa.

title: AWO-YESU BWE YATAMBULA
text:
Naye abayigirizwa 
Ne babagobera ddala,
Nti Temumutegannya nnyo,
Tubeegayiridde.

title: AWO-YESU BWE YATAMBULA
text:
Bwe yabalaba-abaana be,
Yesu yalagira badde,
Yayogera n'eggonjebwa:
-Abato bajje gye ndi

title: EBINY(U) EBIRUNGI (E)NNYO
text:
EBINT(U) ebirungi (e)nnyo
Ebitonde byonna
Byonna ebyewuunyisa
Byatondwa Katonda.

title: EBINY(U) EBIRUNGI (E)NNYO
text:
Ebimuli ebyaanya 
Ye yatinda langi 
Obunyonyi-obuyimba
Buyinza-okubuuka.

title: EBINY(U) EBIRUNGI (E)NNYO
text:
Ebint(u) ebirungi (e)nnyo 
Ebitonde byonna 
Byonna ebyewuunyisa 
Byatondwa Katonda.

title: EBINY(U) EBIRUNGI (E)NNYO
text:
Ensozi ez'omuddo 
Omuli n'emigga,
Enjuba-egwa n'evaayo 
-Eggulu litangaala.

title: EBINY(U) EBIRUNGI (E)NNYO
text:
Ebint(u) ebirungi (e)nnyo 
Ebitonde byonna 
Byonna ebyewuunyisa 
Byatondwa Katonda.

title: EBINY(U) EBIRUNGI (E)NNYO
text:
Empewo eya ttoggo,
-Omusana gw'ekyeya,
Ebibala-ebyengera,
Byonna yabitonda.

title: EBINY(U) EBIRUNGI (E)NNYO
text:
Ebint(u) ebirungi (e)nnyo 
Ebitonde byonna 
Byonna ebyewuunyisa 
Byatondwa Katonda.

title: EBINY(U) EBIRUNGI (E)NNYO
text:
Ensenyi n'ebibira,
-Ensuku n'ennimiro;
Biyiriro by'emigga 
N'ebifo-ebirungi.

title: EBINY(U) EBIRUNGI (E)NNYO
text:
Ebint(u) ebirungi (e)nnyo 
Ebitonde byonna 
Byonna ebyewuunyisa 
Byatondwa Katonda.

title: EBINY(U) EBIRUNGI (E)NNYO
text:
Tulaba,twewuunya nnyo 
Ne tutendereza 
Omuyinza wa byonna 
Eyatonda bw'atyo.

title: EBINY(U) EBIRUNGI (E)NNYO
text:
Ebint(u) ebirungi (e)nnyo 
Ebitonde byonna 
Byonna ebyewuunyisa 
Byatondwa Katonda.

title: EKIRO NGA NEEBASE
text:
EKIRO nga neebase,
Malayika ankuumye;
Nkwebaza,Ayi-Mukama,
Okumpisa mu kiro.

title: EKIRO NGA NEEBASE
text:
Mu njuyi zonna-ez'ensi 
-Erinnya lyo lyebazibwe;
Bye bakola mu ggulu 
Bikolebwe ne mu nsi.

title: EKIRO NGA NEEBASE
text:
Ompe-emmere-eya leero,
Nsonyiwa-ebibi byange;
Onkuume nze-omwana wo 
Olunaku lwa leero.

title: GGWE MUSUMBA-OMULUNGI
text:
GGWE Musumba-omulungi
Ggwe-okuuma endiga zo;
Tewali-ekiriyinza
Kuzikusikulako.

title: GGWE MUSUMBA-OMULUNGI
text:
-Omulokozi wawaayo 
-Obulamu bwo ku lwaffe;
Mu ngalo zo mulimu 
-Enkovu z'emisumaali.

title: GGWE MUSUMBA-OMULUNGI
text:
Naakutenderezanga 
Nga mpulira by'omggamba;
Ndyoke nfaanane ng'abo 
B'oli nabo mu ggulu.

title: GGWE MUSUMBA-OMULUNGI
text:
Ayi-Musumba-omulungi 
Beeranga kumpi nange,
Njige eddoboozi lyo,
Nkwatenga ekkubo lyo.

title: GGWE MUSUMBA-OMULUNGI
text:
Naakugobereranga 
Buli wonna w'oyita;
Olintuusa mu ggulu 
Mu maaso ga Kitaffe.

title: KATONDA TUSIIBULE NNO
text:
KATONDA tusiibule nno:
Kkiriza-ettendo lyaffe
Sonyiwa bonna-abeenenya,
Abakweka ttalanta;
Tulemenga
Okunyiiza-Omwoyo wo

title: KATONDA TUSIIBULE NNO
text:
Otubeere tulemenga 
Okwesanyusa fekka;
Tukuza essanyu lyaffe 
Mu kuwummula kwaffe:
Naawe beera 
Ssanyu lingi gye tuli.

title: KATONDA TUSIIBULE NNO
text:
Byonna bye tuyize wano,
Bituukirze mu ffe;
Naye byonna-ebitasaana,
Otwerabize mangu:
tunoonyenga 
Amagezi-amalungi.

title: KATONDA TUSIIBULE NNO
text:
Ayi Kitaffe-obukuume 
Abatalidda nate;
-Ebiro byabwe-eby'okusiga 
Bireete-okukungula,
Abalidda 
Bakolenga n'amaanyi.

title: KATONDA WANJAGALA
text:
KATONDA wanjagala
N'ompa-Omwana wo Yesu
Abe mukwano gwange
Annyambe mu bizibu.

title: KATONDA WANJAGALA
text:
Yesu tolekangayo 
-Okuba mukwano gwange;
Bulijjo beera nange 
Era n'okunnumggamya.

title: KATONDA WANJAGALA
text:
Naakwagala ntya Yesu?
Nze naakutonera ki?
Siraba kye mba nkuwa 
Anti byonna bintu byo.

title: KATONDA WANJAGALA
text:
Naye kye nnina kimu 
Nkuwadde-omwoyo gwange;
Naakugobereranga,
Ondagirire-ekkubo.

title: KIGAMBO KYA MAGERO NNYO
text:
KIGAMBO kya magero nnyo
Eky'Omwana wa Katonda;
Okuva mu ggulu n'akka
Alokole-abaana nga nze.

title: KIGAMBO KYA MAGERO NNYO
text:
Kya mazima yayagala 
Abaana n'abanyoomebwa;
Yayagala-abamukyawa 
Yattibwa balokolebwe.

title: KIGAMBO KYA MAGERO NNYO
text:
Okwagala kwe kungi nnyo 
Okutayogerekeka,
Okwagala-omubi nga nze,
Nange kirungi mwagale.

title: KIGAMBO KYA MAGERO NNYO
text:
Oluusi nfumiitiriza 
Ne ndowooza-omusaalaba,
Emisumaali n'amaggwa 
Yesu nga bw'afa ku lwange.

title: KIGAMBO KYA MAGERO NNYO
text:
Singa nnaliwo ng'attibwa,
Sandiyinzizza kumanya 
Okwagala kwe-okungi-ennyo
Kwe yalina mu mwoyo gwe.

title: KIGAMBO KYA MAGERO NNYO
text:
Kaakano nnyinza-okumanya 
Nga bw'anjagalira ddala,
Naye ekinkwasa-ensonyi 
Ye-engeri nze gye mwagala.

title: KIGAMBO KYA MAGERO NNYO
text:
Ggwe Mukama wange Yesu,
Ombeere mu mwoyo gwange 
Nnyongere-ennyo-okukwagala
Emirembe n'emirembe.

title: MUKAMA WANGE NKWEBAZA
text:
MUKAMA wange nkwebaza
Okundabirira;
Emmere n'eby'okwambala
Byonna biva gy'oli.

title: MUKAMA WANGE NKWEBAZA
text:
ggwe wekka-onkuume mu kabi,
Era ne mu kufa;
Obulamu bwange bwonna 
Buli mu galo zo.

title: MUKAMA WANGE NKWEBAZA
text:
Ontumire malayika 
Ankuumire ddala;
Nneme-okuva mu maaso go 
-Emisan n'ekiro.

title: MUKAMA WANGE NKWEBAZA
text:
Ggwe wampa bakadde bange 
Ne baganda bange;
Wampa n'emikwano gyange,
Bonna baava gy'oli.

title: MUKAMA WANGE NKWEBAZA
text:
Sirina kya kusasula,
Naye kye nkusaba,
Nkwagale-era nkuwulire 
Emirembe gyonna.

title: OMUTAMBUZE NZE
text:
OMUTAMBUZE nze
Era-omugenyi;
Eby'omu nsi bingi
Bijja-okunnimba.

title: OMUTAMBUZE NZE
text:
Yesu atwal(a) abato 
Alibakulembera;
N'abatuusa ewuwe,
Mu maka ge ye.

title: OMUTAMBUZE NZE
text:
Ensi eyo nnungi,
Temuli kabi,
N'ennaku temuli,
Tebituukayo.

title: OMUTAMBUZE NZE
text:
Yesu atwal(a) abato 
Alibakulembera;
N'abatuusa ewuwe,
Mu maka ge ye.

title: OMUTAMBUZE NZE
text:
Olugendo olwo 
Alutambula 
Asaba-eri Yesu 
Obutalemwa.

title: OMUTAMBUZE NZE
text:
Yesu atwal(a) abato 
Alibakulembera;
N'abatuusa ewuwe,
Mu maka ge ye.

title: OMUTAMBUZE NZE
text:
Yesu onnongoose,
Onjigirize;
Onnumggamye,nkwate,
Erijja gy'oli.

title: OMUTAMBUZE NZE
text:
Yesu atwal(a) abato 
Alibakulembera;
N'abatuusa ewuwe,
Mu maka ge ye.

title: OMUTAMBUZE-OMUTO NZE
text:
-OMUTAMBUZE-omuto nze
Natandise leero;
Nnumggamya okumala
-Olugendo lwo lwonna.

title: OMUTAMBUZE-OMUTO NZE
text:
Mulwanyi wo-omuto nze,
Atalina maanyi;
Mbeeranga ggwe-ow'amaanyi 
Nnwanenga n'ebibi.

title: OMUTAMBUZE-OMUTO NZE
text:
Omwana wo-omto nze,
Nkweyabiza wekka;
Mulokozi,ompenga
-Ekisa kyo kye nsabye.

title: OMUTAMBUZE-OMUTO NZE
text:
Mmanyi bwe ndi-omunafu 
Naye ntunuulira;
Ompe-okukuweereza 
Leero ne bulijjo.

title: TEMUYONOONANGA
text:
TEMUYONOONANGA,
Temuyombanga;
Muli ba Mukama,
Muli ba Yesu.

title: TEMUYONOONANGA
text:
Kristo muwombeefu,
Alina-ekisa;
Era n'abaana be 
Bamufaanane.

title: TEMUYONOONANGA
text:
Waliwo Ssetaani 
Abateganya;
Abasendasenda 
Mulokle-ebibi.

title: TEMUYONOONANGA
text:
Mumujeemerenga,
Ne bw'abakema;
Musabe Mukama 
Mube balungi.

title: TEMUYONOONANGA
text:
Edda mwasuubiza 
Nga muli bato;
-Okugaana Ssetaani,
N'amakubo ge.

title: TEMUYONOONANGA
text:
Muli Bakristaayo 
Mulwanyise nnyo 
Buli kibi kyonna,
Mube balungi.

title: TEMUYONOONANGA
text:
Kristo abafuga,
Ye wa mazima;
Era n'abaana be 
Bamufaanane.

title: TULEETA EBIRABO
text:
TULEETA ebirabo
N'essanyu lingi;
Tukutendereza,
Omulokozi.

title: TULEETA EBIRABO
text:
Birabo bitono 
Obikkirize;
Buli kye tuleeta 
Ggwe tokigaana.

title: TULEETA EBIRABO
text:
Yesu tukuwadde 
N'essanyu lingi 
Otuyigirize 
Okugabanga.

title: TULINA KABAKA WAFFE
text:
TULINA Kbaka waffe
Eyava mu ggulu:
Kale fenna abaana be
Tumugoberere.

title: TULINA KABAKA WAFFE
text:
Okwagala kwe kungi nnyo 
Eri-abantu bonna;
Naffe twagale bannaffe
Nga bwe kiyinzika.

title: TULINA KABAKA WAFFE
text:
Yesu tayagala kibi 
Na kwerowoozaako;
Ye omulabe we y'ani,
Amulyamu-olukwe?

title: TULINA KABAKA WAFFE
text:
Ayagala tulongoose 
Emibiri gyaffe;
Abatali batukuvu 
Tebaliba naye.

title: TULINA KABAKA WAFFE
text:
Tuli kibiina kitono,
Naye tusaanidde 
Okutwalira Katonda 
-Emyoyo-emirongoofu.

title: WULIRA-OKUSABA KWANGE
text:
WULIRA-okusaba kwange
Okw'omwana wo-omuto nze,
Ekisa kyo okimpenga,
Bulijjo,bulijjo.

title: WULIRA-OKUSABA KWANGE
text:
Saasira-obunafu bwange 
Obw'omwana wo-omuto nze;
Ekisa kyo okimpenga,
Bulijjo,bulijjo.

title: WULIRA-OKUSABA KWANGE
text:
Sonyiwa-ebyonoono byange,
Ng'obinaaza n'omusaayi,
Ogw'Omulokozi Yesu,
Bulijjo,bulijjo.

title: WULIRA-OKUSABA KWANGE
text:
Ne mu maanyi ga Ssetaani,
Lokolanga-omwoyo gwange;
Wulira-okusaba kwange,
Bulijjo,bulijjo.

title: WULIRA-OKUSABA KWANGE
text:
Kkiriza omwoyo gwange 
Ggwe nkuwadde-okugukuuma;
Nsanyusanga n'ekisa kyo,
Bulijjo,bulijjo.

title: WULIRA-OKUSABA KWANGE
text:
Olw'obwesigwa bwo bwonna 
Ayi-Katonda Onnyambenga;
Mbeefe gy'oli omwesigwa,
Bulijjo,bulijjo.

title: YESU,MUKAMA WANGE
text:
YESU,Mukama wange,
Laba nze ndi muddu wo;
Saasira-obuto bwange
Njagala-okujja gy'oli.

title: YESU,MUKAMA WANGE
text:
Mwana gw'endiga,Yesu,
Naawe wafuuka-omwana,
Bwe ndowooza-ekisa kyo,
Njagala-okukulaba.

title: YESU,MUKAMA WANGE
text:
Ontegeeze bulijjo 
Ebinsaanidde byonna,
Nnyiikirenga okukula-
Nga nkufaanana Yesu.

title: YESU,MUKAMA WANGE
text:
Era n'obuwombeefu,
Bonna ka mbaweereze;
Era okwagalana-ennyo 
Ka ndagenga bulijjo.

title: YESU,MUKAMA WANGE
text:
Ekyo ndikiyinza ntya?
Nga nkusaba bulijjo 
Ggwe-ateesanyusa mu nsi 
Ggwe nnannyini bulungi.

title: YESU,MUKAMA WANGE
text:
Bwe ntyo bwe naayinzanga 
-Okukuweereza Yesu;
Bonna-abantunuulira 
Bandabe nga-omuddu wo.

title: YESU,MUKAMA WANGE
text:
Bwe ntyo bwe naasanyusa 
Katonda ow'okwagala 
Nga mugulumiriza 
Mu mirimu gye nkola.

title: YESU MUSUMBA WANGE
YESU MUSUMBA WANGE
text:
Ntambula nga sikyatya,
Yesu Mukuumi wange;
Mu biro-eby'enjala-andiisa,
Era bwe nnumwa ennyonta,
Antwala ku mabbali
Ag'amazzi-amateefu.

title: YESU MUSUMBA WANGE
text:
Si kirungi nsanyuke?
Si kirungi njaguze?
Ne bwe ndifa talindeka 
Alintuusa ne mu ggulu,
Eyo gye naabeeranga,
Mu maaso ga Katonda.

title: YESU YE ANJAGALA
text:
YESU ye anjagala,
Bw'atyo bwe yayogera:
Abaana-abato babe,
Be yawa-omukisagwe.

title: YESU YE ANJAGALA
text:
Ayagala nze,ayagala nze,
Ayagala nze;yayogera bw'atyo.

title: YESU YE ANJAGALA
text:
Yesu fenna-atwagala;
Yafa-okutununula,
Yatuggulira-oluggi,
Atusonyiwe-ebibi.

title: YESU YE ANJAGALA
text:
Ayagala nze,ayagala nze,
Ayagala nze;yayogera bw'atyo.

title: YESU YE ANJAGALA
text:
Yesu ankulembera 
Gye naagendanga yonna;
Tandekenga-,alintuusa 
Mu ggulu nga njaguza.

title: YESU YE ANJAGALA
text:
Ayagala nze,ayagala nze,
Ayagala nze;yayogera bw'atyo.

title: KATONDA MU GGULU
text:
KATONDA mu ggulu,
Ggwe-otukuza byonna;
N'okwagala kwo-okw'ensusso
Tukuza-ennyumba-eno

title: KATONDA MU GGULU
text:
Mwe tukakasibwa 
Nga tubatizibwa,
N'okunaazibwako-ebibi,
-Olw'ekisa kyo-ekingi.

title: KATONDA MU GGULU
text:
Kristo ye kennyini,
Mw'aliisiza-ababe 
-Omubiri n'Omusaayi ggwe,
Ye mmere y'obulamu-.

title: KATONDA MU GGULU
text:
Abantu-aboonoonyi,
Mwe basaasirirwa;
Bonna-abfiira mu kibi,
Mwe basonyiyirwa.

title: KATONDA MU GGULU
text:
Amaanyi g'omubi 
Gawangulwa mangu;
Bwe gakoona ku nnyumba-eno,
Kubanga ntukuvu.

title: KATONDA MU GGULU
text:
-Ettendo libe-eri ggwe,
Kitaffe n'Omwana,
N'Omwoyo-Omutkuvu,
Emirembe gyonna.

title: EDDA BONNA ABALWADDE
text:
EDDA bonna abalwadde
Baakunoonyanga Yesu,
So tewali n'omu-eyadda
Awatali kuwona.
Otuwulire ggwe Yesu,
Ffe abakukaabidde.

title: EDDA BONNA ABALWADDE
text:
Abanaku n'abakooye,
Abalwala n'abafa;
Bakyetaaga-Omulokozi,
Obawonyeze ddala.
Otuwe ggwe bye twetaaga
Okuliisa-abayala.

title: EDDA BONNA ABALWADDE
text:
Bonna-abzitoowereddwa 
Ebibi bajje gy'oli,
Obatikkule-emigugu.
-Ebibazitoowerera.
Emibiri era-emyoyo 
Yesu,-obiuule bibyo.

title: EDDA BONNA ABALWADDE
EDDA MU NSI ABAYUDAAYA
text:
EDDA mu nsi-Abayudaaya
Bwe baatambulanga
Omukono gwo-ogw'amaanyi
Gwawonya-abalwadde:
Bamuzibe n'abalema
Baakweyunanga ggwe;
Gy'oli abanaku bonna
Basanyusibwanga.

title: EDDA MU NSI ABAYUDAAYA
text:
Abo be wakomangako 
Mu kisa kyo-ekingi 
Baafunanga obulamu
-Essanyu n'emirembe:
Okulwala-era n'okufa 
Byonna byaddukanga
Ne leero jjangu gye tuli 
N'ekisa kyo-ekingi.

title: EDDA MU NSI ABAYUDAAYA
text:
Naffe tukwegayiridde 
Ggwe-agaba-obulamu;
Otuwonye-endwadde zaffe 
Ezituteganya;
Ez'omubiri n'omwoyo:
Tuwonyeze ddala,
N'abo bonna abeetaaga 
Bawonyezebwenga.

title: OBUDDE BWE BWAWUNGEERA
text:
OBUDDE bwe bwawungeera
Abalwadde bajja gy'oli,
Baatuuka nga balumwa nnyo
Ne badda nga basanyuka.

title: OBUDDE BWE BWAWUNGEERA
text:
Naffe leero tuzze gy'oli,
Emyoyo nga gituluma;
Tetukulaba n'amaaso,
Naye tumanyi nga wooli.

title: OBUDDE BWE BWAWUNGEERA
text:
Ayi-Yesu otusaasire,
Ffe-abaana bo,tulwadde nnyo 
Endwadde nnyingi-ez'emwoyo 
N'ennaku zitusanze nnyo.

title: OBUDDE BWE BWAWUNGEERA
text:
Abamu tebakwesiga,
Babuusabuusa ne batya;
Abalala bazze-ennyuma,
Ne beerabira-erinnya lyo.

title: OBUDDE BWE BWAWUNGEERA
OBUDDE BWE BWAWUNGEERA
text:
Mukama otukomeko,
Mu ndwadde zaffe-otuwonye;
Nga-ab'edda bwe bajja gy'oli 
Ne bawonyezebwa bonna.

title: OMULOKOZI WAFFE
text:
OMULOKOZI waffe
Ekisa kyo kingi;
Wansanyusa-abalwadde
Bwe wabeera mu nsi.
Kaakano ffe tuutuno
Mu nnaku nnyingi nnyo;
Mu kwagala kwo-okungi
Otega-amatu go

title: OMULOKOZI WAFFE
text:
Ffe-abakumggaanye wano 
Twetaaga-ekisa kyo;
Kubanga mu mibiri 
Naye Katonda waffe 
Bw'otuula gye tuli,
Endwadde zaffe zonna 
Zinaafuuka-amaanyi.

title: OMULOKOZI WAFFE
text:
Jjangu-,otubeere Yesu,
Tuleme okutya;
Newankubadde-okufa 
Bwe kunaatujjira;
Kuba Mukam waffe 
Wawangula-okufa:
Eri abeesigwa be 
-Okufa kwe kwebaka

title: OMULOKOZI WAFFE
text:
4 
 Bwe tunaalaba-ennaku 
 Ffe tunaakwesiga;
 Tunaalwana bulungi 
 Ng'abaweereza bo.
 Ka tugume emyoyo 
 Tunywereze ddala.
 Taaleme kutubeera,
 Ku lw'obuyinza bwe.

title: OMULOKOZI WAFFE
text:
5 
 Edda twalaba-ennaku 
 Ezaatuluma-ennyo
 Kaakano-essanyu lyokka 
 Yesu,-olw'ekisa kyo;
 Netuweebwa ku lulwo 
 Obutuukirivu;
 Ayi-Omusawo waffe,
 Mukama tolwawo.

title: AMAZE-OMULIMU GWE
text:
AMAZE-omulimu gwe
Alwanye-olutalo lwe;
Avudde mu mayengo,
Yeesiimye-okuwunguka.
Kitaffe tuwaayo gy'oli,
Omwana w(o) eyeebase

title: AMAZE-OMULIMU GWE
AMAZE-OMULIMU GWE
text:
Eyo-amaanyi g'okufa 
Tegakyamutuutako;
Omununuzi gy'ali
Eyawangula-okufa
Kitaffe tuwaayo gy'oli,
Omwana w(o) eyeebase

title: AMAZE-OMULIMU GWE
text:
Naffe-abasigaddewo
Tulinda nnyo n'essuubi;
Okumulaba Yesu,
Ku lunaku-olwentiisa.
Kitaffe tuwaayo gy'oli,
Omwana w(o) eyeebase

title: BAWEEREDDWA-ABAFU
text:
BAWEEREDDWA-abafu
Bonna-abeebakira
Mu mukama waffe,
Kuba bawummula.

title: BAWEEREDDWA-ABAFU
text:
So,nga basanyuka;
Okulaba n'amaaso 
Gwe baali baagala
Nga tannalabika!

title: BAWEEREDDWA-ABAFU
text:
Katonda-asangula 
Amaziga gaabwe;
Abawa-essanyu lye 
Erituukiridde.

title: BAWEEREDDWA-ABAFU
text:
Ffe tubakaabira
Fenna ku ntaana-eno
Nga tulowoozezza
Ku mikwano gyaffe.

title: BAWEEREDDWA-ABAFU
text:
-Ekiseera kitono 
Naffe-alituyita,
Okwetaba nabo
Emirembe gyonna.

title: BAWEEREDDWA-ABAFU
text:
Obudde bulikya,
Nammwe-,eddoboozi lye
Muliriwulira:
Mwenna muzuukuke.

title: MU BUYINIKE-OBUNGI
text:
MU buyinike-obungi
Bwe tuba tufiiriddwa,
Bannaffe be twagala,
Otusanyuse Yesu.

title: MU BUYINIKE-OBUNGI
MU BUYINIKE-OBUNGI
text:
Bwe tweraliikirira
Ne tuggwaamu amaanyi,
Byonna nga kizikiza,
Otusaasire Yesu

title: MU BUYINIKE-OBUNGI
text:
Oluusi bwe tukuvuma
Era nga twerabidde,
Okwagala kwo-okungi,
Otusonyiwe Yesu.

title: MU BUYINIKE-OBUNGI
text:
Ka tuyimuse-emyoyo
Era nga twolesebwa
Ekitiibwa mu ggulu,
Naffe tulituukayo.

title: KABAKA W'EGGULU N'ENSI
text:
KABAKA w'eggulu n'ensi
Tukuwe-ekitiibwa kingi,
Tusuuta n'essanyu lingi
Ggwe-Omugabi.

title: KABAKA W'EGGULU N'ENSI
text:
Olw'obulamu n'essanyu
N'emirembe gyaffe gyonna,
Leero twebaza nnyo nnyini
Ggwe-Omugabi.

title: KABAKA W'EGGULU N'ENSI
text:
Omwaka ggwe ogwengeza
Ne byonna-ebitusanyusa
Emmere n'eby'okwambala
Ggwe-obigaba.

title: KABAKA W'EGGULU N'ENSI
text:
Omwana wo omu yekka
Tewamugaana na kufa
Ku lwaffe abatasaana,
Abajeemu

title: KABAKA W'EGGULU N'ENSI
text:
Olw'emyoyo-emirokole,
Olw'ebibi-ebisonyiwe;
Tulikusasula tutya?
Ggwe-Omugabi.

title: KABAKA W'EGGULU N'ENSI
text:
Ebbanja lyaffe teriggwa;
Naye bye tukuleetedde
Biva kw'ebyo by'otwazika,
Tobinyooma.

title: KABAKA W'EGGULU N'ENSI
text:
Otufukeko-Omwoyo wo
Okutuyinzisa leero
Mu ntalo zaffe,tugobe
Omulabe.

title: KATONDA TUMWEBAZE
text:
KATONDA tumwebaze
N'ennyimba-ez'amatendo
Ku lw'ekisa ky(e) ekingi,
Ekitajjulukuka.

title: KATONDA TUMWEBAZE
text:
Tutende-era-amaanyi ge
Agaatonda-enjuba-eyo;
Twebaz(e) ekis(a) ekingi,
Ekitajjulukuka.

title: KATONDA TUMWEBAZE
text:
Naye yatonda-omwezi
Ogwaka nga buzibye.
Twebaz(e) ekis(a) ekingi,
Ekitajjulukuka.

title: KATONDA TUMWEBAZE
text:
Naye yatuwa-enkuba 
Okumerusa ensigo;
Twebaz(e) ekis(a) ekingi,
Ekitajjulukuka.

title: KATONDA TUMWEBAZE
text:
Era-olw'okukungula
Ne byonna bye tulina;
Twebaz(e) ekis(a) ekingi,
Ekitajjulukuka.

title: KATONDA TUMWEBAZE
text:
Era okusinga byonna
Olw'okufa kwa Yesu;
Twebaz(e) ekis(a) ekingi,
Ekitajjulukuka.

title: KATONDA TUMWEBAZE
text:
Ebitonde bye byonna 
Bimuleetera-ettendo;
Twebaz(e) ekis(a) ekingi,
Ekitajjulukuka.

title: OMWANA WO NKUKOOWOOLA
text:
OMWANA wo nkukoowoola;
Era wansuubiza
Okutuusa ekyengera
Byonna ggwe-obigaba.

title: OMWANA WO NKUKOOWOOLA
text:
Tutunuulira ggwe wekka
Ekyeya bwe kijja;
Era ne ttoggo bw'atuuka,
Tukulindirira.

title: OMWANA WO NKUKOOWOOLA
text:
Enkuba-ebaza-ebibala
Era n'omusana;
Bwe bireeta ekyengera
Naffe tumalibwa.

title: OMWANA WO NKUKOOWOOLA
text:
Naye byetulina bibyo
Otuwe-olw'ekisa;
Tuwe tukwesige wekka
Kubanga-otwagala.

title: OMWANA WO NKUKOOWOOLA
text:
Kaakano ffe tukusaba
Byonna obituwe.
Tukugulumize wekka,
Katonda-atwagala.

title: TUTENDE NNYO MUKAMA
text:
TUTENDE nnyo Mukama
-Olw'okutulabirira;
Ye nsibuko y'essanyu,
Tumwebaze Mukama.

title: TUTENDE NNYO MUKAMA
text:
Laba-eby'okukungula
Byengedde mu nnimiro;
Naffe ka tusanyuke
-Okutuusa bulijjo.

title: TUTENDE NNYO MUKAMA
text:
Emmere gye tusiga,
Tutunuulira oyo
Afukirira-ettaka
Okukuza-ebibala.

title: TUTENDE NNYO MUKAMA
text:
Ka tukutendereze 
Ggwe nannyini kwagala;
Kubanga mu ggwe wekka
Mwe tufuna-obulamu.

title: TUSIGA-ENSIGO-ENNUNGI
text:
TUSIGA-ensigo-ennungi
Mu nnimiro zaffe,
Naye Katonda-azikuzaza
N'azifukirira.
Ayasa omusana
N'atonnyesa-enkuba
Empewo ne zikunta,
Ebimeza-ensigo.

title: TUSIGA-ENSIGO-ENNUNGI
text:
Byonna bye tulina,
(E)bitwetoolodde
Katonda olw'ekisa kye,
Ye atugabira.

title: TUSIGA-ENSIGO-ENNUNGI
text:
Katonda ye yatonda.
Byonna bye tulaba;
-Ebimuli n'ebimera
Byonna byonna ku nsi;
Empewo-era n'ennyanja,
N'ebirimu byonna,
Ennyonyi-ez'omu bbanga 
N'ensolo-ez'omu nsi.

title: TUSIGA-ENSIGO-ENNUNGI
text:
Byonna bye tulina,
(E)bitwetoolodde
Katonda olw'ekisa kye,
Ye atugabira.

title: TUSIGA-ENSIGO-ENNUNGI
text:
Kale ka tumwebaze,
Katonda waffe-oyo
Olw'emere n'obulamu-
N'olw'okukungula;
Naffe tuwaayo-ebyaffe 
Olw'okukwebaza;
Toola-obulamu bwaffe
Bwe tukuwa leero.

title: TUSIGA-ENSIGO-ENNUNGI
text:
Byonna bye tulina,
(E)bitwetoolodde
Katonda olw'ekisa kye,
Ye atugabira.

title: KATONDA LWE LWAZI LWAFFE
text:
KATONDA lwe Lwazi lwaffe:
Ge maanyi-agataggwaawo-:
Tutya ki ffe bannannyini
Mukwano-ogwenkanaawo-?

title: KATONDA LWE LWAZI LWAFFE
KATONDA LWE LWAZI LWAFFE
text:
Ensi nga tennatondebwa,
Ebintu nga mpaawo;
Edda n'edda ggwe-oba bumu,
Katonda-atavaawo.

title: KATONDA LWE LWAZI LWAFFE
text:
Emyaka-olukumi gy'oli 
Lwe lunaku lumu;
Gikulukuta ng'amazzi
Agayita-amangu.

title: KATONDA LWE LWAZI LWAFFE
text:
N'ebintu byonna-eby'omu nsi 
Biyita bwe bityo:
Leero tuba nabyo,naye
Jjo nga biweddewo.

title: KATONDA LWE LWAZI LWAFFE
text:
Katonda lwe lwazi lwaffe,
Ge maanyi-agataggwaawo-;
Tugume ffe bannannyini 
Mukwano-ogwenkanaawo-.

title: KATONDA OW'OKWAGALA
text:
KATONDA ow'okwagala,
Kitaffe ow'emirembe;
Aggyawo mu nsi entalo,
Tuwe nate-emirembe gyo.

title: KATONDA OW'OKWAGALA
text:
Sso tewali kiddukiro 
Wabula mu mikono gyo;
Tuwonye ffe abaana bo,
Tuwe nate-emirembe gyo.

title: KATONDA OW'OKWAGALA
text:
Ojjukire,Ayi-Mukama,
Emirembe gyo egy'edda;
Bajjajja gye baategeeza,
Tuwe nate-emirembe gyo.

title: KATONDA OW'OKWAGALA
MUKAMA TUFUKAMIDDE
text:
MUKAMA tufukamidde,
Tukwegayirira leero,
Olwa baganda baffe-abo,
Kaakano-abali mu ntalo
Sembera kumpi gye bali,
Mukama obakuumenga.

title: MUKAMA TUFUKAMIDDE
text:
Era-n'eri abakyala,
N'abo bannyina b'abaana,
-Abalindiridda nga batya
-Okuwuliza-abantu baabwe;
Katonda Omusanyusa,
Nabo obasanyusenga.

title: MUKAMA TUFUKAMIDDE
MUKAMA TUFUKAMIDDE
KATONDA ABEERENGA NAAWE
text:
KATONDA abeerenga naawe
Akuwenga omukisa,
Akubalire mu babe,
Akukuume-okutuusa-okufa.

title: KATONDA ABEERENGA NAAWE
text:
Weeraba,weeraba,
Otambule mirembe;
Weeraba,weeraba,
Omutonzi abeere naawe.

title: KATONDA ABEERENGA NAAWE
text:
Katonda abeerenga naawe,
Akukwate mu ngalo ze,
Akuwe-emmere y'omwoyo,
Akukuume-okutuusa-okufa

title: KATONDA ABEERENGA NAAWE
text:
Weeraba,weeraba,
Otambule mirembe;
Weeraba,weeraba,
Omutonzi abeere naawe.

title: KATONDA ABEERENGA NAAWE
text:
Katonda abeerenga naawe,
Entiisa bw'erikujjira,
Akwetoolooze ekisa,
Abeerenga naawe bulijjo.

title: KATONDA ABEERENGA NAAWE
text:
Weeraba,weeraba,
Otambule mirembe;
Weeraba,weeraba,
Omutonzi abeere naawe.

title: KATONDA ABEERENGA NAAWE
text:
Katonda abeeranga naawe,
Akuwe okwagala kwe,
Akuyise mu mayengo,
Akutuuse mu kisulo kyo.

title: KATONDA ABEERENGA NAAWE
text:
Weeraba,weeraba,
Otambule mirembe;
Weeraba,weeraba,
Omutonzi abeere naawe.

title: BEWAAYO-ABAANA BEEBAZIBWA
text:
Bewaayo-abaana beebazibwa
Ku lwaffe bawaayo-obulamu ne byonna;
Tumanyi Makayi ne banne
Abaaleeta Yesu-Omulokozi yekka

title: BEWAAYO-ABAANA BEEBAZIBWA
text:
Aleruuya ku lwa Yesu 
Battibwa nga bayimba;
Bewaayo-abaana beebazibwa,
Ku lwaffe bawaayo-obulamu ne byonna.

title: BEWAAYO-ABAANA BEEBAZIBWA
text:
Baabatemako-emikono ne babasiba
Mu nkabazi ne babookya nga balaba bonna;
Baali bato-abasoma-akatono,
Yesu yebazibwe-abajulira leero.

title: BEWAAYO-ABAANA BEEBAZIBWA
text:
Aleruuya ku lwa Yesu 
Battibwa nga bayimba;
Bewaayo-abaana beebazibwa,
Ku lwaffe bawaayo-obulamu ne byonna.

title: BEWAAYO-ABAANA BEEBAZIBWA
text:
Ekyewuunyisa Balikuddembe,
Gonza ne Kaggwa nabo-abo baali bagumu;
Baabatemako-emikono,baabasalako
Ebigere,baatemwatemwa-ofufiifi bonna.

title: BEWAAYO-ABAANA BEEBAZIBWA
text:
Aleruuya ku lwa Yesu 
Battibwa nga bayimba;
Bewaayo-abaana beebazibwa,
Ku lwaffe bawaayo-obulamu ne byonna.

title: BEWAAYO-ABAANA BEEBAZIBWA
text:
Walukagga ne Lugalama wamu
Ne kakumba,Kadoko ne Munyagabyanjo
Okukkiriza kwe mwagala n'obuvumu 
Bwe mutyo ne mubeera-abasaale baffe.

title: BEWAAYO-ABAANA BEEBAZIBWA
text:
Aleruuya ku lwa Yesu 
Battibwa nga bayimba;
Bewaayo-abaana beebazibwa,
Ku lwaffe bawaayo-obulamu ne byonna.

title: BEWAAYO-ABAANA BEEBAZIBWA
text:
Mu kajanga yatuuyana n'atawuka 
Nga bookebwa n'abamu nga batemebwatemebwa,
Mwalimu n'omwana gw'azaala:
Ku olwo kyamubuukako naye bwe yakkiriza.

title: BEWAAYO-ABAANA BEEBAZIBWA
text:
Aleruuya ku lwa Yesu 
Battibwa nga bayimba;
Bewaayo-abaana beebazibwa,
Ku lwaffe bawaayo-obulamu ne byonna.

title: BEWAAYO-ABAANA BEEBAZIBWA
text:
Baali bumu nga bookebwa-omuliro,
Ne wataba n'omu awanjaga-ateebwe;
Baali ku kimu-eky'okusaba-obusabi
Yesu gwe bakkiriza-atwale myoyo gyabwe.

title: BEWAAYO-ABAANA BEEBAZIBWA
text:
Aleruuya ku lwa Yesu 
Battibwa nga bayimba;
Bewaayo-abaana beebazibwa,
Ku lwaffe bawaayo-obulamu ne byonna.

title: BEWAAYO-ABAANA BEEBAZIBWA
text:
Waliwo nnyo-amaanyi gaakoseza 
Yesu eri byonna-abamwesiga bulijjo;
-Omuliro-ogw'entisa,musaayi-ogwayiika
Yesu yalinga wakati waabwe.

title: BEWAAYO-ABAANA BEEBAZIBWA
text:
Aleruuya ku lwa Yesu 
Battibwa nga bayimba;
Bewaayo-abaana beebazibwa,
Ku lwaffe bawaayo-obulamu ne byonna.

title: BEWAAYO-ABAANA BEEBAZIBWA
text:
Twewaddeyo naffe-olwa leero-
Okubonyabonyezebwa,oba kuttibwa kujje;
Tuli bagumu nga-abalenzi bali nga
Twesiga-amaanyi ge-okutuusa lw'alidda.

title: BEWAAYO-ABAANA BEEBAZIBWA
text:
Aleruuya ku lwa Yesu 
Battibwa nga bayimba;
Bewaayo-abaana beebazibwa,
Ku lwaffe bawaayo-obulamu ne byonna.

title: AYI KATONDA OGIKUUME
text:
AYI Katonda ogikuume
Ensi yaffe-eno Uganda;
Naffe-abantu-abagirimu
Otuwenga omukisa.

title: AYI KATONDA OGIKUUME
text:
Kitaffe ow'omu ggulu,
Ggwe-eyatonda-ensi n'abantu 
Ebimera-era n'ensolo,
Buli kintu wakitonda.

title: AYI KATONDA OGIKUUME
text:
Otuwenga omukisa
Ffe abantu ba Uganda;
Ekisa n'obulungi bwo,
Bituukirirenga mu ffe.

title: AYI KATONDA OGIKUUME
text:
Obakuume abafuzi
Okutukulemberanga;
Babeerenga-ab'amazima
Mw'ebyo bye banaakolanga.

title: AYI KATONDA OGIKUUME
text:
Ffe-abantu abagirimu 
Mu mawanga ne mu bika;
Tukusaba kimu kyokka:
Otuwe-okwagalananga.

title: AYI KATONDA OGIKUUME
text:
Ne mu buvubuka bwaffe,
Mu maanyi gonna ag'ensi
Mu buggya n'obutamanya,
Ayi-Katonda,tukuumenga.

title: OBUDDE BUZIBYE;YESU
text:
OBUDDE buzibye;Yesu
Njijja ne mu maaso go,
Mu kizikiza n'ekisa,
Kuuma nze omuddu wo,

title: OBUDDE BUZIBYE;YESU
text:
Mwana gw'endiga,gw'osinga
Okubeera omulungi;
Ggwe wansasiira;nnali nga
Naatera kufa bufi.

title: OBUDDE BUZIBYE;YESU
OBUDDE BUZIBYE;YESU
text:
Mwana gw'endiga,gw'osinga
Okubeera omulungi;
Ggwe wansasiira;nnali nga
Naatera kufa bufi.

title: OBUDDE BUZIBYE;YESU
text:
Buli kye tukoze olabye,
Buli kye tukwonoonye;
Bwe tukyalaba,tusaba,
Yesu,otusonyiwe.

title: OBUDDE BUZIBYE;YESU
text:
Mwana gw'endiga,gw'osinga
Okubeera omulungi;
Ggwe wansasiira;nnali nga
Naatera kufa bufi.

title: WAALIWO EDDA OMUWALA:YALAGULWA BANNABBI
text:
WAALIWO edda omuwala:yalagulwa bannabbi
Okuzaala-omulokozi nga olwa leero,
Atulokole mu bibi era ne mu kufa
Adamu-bye yatusuulamu-mu kusooka kw'ensi

title: WAALIWO EDDA OMUWALA:YALAGULWA BANNABBI
text:
Ka tusanyuke nnyo nnyini ka tujaguze,
Yesu Omulokozi yazaalwa nga leero.

title: WAALIWO EDDA OMUWALA:YALAGULWA BANNABBI
text:
Mu Beserekemu e Buyudaaya,
Malyamu yagenda awamu ne Yusufu 
N'abantu-abalala bangi okwewandiisa 
Nga bwe baalagirwa Kayisaali Agusito.

title: WAALIWO EDDA OMUWALA:YALAGULWA BANNABBI
text:
Ka tusanyuke nnyo nnyini ka tujaguze,
Yesu Omulokozi yazaalwa nga leero.

title: WAALIWO EDDA OMUWALA:YALAGULWA BANNABBI
WAALIWO EDDA OMUWALA:YALAGULWA BANNABBI
text:
Ne bamala gasula mu kisibo ky'ente 
Ne beebeka mu nju omwo-ensolo nga mwe ziri
Naye tebanyooma wabi watyo;
Bw'atyo Omulokozi bwe yazaalibwa

title: WAALIWO EDDA OMUWALA:YALAGULWA BANNABBI
text:
Ka tusanyuke nnyo nnyini ka tujaguze,
Yesu Omulokozi yazaalwa nga leero.

title: WAALIWO EDDA OMUWALA:YALAGULWA BANNABBI
text:
Abasumba Katonda yabatumira 
Nga balunda ebisibo ku ttale-ekiro,
Malayika n'agamba nti,Musanyuke nnyo
Kubanga Omulokozi azaaliddwa leero.

title: WAALIWO EDDA OMUWALA:YALAGULWA BANNABBI
text:
Ka tusanyuke nnyo nnyini ka tujaguze,
Yesu Omulokozi yazaalwa nga leero.

title: WAALIWO EDDA OMUWALA:YALAGULWA BANNABBI
text:
Amangu ago abasumba ne balaba mu bbanga 
Okwolesebwa kwa bamalayika,
Bayimba n'essanyu,ntiEkitiibwa kibe

title: WAALIWO EDDA OMUWALA:YALAGULWA BANNABBI
text:
Eri Katonda waggulu,Emirembe mu bantu:
Ka tusanyuke nnyo nnyini ka tujaguze,
Yesu Omulokozi yazaalwa nga leero.

title: SIKUKULU EYASOKA YAJIRA ABASUMBA ABALUNDA
text:
Sikukulu eyasoka yajira abasumba abalunda,
Ekisibo kyabwe ekyendinga,Malayika naja ekiro nagamba:
Sikukulu,Sikukulu Kabaka azalidwa lero.

title: SIKUKULU EYASOKA YAJIRA ABASUMBA ABALUNDA
text:
Batunula nebalaba Emunyenye eyaka mubuvanjuba,
Emunyenye ku nsi ekitibwa kingi,Era nomusana nga gwaka mungi:
Sikukulu,Sikukulu Kabaka azalidwa lero.

title: SIKUKULU EYASOKA YAJIRA ABASUMBA ABALUNDA
text:
Bwebala emunyenye eyo,Abagegezi nebava wala nyo,
Emunyenye kugigoberera,Kabaka oyo okumusinza:
Sikukulu,Sikukulu Kabaka azalidwa lero.

title: SIKUKULU EYASOKA YAJIRA ABASUMBA ABALUNDA
text:
Emuyenye eyasembera Ebeserekemu neimirira,
Era oluvo kweyaberera, Mukifo Yesu weyazazikibwa:
Sikukulu,Sikukulu Kabaka azalidwa lero.

title: SIKUKULU EYASOKA YAJIRA ABASUMBA ABALUNDA
text:
Nebaingira abasatu abo,Nebamutonera ebirabo byabye,
Zabu nobubane nomugavu,Nga bavunama nobuwombefu:
Sikukulu,Sikukulu Kabaka azalidwa lero.

title: SIKUKULU EYASOKA YAJIRA ABASUMBA ABALUNDA
text:
Kale nafe tumusinze,Tumutendereze Mukama wafe
Eyakola egulu nensi,Eyanunula abantu nomusai
Sikukulu,Sikukulu Kabaka azalidwa lero.

title: OJE OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU OMULISE EMITIMA GYAFFE
OJE OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU OMULISE EMITIMA GYAFFE
OJE OMWOYO OMUTUKUVU OMULISE EMITIMA GYAFFE
OMUTUKUVU OMUTUKUVU
text:
Omutukuvu,Omutukuvu,Omutukuvu,
Mukama Katonda owegye lyona,
Egulu nensi zona bujude ekitibwa-,ekitibwako.

title: OMUTUKUVU OMUTUKUVU
text:
Omutukuvu,Omutukuvu,Omutukuvu,
Mukama Katonda owegye lyona,
Owebwe ekitibwa,Ai Mukama ali wagulu enyo.

title: OMUTUKUVU OMUTUKUVU
text: Amen.

title: OMWANA GW'ENDIGA
text:
OMWANA gw'endiga,
Gwe-eyatufiirira,
Twesigenga okufa kwo okw'omuwendo;
-Omulokozi waffe,
Ne mu mibiriizi zo,
-Enfumite mwe muli-obuddukiro waffe.

title: OMWANA GW'ENDIGA
text:
Omwana gw'endiga
Mu musaayi gwo-omwo,
Mwe tuteekera ddala-emitima gyaffe,
-Otutukuzenga 
Tube balongoofu,
Mu nsi-efuukafuuka-otuwanirirenga.

title: OMWANA GW'ENDIGA
text:
Omwana gw'endiga 
Ggwe eyatufiirira 
Wazuukira n'oddira mu kitiibwa kyo
Ggwe mmere-ey'obulamu 
-Otuliisenga fenna,
Obeerenga mu ffe,naffe tube mu ggwe.

title: OMWANA GW'ENDIGA
text:
Omwana gw'endiga
Ggwe-osaanide wekka,
Ku Nnamulondo ya Katonda Kitaffe 
Okuva-edda n'edda,
Wabeeranga bumu
N'Omwoyo Omutukuvu bwe Busatu.

title: ENSI ZONNA ZIYIMBE
text:
ENSI zonna ziyimbe
Okumanyisa
Obukama bwa Yesu,
N'obulungi bwe
Buli bantu bayimbe
Ennyimba-ez'ettendo lye.

title: ENSI ZONNA ZIYIMBE
text:
Ensi zonna ziyimbe,
Mu buvanjuba,
Mwe muviira bulijjo 
Enjuba yaffe,
Amatendo ga Yesu 
Gabune mu nsi zonna.

title: ENSI ZONNA ZIYIMBE
text:
Ensi zonna ziyimbe,
Mu nsalo zaazo,
Mu bizinga wala nnyo,
Ne mu bibira;
Mu musana n'empewo,
Munaalanga-amatendo.

title: ENSI ZONNA ZIYIMBE
text:
Ensi zonna ziyimbe 
Yesu Kabaka.
Wonna wonna wabune,
Ettutumu lye:
Tumusinze ye yekka
Ow'emirembe gyonna.

title: KATONDA BYASIMA YE BIRIKOLERWA DALA
text:
Katonda byasima birikolerwa dala,
Nebyo byateseza byoka,biritukirizibwa,
Ate bulijo lusembera olunaku-olukulu-enyo,
Etendolye bwerinabunanga munsi,ngamayengo-agomu nyanja.

title: KATONDA BYASIMA YE BIRIKOLERWA DALA
text:
Okuva-obukikanobukika abantu webabunye Mu-
mimwa gyaba tume be basindise,ekigambokye kyogedwa,
Nti mumpulirenga mwena-abatula kubizinga ne munsi zona,

title: YIMBA GGWE MWOYO GWANGE
text: Eyajja gye tuli mu kisa kye ekingi:

title: YIMBA GGWE MWOYO GWANGE
text:
Yimba ggwe mwoyo gwange,
Yimba nnyo n'eddoboozi;(ggwe)
Tendereza Yesu,Omulokozi wange;
Yimba ggwe mwoyo gwange,
Yimba nnyo n'eddoboozi;(ggwe)
Osanyukenga bulijjo olw'obulokozi.

title: YIMBA GGWE MWOYO GWANGE
text:
Ka twebaze-oluyimba lwa bamalayika:
Nga bamulanga Yesu nti Azze gye tuli;
Twegatte mu kuyimba ku nsi wamu nabo,
Nga tuli ne Yesu,Omulokozi.
